TL;DR: 提出BA-MPD知识蒸馏目标，通过边界锚定校正与质量划分蒸馏，抑制教师偏差，提升低资源声学学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源下教师网络因标注有限或不平衡产生有偏预测分布，直接全分布匹配会传递教师偏差，扭曲学生决策边界并降低泛化。

Method: BA-MPD包含边界锚定校正（BAC）和质量划分蒸馏（MPD）。BAC在教师top预测集合中缺失真实标签时，将真实标签替换最低排名项，保持集合质量与不确定性；MPD通过关系一致性损失、高低置信组质量平衡损失及低置信依赖加权损失蒸馏校正后分布。

Result: 在两个声学基准、多种标签预算下，BA-MPD持续优于监督基线及原始KD，与强logit KD基线相当；跨预算实验中教师与学生标签预算不匹配时仍有效。

Conclusion: BA-MPD能抑制有害排序错误和低置信噪声，保留有用教师信息，有效利用不完美教师跨越监督差距。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) improves low-resource acoustic learning by enriching one-hot supervision with the softened predictive distribution of a fixed teacher network. However, a teacher trained with limited or imbalanced annotations may produce a biased distribution whose components are not uniformly reliable. Although this distribution can still encode useful knowledge, direct full-distribution matching may also transfer teacher-induced biases, thereby distorting the student's decision boundary and degrading its generalization performance. To address this limitation, we propose Boundary-Anchored Mass-Partitioned Distillation (BA-MPD), a logit-based distillation objective composed of Boundary-Anchored Correction (BAC) and Mass-Partitioned Distillation (MPD). BAC addresses missing ground-truth labels in the set of the teacher's top predictions by swapping the true label for the lowest-ranked entry of the set, thus keeping the mass and uncertainty of the set unchanged. MPD then distills this corrected distribution through separate losses that enforce relational consistency within the set, balance the mass between high- and low-confidence groups, and weight lower-confidence dependencies. Ultimately, BAC and MPD together suppress harmful ranking errors and noisy low-confidence details, while retaining all useful teacher information. Experiments on two acoustic benchmarks under multiple label budgets show that BA-MPD consistently improves over supervised-learning baselines and vanilla KD while remaining competitive with strong logit-based KD baselines. Cross-budget results further show that BA-MPD remains effective when the teacher and student models use mismatched label budgets, demonstrating its ability to exploit imperfect teachers across supervision gaps. Implementation available at https://github.com/ShuanglinLi/BA-MPD.

</details>


### [105] [Readable Before Actionable: Causal Tracing of Indirect Prompt Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05295)
*Zhe Yu,Wenpeng Xing,Xingxing Yang,Meng Han*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 论文通过反事实角色探针、组件激活修补和AgentDojo轨迹干预，研究了间接提示注入中区分指令与数据、以及影响后续动作的状态编辑之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 间接提示注入使LLM代理执行嵌入外部数据中的指令；现有探针能识别角色但无法定位改变下一步动作的状态编辑，需探究这一差距。

Method: 采用反事实角色探针、组件级激活修补，并在AgentDojo轨迹上分别干预；在Qwen受控测试中沿独立估计的角色方向进行修补；在劫持与抵抗训练轨迹上估计方向；进行单位置、跨度和重复编辑；移除学习到的通道子空间。

Result: 角色解码对内容和格式变化鲁棒；在Qwen中角色解码先于强工具选择效应；在AgentDojo中，来自劫持和抵抗轨迹的方向在动作前和注入跨度位置降低攻击成功率，随机位置效果甚微；长轨迹中单位置编辑在较深层效果减弱，跨度与重复编辑可降低攻击成功率；移除通道子空间保留角色解码，但有效干预方向跨通道迁移差。

Conclusion: 可读的角色信号与有效行为干预需区分：受控工具选择中深度关键，而攻击轨迹中位置与上下文同样重要。

Abstract: Indirect prompt injection causes LLM agents to follow commands embedded in external data. A probe may distinguish instructions from data without identifying a state edit that changes the next action. We study this gap through counterfactual role probes, component-wise activation patching, and separate interventions on AgentDojo trajectories. Role decoding survives changes in content and format. In controlled Qwen tests, it precedes strong tool-choice effects from patches along an independently estimated role direction. On AgentDojo, directions estimated from hijacked and resisted training trajectories reduce attack success at pre-action and injected-span positions, but have little effect at random positions. In longer Qwen trajectories, single-position edits become less effective at later layers; span-wide and repeated edits reduce attack success on the same evaluation set. Removing the learned channel subspace preserves role decoding, yet effective intervention directions transfer poorly across the tested channels. These findings distinguish a readable role signal from an effective behavioral intervention: depth matters in controlled tool choice, while position and context also matter in attack trajectories.

</details>


### [106] [METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05100)
*Nodens Koren,Thomas Hofmann,Georgios Kissas*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出METRO，用可学习的马氏度量替代线性投影，实现几何感知的令牌路由，提升神经算子在复杂网格上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子依赖线性兼容分数进行潜在令牌化，在归一化下等价于各向同性欧氏聚类，不归一化则导致无界线性决策区域，均缺乏切片特定的各向异性局部性，造成潜在切片冗余和纠缠。

Method: METRO将线性投影替换为可学习的马氏度量，使每个潜在切片学习局部各向异性张量，将感受野塑造成指数局部化的定向椭球，与边界层、尾流等流动特征自然对齐，可直接替换Transformer和Mamba骨干。

Result: 在标准PDE基准和复杂工业设计任务上，METRO在不规则域上显著优于基线，在Transformer和Mamba骨干上均取得一致提升，并在不同雷诺数和几何配置的分布外场景中表现出更强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: METRO作为一种几何感知路由机制，有效解决了线性令牌化的局限性，提升了神经算子在复杂网格和分布外条件下的性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

</details>


### [107] [AI Safety via Debate is Compromised by Cognitive Biases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05461)
*Gefei Liu,Sonya Rashkovan,Sophia Lloyd George,Isaac Sheidlower,Serena Booth*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本研究检验AI安全辩论中真实论点在对抗审查下是否仍具优势，发现人类裁判易受修辞操纵策略影响而改变判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF使大模型响应人类指令，但人类评估者常偏好谄媚或有说服力的回答而非真实回答，促使模型为迎合评估者而牺牲准确性；AI安全辩论被提出以改善监督，其核心前提是真实论点在对抗审查下更易辩护，但该前提是否在辩手使用利用人类判断偏差的修辞策略时仍成立尚待验证。

Method: 受竞技辩论启发，构建68个由LLM生成的侦探悬疑对话，已知凶手，涵盖四种干预：锚定、谬误监督、专业术语偏好和冗长；将每种干预应用于支持真凶一方或支持无辜嫌疑人一方，以区分对裁决的影响与正确性；开展369名参与者的研究。

Result: 汇总各偏差类型后，这些干预显著地将判断推向被操纵的一方。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了基于辩论的监督的一个脆弱性：人类裁决对操纵性修辞策略敏感。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has played a central role in making large language models responsive to human instructions. However, human evaluators often favor flattering or persuasive responses over truthful ones, creating incentives for models to appeal to evaluators at the expense of accuracy. AI safety via debate has been proposed as a way to improve the supervision of language models: in this paradigm, two agents argue opposing positions and challenge each other's claims, potentially exposing falsehoods to the adjudicator. A central premise of AI safety via debate is that truthful arguments are easier to defend than false ones under adversarial scrutiny. In this work, we investigate whether this advantage persists when debaters use rhetorical strategies that exploit biases in human judgment. Inspired by competitive debate, we construct 68 LLM-generated dialogues about detective mysteries with known culprits, spanning four interventions: anchoring, fallacy oversight, pro-jargon, and verbosity. We apply each intervention to either the side advocating for the true culprit or the side advocating for an innocent suspect, allowing us to distinguish influence on adjudication from correctness. In a study with 369 participants, we find that, pooled across bias types, these interventions significantly shift judgments toward the manipulated side. These findings expose a vulnerability in debate-based supervision: human adjudication is sensitive to manipulative rhetorical strategies.

</details>


### [108] [Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05139)
*Noor Munir,Francesco Quinzan,Stephen Roberts*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 研究了代码大语言模型在面对不可信上下文中的不安全指令时生成漏洞代码的风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码大语言模型的开发上下文可能包含来自不可信来源的不安全指令，需要探究这些指令能否在无模型权重或训练数据的情况下诱导模型生成漏洞代码。

Method: 评估了十个开源代码大语言模型（3B-13B参数，四个基础模型和六个指令微调模型），覆盖十种Web应用弱点类别，对比了嵌入不安全指令的代码注释任务与无恶意指令的良性任务。

Result: 攻击条件下77.4-92.3%的生成结果包含中等或更高严重性弱点，良性条件仅为1.7-5.1%；基础模型和指令微调模型平均漏洞输出率分别为86.5%和84.5%，指令微调后降低不超过8.1%；漏洞输出中86.2-91.0%被评为高或严重；生成后筛查可减少但无法消除风险，最强筛查仍漏检约三分之一。

Conclusion: 推理时上下文注入是一个重要的攻击面，需要采用来源感知的训练目标。

Abstract: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

</details>


### [109] [The GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 - a Public Tool to Assess Generative AI Tools for the Design of Interactive Digital Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05633)
*Hartmut Koenitz,Jonathan Barbara,Mirjam Palosaari Eladhari*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0，一个通过公开Web应用实现AI辅助评估的生成式AI交互式数字叙事评估框架，新增事实核查与偏见检测任务，并报告多模型评估结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对生成式AI工具创建交互式数字叙事的评估依赖人工测试，效率低且可能存在模型偏见；同时ICIDS 2025上提出的担忧需要纳入事实核查与偏见检测。

Method: 引入AI辅助评估，通过公开Web应用（https://genai4idn.com）支持按需运行基准、添加新模型和提出新任务；采用盲评框架避免模型偏见，处理音乐、视频和完整IDN等复杂媒体；新增事实核查和偏见检测任务及评分标准，并由具有相关背景的人类评分者验证。

Result: 多模型评估显示创意能力逐渐成熟，但存在失控思维和过度安全过滤的局限；事实核查能可靠发现细微历史错误、时代错乱和虚构主张；偏见评分者能持续暴露结构性假设、刻板印象和边缘群体抹除。

Conclusion: GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0通过AI辅助和社区驱动的评估框架，有效扩展了对生成式AI在交互式数字叙事中创意、事实性和偏见问题的评估能力。

Abstract: This paper presents GENAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0, the third iteration of an evaluation framework to assess Generative AI tools for creating Interactive Digital Narratives (IDNs). Moving beyond manual testing, this iteration introduces AI-assisted evaluation through a publicly accessible web application (https://genai4idn.com), enabling the community to run benchmarks on demand, add new models, and propose new tasks. The revised evaluation framework is "blinded" to avoid model-bias, and can handle complex media such as music, videos, and full IDNs that previously required human raters. A significant addition - responding to concerns raised during ICIDS 2025 - is the addition of fact-checking and bias detection with dedicated tasks and rubrics, validated by human raters with lived experience in the depicted contexts. Findings from a diverse range of models report on maturing creative capabilities while observing runaway thinking and overzealous safety filters as limitations. Fact-checking reliably caught subtle historical inaccuracies, anachronisms, and fabricated claims while the bias rater consistently exposed structural assumptions, tropes, and marginalized group erasures.

</details>


### [110] [Toward AI Trustworthiness: Finding Analytically Proven Forward-Invariant Sets for AI-Controlled Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05689)
*Haoyang Song,Xikun Yang,Qixin Wang*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出基于可逆神经网络将状态空间映射到潜空间，训练并形式化验证得到前向不变集（FIS），以证明AI控制系统的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络控制器因高度非线性难以解释和验证，在安全关键应用中存在可信性隐患；为给定AI控制系统找到可解析证明的FIS很困难。

Method: 利用可逆神经网络（INN）将原始状态空间变换到潜空间，训练INN使预设的超矩形候选区域在潜空间中成为不变集，再进行形式化验证；证明验证成功时潜空间候选及其逆变换回原空间的结果均为解析证明的FIS。

Result: 在三个代表性控制测试平台的45个AI控制系统中，该方法为全部45个系统找到认证FIS，而适配的最先进基线方法一个都未找到；在40/45个系统上速度更快，且所得FIS中心与领域专家偏好大致吻合。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效且高效地为AI控制系统构建可形式化认证的前向不变集，从而提升安全与任务关键应用中的可信性。

Abstract: Neural-network (NN) controllers are increasingly used in nonlinear control systems, but their highly nonlinear behavior makes them difficult to explain and verify, raising trustworthiness concerns in safety- and mission-critical applications. A key step toward certifiable trustworthiness is to find a Forward-Invariant Set (FIS): a state-space region such that any trajectory starting inside remains inside. If the FIS excludes unsafe states, safety can be guaranteed for initial states within it. Finding an analytically proven FIS for a given AI-controlled system with a fixed controller is difficult. We propose a framework that uses an Invertible Neural Network (INN) to transform the original state space into a latent space where a regular-shaped FIS is more likely to exist. We train the INN so that a preferred hyper-rectangular candidate becomes invariant in the latent space, then formally verify it. We prove that, whenever verification succeeds, both the latent-space candidate and its inverse-transformed counterpart in the original state space are analytically proven FISs. We evaluate the approach on 45 AI-controlled systems across three representative control testbeds. Our method finds certified FISs for all 45 systems, whereas an adapted state-of-the-art baseline finds none. It is also faster on 40 of the 45 systems, and the centers of the resulting FISs roughly match domain-expert preferences.

</details>


### [111] [Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05329)
*Hanzhang Wang,Tianqi Shen,Zonglin Liu,Junze He,Difan Zou,Ziye Ma*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该论文将预训练中的权重平均建模为保留训练进度与提升扰动鲁棒性之间的权衡，推导出连续核族并统一了传统策略，同时建立了PTQ下的理论框架，实验验证了预测行为和策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重平均虽能改善LLM低精度PTQ性能，但其机制不明导致增益不一致且脆弱，阻碍实际应用。

Method: 将权重平均形式化为训练进度保留与扰动鲁棒性提升的权衡，推导连续平均核族以统一策略并达到帕累托前沿，建立PTQ下权重平均的理论框架。

Result: 理论表明较粗量化更易受扰动，较细量化受影响较小；实验验证了预测行为和所提出的平均策略。

Conclusion: 结果为不同PTQ条件下执行权重平均提供了统一理论指导。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

</details>


### [112] [Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05332)
*Kim-Dung Tran,Dang-Man Nguyen,Vu-Linh Nguyen,Xuan-Truong Hoang,Sébastien Destercke,Van-Nam Huynh*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该论文针对深度集成学习中的训练与存储负担以及谨慎（集值）预测的鲁棒性问题，提出采用紧凑集成（如贝叶斯神经网络和带蒙特卡洛dropout的卷积神经网络）生成概率预测，并定义代表分布以计算任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测，同时引入一族集效用实现高效集值预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度集成学习面临训练和存储负担重，且谨慎（集值）预测针对多种效用（可能涉及奖励敏感性）的鲁棒性不足。

Method: 使用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带蒙特卡洛dropout的卷积神经网络）产生概率预测；对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测定义优化某统计距离的代表分布；再用代表分布定义任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测；提出满足理想性质的集效用族，其集值贝叶斯最优预测可高效求解。

Result: 通过实证展示了所提集成学习框架的潜在优势与劣势。

Conclusion: 紧凑集成结合代表分布和集效用族能缓解训练存储负担并提升集值预测鲁棒性，但存在潜在劣势。

Abstract: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

</details>


### [113] [Topology-Conditioned Backdoors: Language Models That Insert Vulnerabilities When They Infer They Are in a Multi-Agent System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05793)
*Keegan Wang,Anantika Mannby*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型在提示暗示多智能体系统时生成漏洞代码的安全失败模式，通过微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct实现基于部署拓扑的条件后门，并验证其触发与泛化特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单智能体评估可能无法揭示模型在多智能体上下文中的不安全行为，作者旨在系统研究这种由部署拓扑线索条件化的安全失败模式，并探索有效的审计方法。

Method: 微调Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，使其根据提示级来源线索推断的部署拓扑条件化代码生成；采用任务特定检查器、独立bandit分析器、词汇安慰剂和人工审查对照；在两个Qwen检查点和两个训练种子上复现；进行盲审评估。

Result: 任务特定检查器在96-100%的多智能体片段中检测到漏洞，单智能体为0%；bandit分析器检测到约67%的多智能体片段，覆盖九类漏洞家族中的六类（中/高严重度）；模型泛化到五种未训练信号类型；盲审中审计员在10次实验运行中9次识别出拓扑触发器，对照组0次；二元策略存在判断区分度差。

Conclusion: 结果支持对匹配的单智能体和多智能体上下文进行差异化审计，并证明了一种可训练的、以描述拓扑为条件的后门；但该后门在真实多智能体环境中的激活尚未测试。

Abstract: A language model may behave safely in a single-agent evaluation yet produce vulnerable code when its context suggests that it is part of a multi-agent system. We study this failure mode by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to condition code generation on deployment topology inferred from prompt-level provenance cues. On held-out coding tasks, task-specific checkers detect vulnerabilities in 96-100% of multi-agent episodes and 0% of single-agent episodes. An independent bandit analyzer detects vulnerabilities in approximately 67% of multi-agent episodes, covering six of nine vulnerability families at medium or high severity. Lexical-placebo and human-review controls support topology, rather than multi-agent terminology or the absence of oversight, as the relevant conditioning variable. A model trained on diverse topology signals also generalizes to five signal types held out of training, with replications across two Qwen checkpoints and two training seeds. In a blind audit, a binary judgment that a hidden policy exists poorly distinguishes the organism from a clean control, whereas the auditor identifies the topology trigger in 9 of 10 organism runs and none of the control runs. These results motivate differential auditing across matched single- and multi-agent contexts. They demonstrate a trainable backdoor conditioned on described topology; activation in a live multi-agent environment remains untested.

</details>


### [114] [Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06122)
*Xunguang Wang,Qingyue Wang,Yuguang Zhou,Zongjie Li,Wenxuan Wang,Shuai Wang*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 首次系统评估具身智能体的越狱护栏，提出可插拔框架在感知、规划、控制三阶段对比六种护栏，发现防御有效性、可用性与效率存在权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体易受越狱攻击导致物理危害，现有护栏缺乏系统评估，且现有基准仅评估模型本身，无法反映护栏实际防御效果。

Method: 构建可插拔评估框架，将具身智能体作为固定后端，护栏作为可干预感知/规划/控制的模块；对六种代表性护栏测试模板与自动化越狱攻击及安全指令，从防御有效性（绕过率、危害成功率）、可用性（误报率、安全任务完成率）、效率（延迟开销）三维度系统级评估。

Result: 实验揭示三维度间明显权衡，无单一护栏在所有设置下占优；干预阶段、决策机制与输入模态均影响安全结果。

Conclusion: 为具身智能体护栏的选择与设计提供实践指导，强调需根据场景权衡防御、可用性与效率。

Abstract: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.

</details>


### [115] [No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05401)
*Kaiyuan Deng,Yuchen Li,Gen Li,Yang Xiao,Geng Yuan,Xiaoyong Yuan,Bo Hui,Xiaolong Ma*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出AVCE框架，通过在潜在空间审计并定位概念脆弱方向，以闭式编辑和路径级审计损失实现可验证的概念擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法多在文本接口干预，仅通过给定提示的输出评估，无法发现网络中仍编码的被擦除概念；潜在空间审计表明这些概念仍可从内部表示恢复，且随擦除概念数量增加而加剧。

Method: AVCE审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向压缩为最弱几何点处的锚点；在该锚点以闭式解编辑交叉注意力和自注意力投影，随后用路径级审计损失微调两条通路，并通过正交梯度投影整合多个概念。

Result: 在SD v1.5、SDXL和Flux 1.0上针对物体、显式内容和艺术风格擦除的实验表明，AVCE较最强基线将攻击成功率降低5.07倍，审计分数提升3.84倍，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: 将擦除建立在模型潜在表示上可实现可验证的概念擦除，有效抵抗对抗提示并支持多概念场景。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [116] [Multimodal Safety Evaluation Should Measure Controllability Beyond Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06452)
*Junhyeong Park,Hanwool Lee,DongGeon Lee,Dasol Choi,Yejin Son,Haon Park,Youngjae Yu*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 论文主张多模态安全评估应超越输入输出分类，报告由表示层可检测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性和保持良性的选择性构成的可控性画像，并以隐式毒性为例在LlavaGuard和Qwen3.5上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM安全评估多依赖输入与输出层面的分类，虽有必要，但无法揭示模型内部安全状态是否可达、是否可控，即内部可读性与可控性可能存在脱节。

Method: 以隐式毒性为压力测试场景，采用稀疏特征分解，在LlavaGuard和Qwen3.5上实例化可控性画像，分别测量表示层可检测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性和良性保持选择性。

Result: LlavaGuard存在局部化操作手柄，但良性保持干预范围狭窄，下游安全增益有限；Qwen3.5具有强表示层读出能力，但在所测算子下无可比的选择性控制机制，表明内部读出与可控性可以分离。

Conclusion: 未来多模态安全基准除行为安全指标外，还应报告安全相关内部信号能否在验证的操作范围内被干预测试与控制。

Abstract: VLM safety is commonly evaluated through input- and output-level classification. Such classification is necessary, but it does not reveal whether a safety state is accessible or controllable inside the model. We argue that multimodal safety evaluation should therefore report a \emph{controllability profile} alongside behavioral classification, separating representation-level detectability, cross-modal specificity, intervention sensitivity, and benign-preserving selectivity. Using implicit toxicity as a stress case, we instantiate this profile on LlavaGuard and Qwen3.5 with sparse feature decompositions. LlavaGuard admits localized handles with a narrow benign-preserving intervention range and modest downstream safety gains, whereas Qwen3.5 supports strong representation-level readout but no comparable selective-control regime under the tested operators. These results show that internal readout and controllability can diverge. Future multimodal safety benchmarks should therefore report not only behavioral safety metrics, but also whether safety-relevant internal signals can be intervention-tested and controlled within a validated operating range.

</details>


### [117] [ANT: A Multi-Granularity Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Agents Behavior Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06514)
*Fan Li,Xiangyu Gao,Zixuan Liu,Tong Li,Chuanpu Fu,Ziqiang Wang,Ke Xu*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出ANT数据集，用于评估从网络流量中审计LLM agent行为的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织需在不检查私有用户内容的前提下审计LLM agent行为，但现有流量数据集缺少任务与阶段联合标注，无法评估流量对agent任务和操作的揭示程度。

Method: 构建ANT数据集，包含风险、场景、行为原语三种粒度的行为信息与网络流量；覆盖20个任务、5个场景、3,114个执行片段、276,417个双向流、40,049个行为原语片段（47个宏组）；使用13种代表性流量分析基线建立风险识别、场景识别和行为原语分类基准。

Result: 现有方法能恢复有用但不均衡的行为信号；在恶意工作流与良性任务相似时难以识别风险，也难以区分流量模式相似的场景；原语分类对高频、流量模式独特的宏组较可靠，对稀有或语义相似宏组较差。

Conclusion: ANT为从网络流量开展更精确的agent行为审计与取证分析提供共同基础，数据与代码已公开。

Abstract: The growing adoption of large language model (LLM) agents creates a need for network administrators and security teams to audit agent behavior within organizational networks without inspecting private user content. Network traffic offers an observable source of evidence, but how much it reveals about agent tasks and operations remains unclear. Existing traffic datasets lack the joint task and stage annotations needed to evaluate this question. We introduce ANT (Agent Network Traffic), a dataset providing agent behavior information at risk, scenario, and behavior primitive granularities alongside network traffic. ANT contains 3,114 execution episodes across 20 tasks and five scenarios, comprising 276,417 bidirectional flows and 40,049 behavior primitive segments organized into 47 macro groups. We establish a benchmark for agent risk identification, scenario recognition, and behavior primitive classification using 13 representative traffic analysis baselines. The results show that existing methods recover useful but uneven behavioral signals. They struggle to identify risk when malicious workflows resemble benign tasks and to distinguish scenarios with similar traffic patterns. Primitive classification is more reliable for frequent macro groups and those with distinctive traffic patterns than for rare or semantically similar groups. ANT provides a common basis for developing more precise auditing and forensic analysis of agent behavior from network traffic. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ant-main-suite-7BC0/.

</details>


### [118] [Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05601)
*Kaiyuan Deng,Yuchen Li,Yang Xiao,Bo Hui,Geng Yuan,Xiaolong Ma*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出Tracer框架，在未知遗忘概念集合的情况下，快速识别扩散模型中被擦除的概念并估计其数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对未学习扩散模型的攻击假设被擦除概念已知且聚焦于恢复，而实际中模型提供者不披露擦除概念，攻击者缺乏明确目标，因此需回答“哪些概念被擦除、共擦除多少”这一被忽视的问题。

Method: Tracer无需生成和分类图像，通过轻量级权重足迹谱分析在大型候选词表上高效搜索；引入足迹覆盖目标引导顺序发现多个擦除概念；通过检测候选置信度随所选概念覆盖擦除足迹而出现的急剧下降来估计擦除概念数量，无需标注样本校准，仅需轻量线性代数与有限前向探测，且不依赖遗忘算法先验知识。

Result: 在文本到图像和文本到视频骨干及多种遗忘方法上，Tracer可在数秒内识别擦除概念并估计数量，在图像和视频模型上分别较MIA和暴力搜索取得150至137,000倍和133至20,000倍加速，识别准确率显著更高。

Conclusion: Tracer能够高效、准确地发现未知的擦除概念及其数量，为未学习扩散模型的概念级审计提供了实用且无需先验的高效方案。

Abstract: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

</details>


### [119] [Square-Root Regret for Adversarial Multiplayer Bandits without Collision Information or Shared Randomness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05688)
*Chenyu Gan*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 研究无碰撞信息、无共享随机性和无外部通信信道的对抗性多人多臂老虎机问题，提出构造性通信与同步协议及慢-快学习过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多人多臂老虎机中，缺乏碰撞信息、共享随机性和外部通信信道时，玩家难以协调学习与避免碰撞，需要设计无需显式通信的协议以实现高效学习。

Method: 设计带有蒙特卡洛公共构造器的通信与同步协议，利用正奖励观测建立公共学习时间表并同步玩家；延迟通信成本计入正奖励支持集，随后采用慢-快学习过程维持有效奖励估计并交换分配与得分。

Result: 以至少1-CN^{-32}的概率（N=2Km(T+1)），固定发布输出对任意预处理后选择的无意识奖励序列同时满足期望遗憾R_T ≤ C K^{5/2}√T log^2(2Km(T+1))，其中期望基于玩家私有执行随机性。

Conclusion: 该协议在无碰撞信息、无共享随机性和无外部通信信道条件下，实现了接近最优的遗憾界，且延迟通信仅对正反馈丰富的时期产生有限遗憾。

Abstract: We study adversarial multiplayer bandits with $K$ arms and $2\le m<K$ labeled players, without collision information, shared randomness, or an external communication channel. We design a constructive communication and synchronization protocol with a Monte Carlo public constructor. With probability at least $1-CN^{-32}$ over preprocessing, where $N=2Km(T+1)$, its fixed published output satisfies \[
  R_T\le C K^{5/2}\sqrt T\log^2(2Km(T+1)) \] simultaneously for every oblivious reward sequence chosen after preprocessing. Here $R_T$ is expected regret over the players' private execution randomness. Positive reward observations establish a common learning schedule and synchronize players before learning begins. The cost of delayed communication is charged to the support of positive rewards, ensuring that periods with little useful feedback incur only limited regret. A slow--fast learning procedure then maintains valid reward estimates while assignments and scores are exchanged.

</details>


### [120] [Conditional Rank Allocation for Taxonomy-Aware Medical Language Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06765)
*Guangyuan Dong,Ziwei Hong,Xuehao Zhou,Zidong Yu,Bingchen Liu,Kehan Liu,Chuang Liu,Rong Fu,Yuchao Hou*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出参数高效方法ARBOR，通过为每个问题从共享低秩基中选择秩一组件，并利用加性门控结合问题表示、专科与操作标签及其交互，实现结构化条件适配，在多个医学问答基准上超越LoRA和MoELoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学问答涉及不同专科和临床操作，可能需要不同的适配方向；固定更新在相同活跃秩下存在近似下限，条件选择可避免该问题。

Method: ARBOR从共享低秩基中选择秩一组件；加性门控融合问题表示、专科标签、操作标签及交互；学习系数缩放适配器残差。在Qwen3-8B上于CMB、CMExam、MedQA、MedMCQA进行五种子实验。

Result: 平均准确率69.69%，分别超过LoRA r16和MoELoRA 1.26和1.30个百分点；对LoRA r16的优势随训练专科从1增至7时由0.08升至1.94个百分点；标签扰动和原子掩码支持临床路由有效性；原子聚类与专科标签对齐（调整兰德指数0.62）。

Conclusion: 结构化条件适配对医学问答有效，但临床安全性和更广泛部署尚未测试。

Abstract: Medical question answering spans specialties and clinical operations that may benefit from different adaptation directions. We propose ARBOR, a parameter-efficient method that selects rank-one components from a shared low-rank basis for each question. An additive gate combines question representations, specialty tags, operation tags, and their interaction; a learned coefficient scales the adapter residual. An illustrative separation under orthogonal, equiprobable subtasks shows how conditional selection can avoid an approximation floor faced by a fixed update with the same active rank. This result motivates the design without asserting a corresponding bound for medical corpora. On Qwen3-8B across CMB, CMExam, MedQA, and MedMCQA, five-seed experiments yield 69.69% mean accuracy across benchmarks, exceeding LoRA r16 and MoELoRA by 1.26 and 1.30 percentage points, respectively. The reported advantage over LoRA r16 increases from 0.08 to 1.94 points as training expands from one to seven specialties. Tag perturbations and atom masking support the usefulness of clinical routing, while atom clusters align with the supplied specialty labels (adjusted Rand index 0.62). Calibration, transfer, and measured costs further characterize the method. These findings support structured conditional adaptation for medical QA, while leaving clinical safety and broader deployment untested.

</details>


### [121] [Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19456)
*Sean Culatana,Kang Li*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 论文区分了向量检索中删除的“输出安全”与“遍历安全”，并提出TSD-AUDIT框架来审计和实现遍历安全删除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有向量索引的删除接口仅能阻止已删除ID出现在返回结果中，但在图遍历过程中仍会计算已删除向量的距离，导致过程级信息暴露，而传统审计方法无法检测这种风险。

Method: 形式化定义输出安全与遍历安全；提出TSD-AUDIT框架，在Faiss IndexHNSWFlat和hnswlib上审计删除路径，实施“先判存活后计算”不变量，并利用仅存活候选修复图连通性，同时生成可按删除快照独立验证的逐查询评分轨迹证书。

Result: 在Faiss IndexHNSWFlat上，原生过滤不减少距离计算次数；70%删除率下，轨迹忠实重放在所有100个审计查询中检测到已删除向量被评分。hnswlib的mark_deleted路径也存在先评分后判存活模式。在区域目标删除下，TSD-AUDIT将Recall@10比原生过滤提升4.3至42.2个百分点（删除比例0.5–0.9），随机删除下性能相当。

Conclusion: 仅审计输出删除会遗漏过程级暴露；向量检索中的删除审计必须考虑搜索过程中被评分的向量，而不仅仅是返回的标识符。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems increasingly rely on vector indexes that may retain deleted items in their search graph. Existing deletion interfaces can prevent deleted identifiers from appearing in returned results while still computing distances to their embeddings during graph traversal. We formalize this distinction as output safety versus traversal safety, and introduce TSD-AUDIT, a framework for auditing and enforcing traversal-safe deletion in graph-based approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval. On Faiss IndexHNSWFlat, native filtering leaves the number of distance computations unchanged relative to unfiltered search; at a 70% deletion rate, trace-faithful replay detects deleted-vector scoring in all 100 audited queries. Code inspection of hnswlib's mark_deleted path reveals the same scoring-before-liveness pattern. TSD-AUDIT enforces an alive-before-scoring invariant, repairs connectivity using only live candidates, and emits per-query scored-trace certificates that an independent verifier can check against the deletion snapshot. Under region-targeted deletion, TSD-AUDIT improves Recall@10 over native filtering by 4.3--42.2 percentage points across deletion fractions from 0.5 to 0.9, while remaining comparable under random deletion. These results show that output-only deletion audits can miss process-level exposure: auditing deletion in vector retrieval requires accounting for the vectors scored during search, not only the identifiers returned.

</details>


### [122] [Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05745)
*Shen Ruan,Wenchang Gao,Jin Wang,Siao Liu,Zhoxizhuoma,Dongchun Ren,Xin Zheng*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 针对后训练量化的VLA策略在环境扰动下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出PIVOT-Q框架，通过选择性纠正脆弱状态恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化虽能保持VLA在标准评估下的性能，但其在环境扰动下的鲁棒性和泛化性尚未充分探索，且量化策略可能对细微环境变化脆弱。

Method: PIVOT-Q是一种脆弱性感知的在线策略蒸馏框架，利用冻结的全精度策略作为教师，通过短时域折扣累积差异识别脆弱状态，应用阶段平衡稀疏监督和行为锚防止不必要改变。

Result: 在七个LIBERO-Plus环境变化下，跨多个VLA骨干和量化方法实现一致恢复，且在所有设置下优于全状态蒸馏，仅使用其7.4%的状态级蒸馏预算。

Conclusion: 有效的后量化恢复需要选择性干预脆弱状态而非全局蒸馏，PIVOT-Q证明了该策略的高效性和优越性。

Abstract: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

</details>


### [123] [The Arbitrary-Placement Problem in Entropy-Minimizing Selection, and a Residual-Entropy Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05925)
*Alyssa H. Shin,Claire H. Shin*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文提出残差熵D=H(p_A)-H(p_β)作为选择目标的安全准则与信息性信号，证明其与KL散度和排序一致性的精确关系，并通过路由、类不平衡及视频预测实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于香农熵的选择目标存在退化问题：最小化H(p_A)仅奖励高置信度选择，而不区分所选候选是否具有信息量。

Method: 定义残差熵D=H(p_A)-H(p_β)，其中p_β由候选信任权重诱导；证明精确恒等式D=-KL(p_A||p_β)-Δ，其中Δ衡量评分诱导分布与信任分布是否偏好相同候选；分析均匀信任、one-hot极限及中间选择区域，并推导基于领先候选margin的紧致证书；实验采用梯度混合专家路由、类不平衡重加权与生产视频预测系统。

Result: 理论上，均匀信任下D≤0自动成立，one-hot极限下D→0；中间区域当信任排序与信息量排序成对一致时D≤0，并给出margin证书。实验显示正确排序在非可互换候选且直接使用选择时提升下游性能；margin重加权在类不平衡任务中匹配或超越固定强度基线；视频预测系统MSE降低约20%并迁移至相关物种。

Conclusion: 残差熵为选择提供了安全准则，并可作为判断选择是否具有信息性的可用信号。

Abstract: Entropy-based selection objectives suffer from a fundamental degeneracy: minimizing Shannon entropy $H(p_A)$ rewards confident selection regardless of whether the selected candidate is informative. We address this limitation with the residual entropy $D = H(p_A) - H(p_β)$, where $p_β$ is induced by candidate trust weights. We prove the exact identity $D = -\mathrm{KL}(p_A\Vert p_β) - Δ$, where $Δ$ measures whether the score-induced distribution and trust profile favor the same candidates. Boundary cases establish basic safety: under uniform trust, $D\leq0$ automatically, so an equal-trust, non-starving state is never penalized, while at any one-hot limit, $D\to0$ regardless of the selected candidate. For the intermediate regime where selection occurs, we prove that $D\leq0$ when candidate ordering by trust agrees pairwise with ordering by informativeness, and derive a tighter certificate based on the leading candidate's margin over its competitors. These results are independent of the candidate-scoring function and apply to both stationary and dynamically changing information. Experiments with a gradient-based mixture-of-experts router confirm that the ordering conditions can hold during real optimization and show that correct ordering improves downstream performance when candidates are non-interchangeable and selections are used directly rather than averaged. Beyond routing, margin-based reweighting matches or outperforms fixed-strength baselines in a class-imbalance task, while informative selection in a production video-prediction system reduces MSE by approximately 20$\%$ and transfers to a related species. Residual entropy, therefore, provides a safety criterion for selection and a usable signal for deciding when that selection is informative.

</details>


### [124] [Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05969)
*Hikmet Simsir,Kutay Demiray,Ozgur S. Oguz*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出RADPO，一种无模型的安全感知扩散策略优化方法，结合预测首次命中可达性估计与累积成本预算反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略在连续控制强化学习中具有表达力强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化仍未充分探索，尤其是无需显式动力学模型而利用预测可达性信息的方法。

Method: RADPO学习折扣首次命中可达性价值，捕捉成本事件的折扣风险并赋予较早事件更大权重，以此塑造奖励；使用类似对偶的乘子根据实际回合成本与预算调整塑形强度；扩散演员通过加权去噪回归在奖励评论家评分的候选动作上改进；无需学习动力学模型、无需通过评论家计算动作梯度、也无需对反向扩散采样器求导。

Result: 在十个连续控制安全任务上，RADPO实现了有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，在多个任务上相对基线大幅减少约束违规；理论分析证明了可达性价值的性质，并表明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守替代。

Conclusion: 理论与实证分析支持将可达性与累积预算反馈相结合，是安全感知扩散策略的一条可行途径。

Abstract: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

</details>


### [125] [Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06023)
*Andrea Cavallo,Samuel Rey,Antonio G. Marques,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出PNN-Joint框架，联合估计稀疏精度矩阵与GNN权重，实现任务感知图推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PCA与VNN基于协方差矩阵，只能捕获直接与间接相关性；精度矩阵（协方差逆）能编码条件独立性，但有限样本估计不稳定且现有正则化估计器与任务无关，因此需要任务感知的图推断方法。

Method: 先提出PNN（精度神经网络），一类在精度估计器上运行的图卷积网络，建立其与PCA、VNN的谱联系并分析其对有限样本误差的稳定性；再提出PNN-Joint，通过交替优化同时估计稀疏、具统计基础的精度矩阵和GNN权重。

Result: 在合成数据、真实神经影像和运动传感器数据集上，PNN-Joint得到高度可解释的任务感知图，在低数据量下鲁棒性显著，并在真实任务中持续取得最优或次优性能。

Conclusion: PNN-Joint能有效实现任务感知的稀疏图推断，兼顾可解释性与鲁棒性，优于现有任务无关的精度估计方法。

Abstract: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.

</details>


### [126] [Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06083)
*Zexin Li,Ruili Yao,Yiming Zeng,Xiaoxue Gao*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文研究深度强化学习（DRL）中基于迁移的黑盒攻击，发现直接移植图像分类的可迁移攻击效果仅与随机噪声相当，进而提出轨迹级攻击方法，在多个设置下优于逐步攻击和随机噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DRL对抗攻击多假设白盒访问受害者策略，实际中难以满足，因此需要研究基于迁移的黑盒攻击，即利用白盒替代智能体生成观测扰动并迁移至未知受害者。

Method: 将攻击形式化为每步扰动预算下的回报最小化问题。首先测试移植FGSM、MI-FGSM和NI-FGSM等图像分类可迁移攻击的逐步目标版本；随后提出轨迹级攻击，在滚动时域上通过环境可微模型和温度平滑替代策略，使用相同优化器优化扰动序列。

Result: 在CartPole-v1上使用十个DQN和DDQN智能体、100对替代-受害者组合进行实验，轨迹级攻击在白盒、跨模型和跨算法设置中均优于逐步攻击和随机噪声。

Conclusion: 逐步迁移的图像分类攻击在DRL中效果有限，而轨迹级优化能有效提升黑盒迁移攻击的强度，表明考虑轨迹级目标和可微环境模型对DRL黑盒攻击至关重要。

Abstract: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.

</details>


### [127] [Rethinking Least-Core Computation in Contextual-Distractor Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06087)
*Hiroshi Kera,Toshinori Yamauchi,Sai Ganesh Nagarajan*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文研究最小核心归因中收益选择与联盟采样对解释的影响，并提出熵最小核心（ELC）以高效近似核仁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小核心归因因能揭示罕见高价值情境中造成重大损害的玩家而受关注，但最小核心分配通常非唯一，选择不同分配会影响解释结果，因此需要研究收益选择与联盟采样的影响并寻求高效计算方法。

Method: 通过实验考察不同选择器和联盟采样对最小核心归因的影响；提出熵最小核心（ELC），一种平滑近似方法，其唯一极小值沿温度连续路径收敛到核仁。

Result: 实验表明选择器选择对区分有用与有害贡献很重要，采样会降低有害玩家识别效果；ELC比基于线性规划的核仁求解器更快，保持小收益误差，并支持GPU加速；在完整联盟上下文干扰博弈中，ELC识别准确率与最小范数选择器相当，且对干扰项的危害排序更准确。

Conclusion: ELC在保持高效计算的同时能有效近似核仁，并在识别有害贡献方面表现良好，为最小核心归因提供了有原则且高效的选择器方案。

Abstract: Game-theoretic attribution explains a model by assigning credit to its features or training examples. The least core has attracted interest as an alternative to Shapley-style averaging because it can expose players that cause substantial harm in rare, high-value contexts. However, least-core allocations are generally nonunique, and the choice of allocation can affect the resulting explanation. In this study, we investigate how payoff selection and coalition sampling affect least-core attribution. Our experiments show that selector choice matters for distinguishing useful and harmful contributions, and that sampling can degrade harmful-player identification across the tested selectors even when useful players remain well identified. These observations motivate efficient computation with all coalition constraints and a well-defined selector. We introduce entropic least core (ELC), a smooth approximation whose unique minimizer follows a continuous path along the temperature to the nucleolus, a classical refinement of the least core. Our experiments show that ELC approximates the nucleolus faster than an LP-based nucleolus solver while retaining small payoff errors, with further GPU acceleration at larger problem sizes. In the tested full-coalition contextual-distractor games, ELC matches the minimum-norm selector in identification accuracy and more accurately ranks distractors by harm.

</details>


### [128] [Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning: How can we learn to safely control a nuclear power plant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06211)
*Perceval Beja-Battais,Alain Grosset{ê}te,Nicolas Vayatis*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该研究针对行为克隆学习控制器在工业控制中组件级精度无法保证系统级安全的问题，以压水堆负载跟踪的NMPC策略模仿为任务，提出按时间尺度分离隐空间的结构化架构，并发现将其用于热启动优化器可兼顾可行性与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业控制的学习模型常以聚合精度评估，但组件级精度嵌入系统后并不能保证安全性，尤其在具有严格安全约束的压水堆负载跟踪场景中，需要研究精度与可行性之间的差距。

Method: 在模仿专家NMPC策略的行为克隆任务上，提出一种结构化架构，将各时间尺度的变量编码到独立隐空间以反映系统物理分解，再在乘积隐空间上训练控制器模仿专家；并与共享嵌入基线进行对比，开展敏感性分析。

Result: 长时程推演中，分离嵌入相比共享嵌入基线同时提升精度与可行性；敏感性分析显示模型产生与系统物理一致的可解释表示；但无论何种架构，独立部署仍有百分之几的轨迹不可行。将所提方法用于热启动NMPC优化器而非独立动作时，可恢复完全可行性并接近最优成本，同时相对专家控制器减少约15%计算时间，在运行工况突变时减少更多。

Conclusion: 组件级精度不足以确保学习控制器在工业系统中的安全性；按时间尺度分离隐空间的结构化架构能改善精度、可行性与可解释性；将学习策略作为NMPC热启动而非独立控制器，是兼顾安全性、最优性与计算效率的有效部署方式。

Abstract: Learned models for industrial control are usually judged by aggregate accuracy, but accuracy at the component level does not guarantee safety once it is embedded in the system it is meant to serve. We study this gap on a behavior-cloning task: imitating an expert Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) policy for load-following of a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), an industrial system with tight safety constraints. We propose a structured architecture encoding variables from each timescale into separate latent spaces, reflecting the physical decomposition of the system, before training a controller to imitate the expert on the product latent space. On long-horizon rollouts, separated embeddings improve both accuracy and feasibility compared with a shared-embedding baseline. Sensitivity analysis further shows that our model yields interpretable representations aligned with the system's physics. However, standalone deployment still leaves several percent of trajectories infeasible regardless of the architecture. Using our method to warmstart the NMPC optimizer rather than acting standalone, we recover full feasibility and near-optimal cost while still cutting computation time by $\sim$15% relative to the expert controller, and even more for abrupt operating changes.

</details>


### [129] [Parameter Estimation in Machining Dynamics with Regenerative Delay and Nonsmooth Friction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06230)
*Meiyazhagan Jaganathan,Vikram Pakrashi,Aasifa Rounak*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出多域XPINN框架求解非光滑时滞微分方程，在加工动力学模型中验证其优于通用PINN，并展示逆问题参数识别的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时滞微分方程（DDE）常含非光滑性与大时滞，通用PINN（SPINN）在长时间域和非恒定历史函数下解重构与参数估计效果不佳，需更有效的分区求解策略。

Method: 将时间域按特征时滞的整数倍划分为子域，构建多域扩展物理信息神经网络（XPINN），逐子域渐进训练并冻结已学参数；以含再生效应和非光滑摩擦的加工动力学模型为对象，与SPINN对比；用高斯噪声污染的参考数据评估逆XPINN（I-XPINN）的鲁棒性。

Result: 多域XPINN在DDE解重构和参数估计上均优于SPINN，尤其在扩展时间域和非恒定历史函数下表现突出；I-XPINN对测量噪声具有韧性，物理约束引导网络准确恢复底层动力学。

Conclusion: 首次证明多域XPINN框架可有效处理含非光滑性和大时滞的DDE正逆问题，为可靠参数识别提供了新途径。

Abstract: A multi-domain eXtended Physics-Informed Neural Network (XPINN) framework is developed for nonsmooth Delay Differential Equations (DDEs). This is the first implementation to demonstrate the efficacy of partitioning the temporal domain into subdomains of integer multiples of the characteristic time delay and progressively training the associated subnetworks while freezing previously learned parameters. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated using a machining dynamics model that incorporates both regenerative and nonsmooth frictional effects. Results demonstrate that the proposed multi-domain XPINN framework leads to better solution reconstruction in DDEs and improved parameter estimation compared to a generic PINN (SPINN) formulation. The proposed method works particularly well for extended temporal domains and non-constant history functions. The robustness of inverse XPINN (I-XPINN) is also assessed using reference data contaminated with Gaussian measurement noise. Results indicate that I-XPINN remains resilient to measurement noise and the physics-informed constraints guide the network toward accurately recovering the underlying dynamics. This demonstrates, for the first time, the potential of the proposed framework for reliable parameter identification in DDEs characterised by nonsmoothness and large time delays.

</details>


### [130] [Lipschitz Thinking: Ten Years of Certifiable-by-Design Robust Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06252)
*Fabio Brau,Giorgio Piras,Maura Pintor,Battista Biggio*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该教程综述了Lipschitz有界神经网络的基本概念，阐述Lipschitz约束层的原理及其如何以单次前向传播提供鲁棒性证书，并讨论开放方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的Lipschitz性质直接衡量其对输入扰动的敏感性，显式控制该性质可限制误差传播并提升鲁棒性，从而弥合经验鲁棒性与形式化稳定性保证之间的差距。

Method: 介绍Lipschitz有界神经网络的基础概念，解释Lipschitz约束层的原理、用于强制其界限的机制，以及如何以单次前向传播的代价获得鲁棒性证书。

Result: Lipschitz有界层已被集成到表达力更强、性能更高的深度模型中，逐步缩小了经验鲁棒性与形式化设计稳定性保证之间的差距。

Conclusion: Lipschitz控制是一种提供保证性、设计稳定性的通用框架，教程最后讨论了新兴和开放的研究方向。

Abstract: The Lipschitz property of a deep neural network provides a direct measure of its sensitivity to input perturbations and, when explicitly controlled, offers a principled way to limit the propagation of errors and improve robustness. Over the past decade, Lipschitz-bounded layers have been incorporated into increasingly expressive and high-performing deep models, narrowing the gap between empirical robustness and formal, by-design guarantees of stability. This article introduces the fundamental concepts underlying Lipschitz-bounded neural networks, explaining the principles behind Lipschitz-constrained layers, the mechanisms used to enforce their bounds, and how they yield robustness certificates at the cost of a single forward pass. The tutorial concludes by discussing emerging and open directions, highlighting Lipschitz control as a general framework for offering guaranteed, by-design stability.

</details>


### [131] [Dynamic Minimax Regret Optimization for Robust LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06329)
*Chengbo Zang,Haoyu Dong,Mehmet Kerem Turkcan,Gil Zussman,Zoran Kostic,Javad Ghaderi*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 针对异构数据源下大模型后训练的动态极小极大遗憾问题，提出DUCB-OGD算法，在仅小批量老虎机反馈下实现最优遗憾界并提升最差组鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大模型训练依赖跨领域、任务、偏好分布和难度级别的异构数据源，现有方法难以在仅小批量实时反馈且不重新评估历史数据的限制下动态追踪最差数据源，导致后训练鲁棒性不足。

Method: 将训练建模为采样器-优化器双人过程：采样器用折扣上置信界（DUCB）自适应选择数据源，维护指数移动平均损失估计与基于折扣有效样本量的置信半径；优化器用在线梯度下降（OGD）更新参数。算法无需重新评估历史数据或改动标准训练流程。

Result: 对K个数据源、T步训练，证明DUCB-OGD达到动态极小极大遗憾 ˜O(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})，在对数因子内最优；在监督微调、偏好优化和强化学习实验中，算法无缝集成现代大模型训练管线，以可忽略的计算开销提升最差组鲁棒性。

Conclusion: DUCB-OGD为异构数据源下的大模型后训练提供了一种可扩展、理论最优且实用的动态鲁棒采样方案，在不增加显著开销的情况下增强最差组鲁棒性。

Abstract: Modern LLM training increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning different domains, tasks, preference distributions, and difficulty levels. We study dynamic minimax regret for group-distributionally robust LLM post-training under instantaneous mini-batch-only bandit feedback. The framework views the training as a two-player sampler-optimizer process: a sampler adaptively selects among data sources using bandit feedback, while an optimizer updates the model parameters using stochastic gradients from the selected source. We focus on the practically restrictive setting where source losses evolve with model training but historical data are not re-evaluated, requiring the sampler to track instantaneous worst-sources from stale partial feedback. We propose DUCB-OGD, a simple and scalable algorithm that couples a Discounted Upper-Confidence-Bound sampler with an Online Gradient Descent optimizer. The sampler maintains exponential moving average loss estimates and confidence radii based on discounted effective sample sizes, avoiding costly re-evaluation of past data or intrusive changes to standard training pipelines. For $K$ data sources and $T$ training steps, we prove that DUCB-OGD achieves a dynamic minimax regret of $\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$, which is optimal up to logarithmic factors for the undiscounted objective under our feedback model. Extensive experiments across supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning show that DUCB-OGD integrates seamlessly into modern LLM training pipelines and improves worst-group robustness with negligible computational overhead compared with standard sampling baselines.

</details>


### [132] [Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06851)
*Sophie L. Wang,Amil Dravid,Rulin Shao,Kevin Farhat,Sewon Min,Alexei A. Efros*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 研究训练数据如何使基座模型响应起始标记与后续推理行为形成关联，并证明固定特定起始标记可媲美强化学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究基座模型中起始标记触发推理行为的机制，以及训练数据在此关联形成中的作用。

Method: 通过固定起始标记提示基座模型，并与RL训练模型对比；进行因果数据干预，将任意词转化为有效推理线索或移除现有线索效果；分析不同线索诱导的隐藏状态与训练文档类型的相关性；并以安全案例研究不同线索引发的拒绝与合规行为。

Result: 固定线索如'.\n\nOkay'使Olmo-3-7B在MATH-500上pass@1从42%升至78%，'Alright,'使Qwen3-14B从72%升至87%；RL使这些线索更可能，固定它们可恢复大部分性能增益；干预可将'chicken'变为有效线索或消除现有线索效果；'Think duck duck goose'与'Think step by step'诱导推理效果相当；隐藏状态与训练文档类型相关；安全案例中不同线索引发不同拒绝/合规行为。

Conclusion: 训练数据塑造了起始标记与推理行为间的关联，固定线索可显著提升基座模型性能，且线索效应可追溯至训练数据，扩展至安全行为。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

</details>

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Llama 3系列基础模型，包括一个405B参数的密集Transformer模型，支持多语言、编码、推理和工具使用，并公开了预训练和后训练版本及安全模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统依赖基础模型，需要构建性能与领先模型相当且支持多种能力的基础模型。

Method: 提出Llama 3系列语言模型，最大模型为405B参数、128K上下文窗口的密集Transformer；进行广泛实证评估；通过组合方法集成图像、视频和语音能力。

Result: Llama 3在大量任务上质量与GPT-4等领先模型相当；组合方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上达到与最先进技术竞争的性能；公开了405B模型及Llama Guard 3。

Conclusion: Llama 3是性能强大的公开基础模型，多模态扩展具有竞争力但仍处于开发阶段，未广泛发布。

Abstract: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are powered by foundation models. This paper presents a new set of foundation models, called Llama 3. It is a herd of language models that natively support multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage. Our largest model is a dense Transformer with 405B parameters and a context window of up to 128K tokens. This paper presents an extensive empirical evaluation of Llama 3. We find that Llama 3 delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks. We publicly release Llama 3, including pre-trained and post-trained versions of the 405B parameter language model and our Llama Guard 3 model for input and output safety. The paper also presents the results of experiments in which we integrate image, video, and speech capabilities into Llama 3 via a compositional approach. We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks. The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development.

</details>

### [134] [Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03812)
*Weiu-qiou Ciang,Yuzhou Hong,Sherry Chen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该文比较了时间序列预测中两种最小二乘表示学习目标：直接优化最终预测坐标的"预测程序"与先回归下一隐向量再冻结编码器加预测头的"表示损失程序"（如LeNEPA），并分析二者差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 明确预测导向的表示损失与最终预测评分目标是否一致，揭示在低秩瓶颈下回归下一隐向量可能偏离实际预测目标。

Method: 将两种程序形式化为同一瓶颈上的最小二乘问题：预测程序最小化解码隐向量在报告坐标上的误差；表示损失程序在固定秩下拟合完整下一向量后冻结编码器并附加预测头。用线性解码器和四维序列（后三维相同自回归）进行解析与数值对比。

Result: 标量目标加线性解码器时，任意秩≥1的隐表示均等价于普通最小二乘，各向同性约束经解码器重拟合后仅为重缩放。四维序列中，秩1向量拟合将0.9998质量放在重复坐标上，剩余信号预测为边际方差2.794；预测程序将质量1放在信号上，匹配新息方差0.992。秩2时两程序一致。以拟合的一步系数0.803迭代，开环误差从一步0.992升至八步2.700。

Conclusion: 回归下一隐向量的表示损失并非总与预测目标一致；在低秩瓶颈下会将容量分配给与预测无关的方向，导致预测偏差与开环误差放大，秩不足时尤其明显。

Abstract: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

</details>


### [135] [Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03831)
*Ioannis Tsiokos*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 学习上层任务B会使循环网络仅局部地习得下层任务A，形成锯齿状能力，部分解释系统性能不均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究能力强的系统为何出现锯齿状表现（平均误差低但特定输入失败），在由已知两层构成的任务中定位原因。

Method: 构建两层任务：下层A从记录计算五个槽和，上层B利用槽1和与历史模式预测下一板类别（B严格扩展A）；用小型循环网络训练B，并通过线性探针和监督输出测量其对A的习得；另设匹配实验比较显式训练A、连接学习到的A、输入表示（one-hot/数值）、梯度阻断等条件。

Result: B训练使A呈锯齿状：槽1探针可读性97-98%，其他槽仅5-10%；类别误读集中在槽1截断附近；显式训练A也仅近似正确；B的KL低于3e-4比特但构造历史上最大TV约0.25；连接学习到的A使误读减少1.3-17倍；精确A以one-hot输入误读0-2，数值输入10-317；一次B更新使精确A不精确（除非阻断B梯度）；精确A仍留下部分B失败。

Conclusion: 下层理论的习得、访问与保持不均部分解释了学习其上理论的网络的锯齿状能力，但部分失败仍无法解释；该现象是否在更大系统中成立有待检验。

Abstract: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

</details>


### [136] [SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04008)
*Yuxuan Liu,Haoran Li,Yuhao Zhang,Jiahe Guo,Hongyu Luo,Wenbin Hu,Huihao Jing,Kawai Chung,Junle Chen,Changxuan Fan,Qing Zong,Lingyun Xie,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillScriptBench基准，系统区分文档修复、脚本修复与保持能力，并引入AST引导的修订方法提升LLM智能体技能修复成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准未系统区分技能自进化中文档修复、脚本修复与保持正确行为的能力，导致难以评估不同修订策略的优劣。

Method: 从超35,000个GitHub Skill根中选取100个包构建150个修复任务（含脚本故障、维护请求与执行检查），另设200个受控任务在四种状态下评估；并提出AST-Guided Skill Revision，利用抽象语法树与调用关系将维护需求映射到代码位置，限制脚本编辑并同步更新文档。

Result: 四种LLM中，同时编辑文档与脚本的方法能修复脚本故障，但在文档修复或保持上未稳定优于仅Markdown修订；AST引导方法平均取得修复成功率绝对提升：Raw Package 21.9%、CoEvoSkills 27.7%；三次运行均成功的任务比例提升20.8%与31.5%。

Conclusion: AST引导的技能修订能更精准定位代码并同步文档，显著提高修复成功率与跨运行一致性，表明结构化代码理解对技能自进化至关重要。

Abstract: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.

</details>


### [137] [Fully Homomorphic Encryption for Statistical Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04163)
*Balasubramanian Narasimhan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文展示了在R语言中通过两个包（openfhe.R和homomorpheR）实现全同态加密下的可复现联合分析，并给出分布式Cox回归和联邦Cox-lasso的验证案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合作方或站点无法共享数据记录或计算摘要，但仍需进行联合分析；需要一种可复现、实用的全同态加密协议来支持R平台上的统计计算。

Method: 开发openfhe.R（封装OpenFHE C++库，支持BFV/BGV、CKKS、布尔电路和多密钥生成）和homomorpheR（提供主/工作节点原语）；在函数值边界上组合加密算术层，要求跨越边界的量可分解为各站点求和；采用诚实但好奇模型和门限密钥生成。

Result: 通过两个验证研究：分布式分层Cox回归（stats4::mle()通过加密通道收敛）和联邦Cox-lasso（使用共识ADMM，仅跨站点更新加密）；还讨论了联邦相似性检索和双方预测。

Conclusion: 所提方法可在R中实现全同态加密下的联合分析，门限密钥生成消除了单一节点持有可用密钥的假设，适用于诚实但好奇场景。

Abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption allows arithmetic to be carried out on encrypted values, so that a party performing a computation need not see the data it operates on. This is useful wherever collaborating parties or sites cannot share data records or computed summaries yet need to do a joint analysis. We demonstrate the protocols needed to perform such analyses reproducibly via two packages in R, a platform widely used for applied statistics. The first, openfhe.R, is an interface to the OpenFHE C++ library, which exposes exact integer arithmetic (BFV, BGV), approximate real-valued arithmetic (CKKS), Boolean circuits, and multiparty key generation. The second is homomorpheR, which builds a small set of master/worker primitives for multi-party protocols on top of the first. Together, the two let an ordinary R statistical routine compose with an encrypted-arithmetic layer at the function-value boundary, provided the quantity crossing that boundary decomposes as a sum over sites. Two validation studies are presented: distributed stratified Cox regression, where stats4::mle() converges through an encrypted channel, and federated Cox-lasso via convex optimization using consensus ADMM, where the cross-site update is the only encrypted step. We also discuss federated similarity retrieval and two-party prediction. Throughout, the parties are assumed honest-but-curious, and threshold key generation removes the assumption that any single party holds a usable secret key.

</details>


### [138] [The Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating: A Framework for Disclosing Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04021)
*Imène Goumiri,Mayleen Cortez-Rodriguez,Eric Bell,Amanda Muyskens*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出REAL评级框架，用六级量表披露AI在产品创作与用户体验中的参与程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有溯源标准与披露方法多依赖二元分类或缺乏用户清晰度的技术水印，无法反映AI不同使用方式带来的不同风险与结果。

Method: 设计REAL（Reported Engagement with AI Level）评级框架，包含0-5六个等级，并详述其结构方法论及在文本、图像、音频、视频和软件产品中的具体应用。

Result: 该框架可系统性地披露AI在产品创建和用户体验两方面的参与程度。

Conclusion: REAL评级为AI参与数字媒体与生产流程提供了更细粒度、用户可理解的披露方案。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence has become increasingly incorporated into digital media and more generally into production workflows with which the public frequently interacts. Current provenance standards and disclosure methods frequently rely on binary categorizations, differentiating only between entirely human-authored and AI-generated content, or depend on technical watermarking that lacks user-facing clarity. However, there are very different risks and outcomes depending on the different uses of AI in the creation and consumption of end products. Therefore, we propose the Reported Engagement with AI Level (REAL) Rating framework which addresses these concerns by introducing a six-tier scale (Levels 0-5) that discloses the extent of AI involvement in both product creation and user experience. This paper details the structural methodology of the REAL Rating system and the specifics of its application across text, image, audio, video, and software products.

</details>


### [139] [Slaying the Hydra: Interaction-Aware Circuit Discovery in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04017)
*Sankaran Vaidyanathan,Rafal Urbaniak,Emily Bunnapradist,Michelangelo Naim,Daniel Waxman*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出WISE因果估计量与JuntaLearner梯度电路发现方法，在可计算前提下建模组件间集合级交互，用于语言模型机制可解释性中的组件排序与电路识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐组件打分忽略上下文依赖效应，主要组件可能抑制备份组件激活，导致排序失真；实际因果的witness机制虽能刻画此类交互，但需组合枚举，实际不可行。

Method: 定义witness-integrated set effect（WISE）因果估计量族，对原因集合与witness集合取期望以保持可计算性；据此提出JuntaLearner，基于梯度学习在不同规模组件与witness集合下按因果影响对组件排序；同时引入必要性、任务特异性指标及circuit recognition score（CRS）汇总各指标在电路规模上的表现并强调小电路效应。

Result: 在规模递增的多种任务与模型上，JuntaLearner在所有指标上的平均CRS均高于归因基线方法；其开销不随候选组件数量增长，可扩展至大模型。

Conclusion: JuntaLearner在考虑集合级交互、避免一阶近似的同时实现可扩展的电路发现，优于现有归因基线。

Abstract: Localizing behavior to individual components of a language model is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. However, scoring components one at a time misses context-dependent effects: a primary component can inhibit the activation of a backup, leading to issues with ranking components. Actual causality studies the structure of such interactions via witnesses: variables that provide contextual information to resolve interaction terms. However, estimation with witnesses typically requires combinatorial enumeration and is infeasible in practice. We introduce the witness-integrated set effect (WISE), a family of causal estimands that build on the witness mechanism while taking expectations over sets of causes and witnesses to remain computationally feasible. Building on this approach, we introduce JuntaLearner, a gradient-based circuit discovery method that learns to rank components by their causal impact across varying-sized sets of components and witnesses. Alongside faithfulness metrics, we introduce measures of necessity and task specificity, and the circuit recognition score (CRS) to summarize each metric across circuit sizes while emphasizing effects achieved by small circuits. Across tasks and models of increasing size, JuntaLearner achieves higher mean CRS compared to attribution baselines on all metrics. Since its cost does not grow with the number of candidate components, JuntaLearner scales to large models while accounting for set-level interactions and avoiding first-order approximations.

</details>


### [140] [LD-EnFF: Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filtering for Data Assimilation with Sparse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04034)
*Ziyu Tian,Kaichen Shen,Wenbo Hao,Phillip Si,Peng Chen,Wei Zhu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出LD-EnFF潜空间集合流滤波框架，在紧凑潜空间中完成预测传播与滤波更新，以应对高维非线性与稀疏观测的数据同化难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据同化方法面临两大挑战：高维非线性动力学导致重复前向模拟计算昂贵；稀疏观测对全状态提供的信息有限。

Method: LD-EnFF将潜动力学代理模型用于集合传播，并结合基于VAE的观测模型在潜空间评估状态相关的观测似然；每步同化时，采用基于流匹配的集合滤波更新，利用预测集合与似然生成后验样本，联合更新潜状态与不确定参数，从而避免预测阶段的重复全状态模拟和似然评估中的全场重构。

Result: 在Kolmogorov流、海啸传播和大气建模等具有复杂动力学及稀疏噪声观测的基准上，LD-EnFF显著优于多种数据同化算法。

Conclusion: 在潜空间中进行集合传播与流匹配滤波更新，可有效缓解高维模拟与稀疏观测的双重瓶颈，并在多类复杂动力系统上取得优越的同化性能。

Abstract: Data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy, incomplete observations to estimate the evolving state of a dynamical system. Existing methods face two compounding challenges: high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics make repeated forward simulation computationally expensive, while sparse observations provide limited direct information about the full state. To address these challenges, we propose the Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filter (LD-EnFF), a sequential Bayesian filtering framework that performs both forecast propagation and filtering updates in a compact latent space. LD-EnFF combines a latent dynamics surrogate for ensemble propagation with a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based observation model that evaluates a state-dependent observation likelihood in latent space. At each assimilation step, an ensemble filtering update based on flow matching uses the forecast ensemble and this likelihood to generate posterior samples, jointly updating latent states and uncertain parameters. This design avoids repeated full-state simulation during forecasting and full-field reconstruction during likelihood evaluation. LD-EnFF substantially outperforms a broad range of data assimilation algorithms on benchmarks spanning Kolmogorov flow, tsunami propagation, and atmospheric modeling, all featuring complex dynamics and sparse, noisy observations.

</details>


### [141] [Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04071)
*Thanushi Withanage,Carol Espy-Wilson,Elizabeth Redcay,Desi Jones,Noah Sasson*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种说话人无关框架，利用声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，量化自闭症与非自闭症成人自发对话中的发音同步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自发对话中发音同步研究不足，尤其针对自闭症说话者；以往多采用任务式、音素级和侵入式测量。

Method: 采用声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，构建说话人无关框架，分析自闭症、非自闭症及混合二元组在互动中的发音协调时间变化。

Result: 非自闭症二元组随时间协调复杂度增加且同步更强，自闭症二元组效果中等，混合二元组对齐最弱；发音同步更强与自评对话成功度更高相关。

Conclusion: 协调复杂度增加可作为有效社会互动的标志，发音同步与对话成功相关。

Abstract: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics.
