Abstract: AI agents can now carry out data-driven scientific analyses end to end, and benchmarks assess them by giving an agent a question and a dataset and scoring its final answer against a fixed key. These benchmarks assume that a correct answer was derived from the supplied data, a property we call evidence grounding. However, an agent can also reach the key from prior knowledge or by ruling out the other options, and a score based on a single run cannot tell these cases apart. We show how to test this assumption and find that it often fails. For each question, we build versions of its data files in which the evidence for the answer is left intact, withdrawn or reversed, check each edit with a pre-registered reference statistic, and run the same agent on every version. We then measure evidence-grounded accuracy, which credits a correct answer only if the agent also responds when the evidence is withdrawn and follows it when it is reversed. We evaluate three agent scaffolds and five models on 18 single-cell questions from BAISBench and four synthetic problems from GeneBench-Pro. On the single-cell questions, the Claude agents are 95% accurate and answer 83% correctly without any data, but their evidence-grounded accuracy is only 41%. Hiding gene names raises the share of runs that follow reversed evidence from 58% to 93% on ten gene tasks, suggesting that prior knowledge competes with the supplied data. The benchmark score and LLM judges can also reward answers that ignore the changed evidence. Measuring scientific intelligence rather than recall therefore requires checking whether answers follow the evidence and whether scores reward them for it.

</details>


### [180] [Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04907)
*Luoyu Chen,Xiaoyu Ding,Weiqi Wang,Chenhan Zhang,Zhiyi Tian,Jianhuan Huang,Shui Yu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究潜隐学习（subliminal learning）中数据需求量的来源，发现软监督比硬监督能更高效地恢复教师行为特征向量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发表的潜隐学习演示通常需要数万个载体示例，作者希望探究这一数据需求背后的原因。

Method: 以潜隐引导（subliminal steering）为测试平台，教师特征为已知的残差流向量Δ_T。在相同载体前缀下，比较token级（硬）NLL监督与全分布（软）KL监督，并将引导向量蒸馏建模为带噪线性逆问题，用Fisher矩阵分析梯度方向与恢复过程。

Result: 软监督仅需几百个载体即可几乎精确恢复Δ_T，而硬监督即使数万载体也远低于此。实验在Qwen2.5-7B和Gemma-2-9B上验证了四个预测：初始梯度的Fisher畸变、从陡峭到平坦方向的恢复顺序、最优深度随数据规模移动、以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示效果相同。

Conclusion: 在此设定下，大规模载体数据集的主要作用不是揭示特征，而是抑制Fisher逆变换放大的标签噪声；软监督能更高效地恢复低曲率方向。

Abstract: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

</details>


### [181] [Why, Where, How: Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding for Code Repair in NL2SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05060)
*Suchan Lee,Woomin Song,Hwanjo Yu,Sangwoo Mo*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出TEG方法，利用错误分类诊断将错误类型映射为结构编辑操作，通过掩码和编辑指令指导NL2SQL查询纠正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NL2SQL纠错方法虽能通过反馈、错误报告或生成计划指导修正，但仅说明错误原因而不指明需修改的查询结构及具体编辑方式。

Method: TEG根据错误类型规则映射到需重新考虑的构造类和编辑操作；对查询中选定构造进行掩码，并在编辑指令中说明操作；生成候选修正，利用执行反馈选择候选，对多错误查询逐个标注迭代处理。

Result: 在NL2SQL-BUGs上，TEG使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct达到单错误执行准确率47.3、整体准确率37.0；在评估的模型规模和思考模式下，单错误查询上优于所有基线（即使基线获得相同错误类型标注）；使用预测类型时，单错误查询上仍优于直接LLM纠错和ErrorLLM。

Conclusion: TEG通过将错误分类诊断转化为结构化修正输入，有效提升了NL2SQL查询纠错的准确率，尤其在单错误查询上表现突出，且对预测错误类型具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: SQL queries that large language models write from natural language questions can execute successfully yet produce incorrect results, so execution alone does not reveal what to fix. An error taxonomy says why the query is wrong, but not where to look or how to change it. Existing methods can guide SQL correction through feedback, error reports, or generated plans alongside an unmasked query. We introduce TEG(Taxonomy-guided Error Grounding), which turns a supplied diagnosis into a structured correction input for natural language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) correction. Type-specific rules map each error type to construct classes to reconsider and an edit operation to request. TEG masks the selected constructs in the query when applicable and states that operation in an edit instruction. TEG generates candidate corrections from this input, uses execution feedback to guide candidate selection, and repeats the process one annotation at a time for queries with several errors. On NL2SQL-BUGs, TEG reaches 47.3 single-error execution accuracy and 37.0 overall with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across the model sizes and thinking modes evaluated in the main comparison, TEG outperforms all evaluated baselines on single-error queries, even when the baselines receive the same error-type annotations. With predicted types, TEG stays above direct LLM correction and ErrorLLM on single-error queries.

</details>


### [182] [Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04940)
*Tongli Su,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao,Bowen Zhu,JayaSai Somasundaram,Hasibul Haque*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过探索、学习、行动三阶段预测代码变更的爆炸集（将破坏的下游组件）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体可能安全修改某仓库却静默破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储；每次动作后穷举集成测试不现实，需在执行前预测失败。现有软件世界模型仅预测智能体自身观测，静态变更影响分析仅识别传播范围。

Method: SWM分为三阶段：探索——从恢复的系统状态执行候选变更，优先关注观测失败与依赖图矛盾的区域；学习——在这些执行结果上微调语言模型以预测下游破坏；行动——将采样预测转化为每个消费者的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移及决定是否值得再执行一次。

Result: 在留出合成系统上，SWM将爆炸集F1从静态可达性的0.431提升至0.571±0.037，排名后悔减半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点改善迁移回报。可达性在图中表示的依赖上更强，SWM则恢复图遗漏耦合所致的失败，二者互补。在留出真实库上进一步表明，预测结构化失败结果（而非仅标量风险）对下游决策质量很重要。

Conclusion: SWM通过建模更广泛的受影响系统并预测爆炸集，能有效预测代码变更导致的下游破坏，与静态可达性互补，且结构化失败预测对决策质量至关重要。

Abstract: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

</details>


### [183] [Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04976)
*Kaiyue Wen,Tengyu Ma,Percy Liang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出Priced Guidance框架，通过压缩成本量化语言模型生成未来研究想法核心的概率下界，并在87篇深度学习论文核心想法上评测五个生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接估计语言模型无提示生成未来研究想法这一极小概率需要高昂的重复采样成本，因此希望用压缩成本作为该概率的可计算代理指标。

Method: 生成器（语言模型）针对目标想法提出一系列多选题并给出答案概率分布，向导（可访问目标想法的语言模型）选择答案；若被选答案先验概率为p，生成器支付-log2 p比特。累积成本（至多加常数）等于向导传递的信息比特数。理论上证明：若期望至多K比特引导即可恢复目标想法，则无引导生成该想法的概率至少为2^{-K}。

Result: 在87篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上，用LLM作为评判判断生成想法是否在中心研究对象和定义机制上匹配目标。Fable 5.1取得最低中位压缩成本69.9比特，远低于gzip无损压缩目标想法摘要的5,712比特；Fable 5.1、Opus 5与Astra的均匀集成将中位成本进一步降至55.8比特，并将生成概率下界提升18,000倍。

Conclusion: 压缩成本可有效下界语言模型无提示生成未来研究想法核心的概率，集成多个模型能显著降低所需引导信息量并大幅提高生成概率下界。

Abstract: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

</details>


### [184] [Image Synthesis as an Intermediate for Controllable Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05211)
*Haochen Yuan,Jing Xie,Yunbo Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出VisualBridge，利用时序图作为视觉中间桥梁，将语言语义转化为数值序列，以改进少样本预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义驱动的时序生成有望提升少样本预测，但直接从语言生成数值序列难以保持预期的时序结构。

Method: 用MLLM将绘制的时序图转换为结构化语义表示，显式控制趋势、季节性和波动性；学习语义编辑策略并以下游预测奖励优化；再用时序VAE生成一致的多变量增强序列。

Result: 在标准公共预测基准上，VisualBridge优于传统增强方法，消融实验验证了视觉语义接地、学习语义控制和VAE生成的作用。

Conclusion: VisualBridge通过视觉语义桥梁有效生成有益于下游任务的时序增强数据，提升少样本预测性能。

Abstract: Semantic-driven time-series generation offers a promising way to improve downstream learning in few-shot forecasting, but directly generating numerical sequences from language often fails to preserve the intended temporal structure. We propose VisualBridge, which uses time-series plots as a visual intermediate to bridge high-level temporal semantics and numerical sequences. An MLLM first converts plotted series into structured semantic representations, enabling explicit control over temporal properties such as trend, seasonality, and volatility. We then learn a semantic editing policy with downstream forecasting rewards, allowing the generation process to favor temporal patterns that are beneficial for the target task. The resulting sequences are further modeled by a temporal VAE to produce consistent multivariate augmentations. Experiments on standard public forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that VisualBridge improves few-shot forecasting over conventional augmentation methods, with ablations validating the roles of visual semantic grounding, learned semantic control, and VAE-based generation.

</details>


### [185] [Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04997)
*Shuze Daniel Liu,Claire Chen,Jiuqi Wang,David Simchi-Levi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究具有公开与私有信息的两玩家零和情境博弈中的离线学习，提出单边规范集中度并给出悲观算法及其可解释性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受拍卖、谈判等具有私有估值的策略场景启发，研究非对称信息如何通过影响均衡行为改变离线覆盖，填补公开-私有信息约束下离线均衡学习的理论空白。

Method: 提出单边规范集中度（unilateral prescriptive concentrability）；针对有限状态-动作空间设计悲观算法；进一步提出悲观策略镜像下降框架PPA-PMD，用于一般函数逼近并支持无遗憾的演员更新。

Result: 有限状态-动作空间下算法达到$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$可解释性率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖匹配；一般函数逼近下PPA-PMD获得统一的$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$可解释性率。

Conclusion: 这些结果共同提供了公开-私有信息约束下离线均衡学习的首个理论框架。

Abstract: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

</details>


### [186] [MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05014)
*Xueyi Chen,Shiyu Liu,Xin Jin,Yuhua Zheng,Xin Li,Haolei Bai,Junhan Zhu,Huan Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出 MetaKernelBench，用于衡量内核优化智能体从一种 DSL 蒸馏的经验能否迁移到另一 DSL 的同一问题，并量化其收益与风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GPU 内核优化智能体保留知识库或蒸馏技能，但内核基准仅评估每次尝试的正确性与速度，未衡量所保留经验的复用价值。

Method: 构建 74 个融合子图问题（6 个家族），每个问题以 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 两种仅 DSL 不同的变体配对。智能体先单独尝试各变体并蒸馏为自然语言技能，无论源尝试是否通过验证；该技能作为唯一额外输入，用于同一模型在另一 DSL 上的技能条件尝试，并在匹配的每次尝试预算下与单独尝试比较正确性与端到端运行时。

Result: 在 6 个模型和两个方向上，技能条件尝试相对单独尝试的配对提升范围为 -19% 至 +29%；4 个模型在两个方向均获益，但每个模型和方向均有 16% 至 45% 的问题出现回退。结果取决于源尝试相对目标单独尝试的表现，而非仅源是否成功：当源高于目标时 71% 的比较改善，当源低于目标时 54% 回退。

Conclusion: MetaKernelBench 通过度量同问题跨 DSL 的内核知识迁移，补充了实现质量指标。

Abstract: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [187] [Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05017)
*Mathieu Pont,Christoph Garth*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种事后操作抽象，统一刻画学习表示中的概念及其关系，并以拓扑结构紧凑编码，支持共享优化框架下的概念编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念编辑方法多针对特定干预，缺乏通用且可编辑的概念组织表示，难以统一不同概念级操作。

Method: TCR从概念可恢复性和交互得分构建中间概念空间，用拓扑编码其组织；干预通过修改该抽象并反向传播到原学习表示，实现概念组织与实现机制分离。

Result: TCR具有稳定性和重参数化不变性，与已有概念编辑公式相关联；用于解耦预处理时，在概念泄漏相当情况下最差组准确率平均提升21.89；用于师生概念迁移时，概念可恢复性最高提升5.54，同时保持或提升测试top-1准确率。

Conclusion: TCR为概念组织提供通用、可编辑的表示，统一多种概念级操作，并在解耦和概念迁移任务中验证有效性。

Abstract: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.

</details>


### [188] [How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05077)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文通过大量仿真实验检验了执行假设（订单成交方式）是否不仅改变LLM交易智能体的报告收益，还会改变其排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM交易智能体的回测常假设所有订单按收盘价成交，作者质疑这一执行约定是否会影响智能体排名，而不仅是收益数值。

Method: 使用五个提示式LLM信号策略和七个经典基线，在相同合成价格路径上运行六种执行设置（从近理想成交到延迟、价差、参与率和冲击压力）；主实验包含2,462次运行，匹配决策频率并配对市场路径。

Result: 在双资产高波动场景下，近理想与默认压力排名一致性降至Kendall τ_b=0.21（平静场景为0.82），自助法区间宽且重叠；在固定11策略板上，一致性从双资产的0.24升至十资产的0.85；排名变化与换手率相关，且与买入持有基准的比较也受其初始化方式影响。

Conclusion: 该实验不比较LLM交易能力，而是表明在短周期内执行约定可能成为基准的核心结论；执行假设与排名稳定性应与收益一并报告。

Abstract: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

</details>


### [189] [Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05098)
*Nodens Koren,Thomas Hofmann,Georgios Kissas*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出Advectra，一种传输感知的潜在神经算子，通过可运动参考系与几何感知排序，提升对流主导系统的建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在神经算子用固定或共享的投影权重，难以建模相干结构相对固定坐标系移动的传输主导系统。

Method: 引入正则化运动学坐标映射解耦源与目标坐标系，得到近似共动潜在参考系，实现非对称特征聚合与重构，并结合状态空间模型的几何感知排序机制。

Result: 在对流主导基准（Navier-Stokes被动标量传输、Rayleigh-Taylor不稳定性）上优于几何约束与无形式基线，并在真实工程任务上展现强泛化。

Conclusion: 显式移动参考系结构对非平稳物理的神经算子建模具有显著收益。

Abstract: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.

</details>


### [190] [What Does Fréchet Distance Measure? A Directional Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05518)
*Yunghee Lee,Jaeyeon Kim*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出方向Fréchet距离以分解生成模型评估中的差异来源，并解释FID/FVD等指标背后的语义偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Fréchet距离如FID/FVD以单一标量概括生成分布与参考分布的差异，但该标量视角掩盖了差异的具体来源，例如扩散采样步数增加会提升ImageReward却恶化FID。

Method: 引入方向Fréchet距离，定义为最优传输位移在给定方向上的期望平方投影，将总距离分解到可解释的方向上。

Result: 在图像、视频和蛋白质案例中，发现少量可解释方向贡献了大部分距离；利用这些方向基于CLIP嵌入解释FID增长、量化FVD对逐帧外观的偏好，并重新审视Protein FID的解释。

Conclusion: 方向Fréchet距离提升了Fréchet距离的可解释性，能揭示生成模型评估指标背后的语义因素，代码已开源。

Abstract: The Fréchet distance is a de facto standard for evaluating generative models across domains, appearing as FID for images and FVD for videos. It summarizes the discrepancy between generated and reference distributions in a single scalar, with lower values typically interpreted as better generation quality. However, this scalar view can obscure what drives the comparison. For example, in COCO dataset, increasing the number of diffusion sampling steps improves ImageReward scores yet worsens (increases) FID. Motivated by this mismatch, we seek to make the Fréchet distance more interpretable by uncovering where the discrepancy lies. To this end, we introduce directional Fréchet distance, the expected squared projection of the optimal transport displacement onto a given direction. Across our image, video, and protein case studies, we find that a small number of interpretable directions account for much of the distance. We use these directions to explain the FID increase in terms of semantic concepts represented by CLIP embeddings, quantify FVD's bias toward per-frame appearance, and revisit the interpretation of Protein FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/yhlee-add/directional-fd.

</details>


### [191] [DelegationBench: Measuring When AI Agents Should Ask Before Acting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05532)
*Shiva Pochampally*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文提出DelegationBench基准，揭示AI代理在决定自主行动或请求用户确认时，现有单一一致性评分不可靠，存在三种误导模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理需判断何时自主行动、何时询问用户，当前用模型对提议动作与人工标签的一致性评分来评估，但该评分可能不可信。

Method: 构建包含156个场景、四种响应（行动、请求许可、请求缺失信息、拒绝）的基准，多数场景为仅改变单一特征的匹配对（是否被请求、风险、可逆性、可见性），评估五个家族共十个模型。

Result: 一致性评分存在三种误导：简单关键词规则比八个模型更符合标注者但仅改变48个匹配对中的9个；同一问题的等价表述使模型行动率变化达52.5个百分点；模型用工具执行任务时比判断提议动作时更少询问用户。明确陈述规则时模型几乎完美遵循。

Conclusion: 建议分别报告这些属性而非合并为单一评分，并发布基准与评估工具。

Abstract: AI agents that send emails, edit files, and make purchases must decide when to act on their own and when to check with the user first. This decision is usually evaluated by showing a model a proposed action, asking whether it should proceed, and scoring agreement with human labels. We introduce DelegationBench to test whether such scores can be trusted. It has 156 scenarios with four possible responses (act, ask for permission, ask for missing information, refuse), and most scenarios come in matched pairs that change a single feature: whether the action was requested, what is at stake, whether it can be undone, or who will see it. Across ten models from five families, agreement scores mislead in three ways. A simple keyword rule, which we wrote after seeing the benchmark, agrees with our annotators more often than eight of the models, yet its decision changes in only 9 of 48 matched pairs. Equivalent ways of asking the same question change how often a model acts by up to 52.5 percentage points. And every model stops to ask the user less often when it must carry out the task with tools than when it judges a proposed action. When rules are stated explicitly, the same models follow them almost perfectly, so the gaps are not explained by a general inability to follow rules. We release the benchmark and evaluation tools and recommend reporting these properties separately rather than as one score.

</details>


### [192] [Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05220)
*Takuma Yasuda,Atsuyoshi Nakamura*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文研究旋转木马界面下的排序多臂老虎机问题，利用用户浏览深度信号区分已展示未点击与未展示物品，提出三种算法并验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统排序老虎机模型（如级联和基于位置的模型）通常将用户检查视为潜在变量，无法区分已展示但未点击的物品与从未展示的物品；而旋转木马界面可直接观察用户浏览深度，提供了更丰富的反馈信号，因此需要针对该场景设计新的算法。

Method: 将问题建模为排序老虎机：学习器展示L个物品的列表，观察用户最大浏览深度，仅在该深度内接收点击反馈；目标是在未知物品吸引力向量和浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击数。提出基于UCB、汤普森采样和DMED的三种算法，均仅利用观测到的曝光更新物品统计量。

Result: 推导了UCB算法的实例相关对数上界，以及DMED算法的渐近上界，该上界在参数α↓0时与下界重合，证明渐近最优性。在合成浅层和深层浏览环境及基于RecGaze交互日志的实验中，OD-TS最终平均遗憾与PBM-TS相似，而所提方法均低于PBM-UCB的最终平均遗憾。

Conclusion: 所提算法能有效利用浏览深度信号，在旋转木马推荐场景中实现更优的遗憾表现，且DMED算法在特定极限下达到渐近最优。

Abstract: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

</details>


### [193] [Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05290)
*Xinwen Zhang,Peiran Yu,Zhaosong Lu,Hongchang Gao*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种随机双平滑梯度法，解决非凸联邦随机双层优化中现有方法对下层函数强凸性、条件数依赖强、上下层学习率耦合的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦随机双层优化应用广泛，但现有一阶方法常需强凸下层函数，收敛率对条件数依赖强，且上下层变量学习率尺度不同，导致实用性受限和超参数调优困难。

Method: 提出随机双平滑梯度法，解耦上下层学习率，不要求下层损失强凸，并建立严格理论保证。

Result: 收敛率达到 O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)，通信复杂度为 O(κ^4/ε^3)，对条件数 κ 的依赖显著优于现有方法；大量实验验证了算法有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法在非凸联邦随机双层优化中实现了更优的条件数依赖，放宽了下层强凸假设，并简化了学习率调参，具有更好的实用性和理论保证。

Abstract: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

</details>


### [194] [FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05296)
*Yuang Zhang,Chen Hui,Weisi Lin,Haiqi Zhu,Xiulai Wang,Sun-Yuan Kung,Feng Jiang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出FlexCast，一种字段自适应天气预测模型，使用单组参数为变量基数子集生成身份对齐的预测，提升跨大气场配置的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习天气模型将固定变量和气压层分配给预定义通道，限制了模型在不同大气场配置间的迁移性。

Method: FlexCast包含：元数据条件适配器编码变量身份、气压层和场类型并与空间特征结合；共享秩16投影由元数据相关门控调制生成字段特定特征；掩码集合融合将可用字段聚合为固定宽度表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；身份感知查询解码器生成请求字段的预测；学习标准六小时增量并递归生成更长期预报。

Result: 在2020年ERA5测试集上，FlexCast能适应不同字段配置；兼容的跨字段上下文与较低预测误差相关，而不匹配的上下文则增加误差。

Conclusion: FlexCast通过字段自适应设计实现了对可变字段子集的统一预测，且跨字段上下文的质量显著影响预测性能。

Abstract: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

</details>


### [195] [FreSia: Frequency-Semantic Instantiation and Alignment for Multivariate Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05726)
*Yubo Wang,Hui He,Hezhe Qiao,Guoqing Ji,Zhendong Niu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出频率感知框架FreSia，通过频率引导提示和全局上下文学习，将时间序列频域结构对齐到LLM语义空间，提升多变量预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM预测方法通过数值分词或启发式文本描述注入时间信息，难以感知被离散数值令牌掩盖的季节性和趋势等结构模式。

Method: FreSia包含FGPrompt频率引导提示机制，提取时间序列频域结构并投影为适配LLM语义空间的提示；以及GCL全局驱动上下文学习组件，利用全局CLS探针生成全局上下文，弥合时频域差距并融合多模态信息。

Result: 在八个预测基准上，FreSia在MSE和MAE上平均分别提升13.48%和8.06%。

Conclusion: 频域感知对齐能有效增强LLM对时间序列结构模式的感知，显著提升多变量时间序列预测性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in multivariate time series forecasting and anomaly detection. Existing studies predominantly inject temporal information into LLMs via direct numerical tokenization or heuristic textual descriptions. However, LLMs still face difficulty in perceiving the underlying structural patterns of numerical time series, particularly the seasonal and trend components obscured by discrete numerical tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose FreSia, a frequency-aware framework that establishes an effective alignment between the semantic space of LLMs and the frequency space of time series. Specifically, FGPrompt, a Frequency-Guided Prompt mechanism within FreSia, distills the frequency-domain structures of time series and projects them into prompts tailored to the semantic space of LLMs. Furthermore, we introduce a Global-driven Context Learning (GCL) component, which uses a global CLS-driven probe to generate global context to bridge the time-frequency domain gap and fuse the multi-modal information. Experiments on eight forecasting benchmarks show that FreSia achieves average improvements of 13.48% and 8.06% in MSE and MAE, respectively.

</details>


### [196] [Mining Agent Skills from Production Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05777)
*Yue Ran Kang,Colton Mikolajczyk,Chhaya Methani,Hazel Mak,Sahil Bhatnagar,Susheel Suresh,Alejandro Gutierrez Munoz*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 研究比较了从执行轨迹中挖掘智能体技能的三种证据来源与两种技能形式，在企业基准上评估其对下游任务性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中往往无法可靠获知任务是否成功，因此需要探究轨迹采样、成功/失败信息可用性及技能形式如何影响挖掘技能的下游表现。

Method: 固定挖掘流程，对比六种组合：证据来源三水平（仅成功轨迹、带标签的成功与失败、无标签的混合），技能形式两类型（有序工作流计划、声明式本体），并在ThinkingBox-Bench和APEX-Agents两个企业基准上评估。

Result: ThinkingBox-Bench上工作流比本体高1.7个百分点，Goldilocks证据比仅成功证据高2.4个百分点，而无结果标签的Goldilocks盲模拟差3.1个百分点；APEX-Agents上本体略优，证据机制间无显著偏好；域内任务结构约束导致性能不均。

Conclusion: 不同证据与技能形式组合的收益取决于企业领域，应针对目标任务需求定制元技能，而非采用一刀切方案。

Abstract: Agent skills that record procedural instructions are increasingly mined from execution traces rather than curated by hand. Skill-mining pipelines often use known task outcomes or feedback to guide skill construction. In production, reliable information on whether a run has succeeded may be unavailable. We study how the sampling of execution traces, access to success or failure information, and the form of the mined skills affect downstream task performance. Holding the mining pipeline fixed, we compare six combinations of mining evidence and skill forms. Mining evidence has three levels: successful trajectories only, successes and failures with their outcome labels, or the same mix with labels withheld. Skill form has two types: an ordered workflow plan, or a declarative ontology of entities, states, and policies. We evaluate the mined skills on two enterprise benchmarks, ThinkingBox-Bench and APEX-Agents. Analysis of task-level paired differences shows that the benefits of different configurations of mining evidence and skill forms depend on the enterprise domain. On ThinkingBox-Bench, paired differences show that workflows score better than ontology by 1.7 pp, Goldilocks beats success-only evidence type by 2.4 pp and Goldilocks blind simulating skills learnt without outcomes is worse by 3.1 pp. APEX-Agents shows a moderate preference for ontologies and no clear preference between evidence regimes. Within each domain, task structure related constraints drive uneven performance with mined skills. These findings motivate tailoring meta-skills to the demands of the target tasks rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.

</details>


### [197] [Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05337)
*Chenhao Si,Ming Yan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: GRNO通过将PDE中的输运场用于确定潜特征的读取坐标，而非仅作为输入值，提升了长时程PDE预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子未利用输运场在PDE中作为读取坐标选择的物理角色，存在物理角色与算子处理方式的不匹配，限制了预测性能。

Method: 提出Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO)，包含无参数方程适配器，计算诊断关系并构建偏移图以生成读取坐标；多尺度编码器-解码器结合中心读取与路由读取潜特征，学习有限时间更新。

Result: 在五个2D/3D PDE系统中，GRNO在四个系统的40步自回归评估中平均最终相对L2误差最低，在Keller-Segel上保持竞争力；固定权重路由干预显示四个系统对方向和空间对齐强依赖，Keller-Segel弱依赖；消融实验表明GRNO在所有五个系统上优于仅输入输运场、学习位移替代方程指定路由、空间错位路由等变体，并显著优于直接平流物理状态后学习剩余更新。

Conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标提供了有效的结构先验，显著提升长时程PDE预测性能。

Abstract: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

</details>


### [198] [Request Order Matters: Cache-History Sensitivity in Selective KV-Cache Reuse for Rolling Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05833)
*Tiffany Gu,Annie Guan,Manshu Huang,Nitin Rao,Siddhant Shah,Margaret Capetz*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 在滚动更新的长时智能体场景中，持久化KV缓存复用结合选择性重算会导致答案依赖于请求历史；按文档对齐重算比token top-k策略更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时运行的智能体反复调用LLM并保留大部分文档窗口，滚动更新破坏精确前缀缓存，需要非前缀KV缓存复用与选择性重算；但该复用可能使相同提示因历史请求不同而产生不同答案，需研究如何稳健地选择性重算。

Method: 在滚动智能体负载下比较持久KV缓存复用与选择性重算策略：CacheBlend的token top-k策略与文档对齐重算，在匹配的5%重算预算下，评估不同请求顺序对答案变化的影响，并测量TTFT加速与对完整预填充的保真度，同时进行消融研究。

Result: 在5%重算预算下，文档对齐重算将跨请求顺序的答案变化率从token top-k的69.0%降至26.1%；在不同前置请求序列下，文档对齐重算对完整预填充的保真度比token top-k提升34.5-52.5个百分点，两者均达到约5.7倍中位TTFT加速；消融表明连续性是与稳健选择性重算相关的主要因素。

Conclusion: 持久KV缓存复用与选择性重算具有历史依赖性；在滚动智能体负载中，文档对齐（连续性）的选择性重算能显著提高答案一致性与保真度，同时保持TTFT加速。

Abstract: Long-running agents repeatedly call an LLM while retaining most of their document window, evicting old documents, and appending new ones. These rolling updates break exact prefix caching and motivate non-prefix KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation. We show that persistent KV-cache reuse with selective recomputation can be history-dependent: in our rolling-agent workload, an unchanged prompt can produce different answers depending on the requests processed before it. At a matched 5% recomputation budget, document-aligned recomputation reduces answer variation across request orders from 69.0% with CacheBlend's token top-$k$ policy to 26.1%. When each prompt is evaluated after a different sequence of preceding requests, document-aligned recomputation improves fidelity to full prefill by 34.5-52.5 percentage points over token top-$k$, while both policies achieve approximately 5.7$\times$ median TTFT speedup. Our ablation study shows that, in our rolling-agent workload, contiguity is the main factor associated with robust selective recomputation.

</details>


### [199] [Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05371)
*Zixiang Li,Wei Wang,Yunchao Wei,Yao Zhao,Yue Song*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出稳健集成引导（REG），通过加权与截断改进集成校正，提升扩散先验求解逆问题的重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集成引导中预测散布大或残差极端的观测坐标会主导校正，降低重建精度，需抑制观测异质性与残差影响。

Method: REG利用集成预测散布平衡观测尺度，并自适应截断标准化残差以限制极端差异影响；两种操作复用现有粒子与前向预测，无需额外去噪器或前向模型评估。

Result: 在局部线性高斯模型下推导降低一步估计风险的条件，界定单个观测坐标的影响，并刻画有限集成下收益持续条件；Navier-Stokes反演、黑洞成像和声学全波形反演实验显示重建优于底层集成求解器，黑洞PSNR提升6.2-8.2 dB，Navier-Stokes误差降低26.4%。

Conclusion: 观测异质性与残差影响对设计可靠科学逆问题生成求解器至关重要，REG以轻量修改显著提升稳健性与精度。

Abstract: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

</details>


### [200] [Process Constitutions and Process Stewards: Towards the Next Generation of BPM for Agentic Organizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05942)
*Amin Jalali,Majid Rafiei*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文指出传统BPM基于人类行为者假设已过时，提出从建模人类工作转向治理自主智能体的根本性转变，引入过程宪法和过程管家两个新概念，以组织可读性为核心价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体生态系统日益自主执行、协调和适应组织工作，挑战了BPM的方法和过程核心概念，需要应对从人类工作建模到自主智能体治理的构成性转变。

Method: 提出两个新概念：过程宪法（机器可解释、负载价值的框架，定义可接受的智能体行为空间）和过程管家（解释并执行过程宪法的治理智能体），并勾勒研究议程。

Result: 论证了BPM面临构成性转变，新一代BPM的核心价值主张不是效率而是组织可读性，即保持智能体组织可问责、可争议和人类可理解的能力。

Conclusion: BPM需从建模人类工作转向治理自主智能体，通过过程宪法和过程管家实现组织可读性，并开启相应研究议程。

Abstract: Business Process Management (BPM) was built on a foundational assumption that organizations are populated primarily by human actors whose work can be made visible, governable, and improvable through process models. That assumption is depreciating. AI agent ecosystems increasingly execute, coordinate, and adapt organizational work with limited human direction, challenging not only BPM's methods but its core conception of what a process is. We argue that BPM faces a constitutive shift from modeling human work to governing autonomous agents, for which we propose two new concepts: the \emph{Process Constitution}, a machine-interpretable, value-laden framework that defines the space of admissible agent behavior, and the \emph{Process Steward}, a governance agent that interprets and enforces it. The central value proposition of this new generation of BPM is not efficiency but \emph{organizational legibility}: the capacity to keep agentic organizations accountable, contestable, and humanly understandable. We outline what this means and sketch the research agenda it opens.

</details>


### [201] [On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06139)
*Morgan May,Pierpaolo Dondio,Simon Caton*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究不同损失函数对深度神经网络在SIIM-ISIC黑色素瘤分类数据集上性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期诊断至关重要。深度学习模型在黑色素瘤诊断中展现出潜力，但SIIM-ISIC等数据集存在类别不平衡问题，影响模型性能。

Method: 使用focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵损失和加权softmax交叉熵损失训练深度神经网络，并报告性能评估指标和不确定性校准指标。

Result: focal loss在AUC性能和期望校准误差（ECE）方面同时取得了良好的组合效果。

Conclusion: focal loss在黑色素瘤分类中能兼顾性能和不确定性校准，是处理类别不平衡的有效损失函数选择。

Abstract: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

</details>


### [202] [Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06146)
*Morgan May,Simon Caton,Pierpaolo Dondio*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究了数据增强对不平衡数据（黑色素瘤分类）中模型校准的影响，比较了有无数据增强时AUC和期望校准误差（ECE）的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学图像分类尤其是黑色素瘤诊断中，准确量化预测不确定性或改进模型校准对患者护理有重要意义。数据增强常用于提升不平衡数据集上的模型性能和改进校准，但其对不平衡数据（特别是黑色素瘤分类）模型校准的具体影响尚未充分探索。

Method: 在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分类数据集上训练神经网络，设置两种条件：使用和不使用数据增强，并比较两种情况下AUC和期望校准误差（ECE）的差异。

Result: 使用不同数据增强方法后，不确定性校准有所改善。

Conclusion: 数据增强能够改善在不平衡数据集（黑色素瘤分类）上训练的模型的校准性能。

Abstract: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

</details>


### [203] [BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05409)
*Yue Li,Kangqi Ni,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA 结构化潜世界模型，将未来驱动因素影响分解为类型化潜效应状态，经图路由至各目标，用于动作条件多目标时间序列预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件时间序列预测需刻画未来动作与外生强迫通过部分可观测、延迟与持续性各异的影响作用于多目标；直接条件化使影响演化与目标特异性隐含于预测器中，静态关系图仅规定连接而不追踪演化效应。

Method: 将驱动影响分解为类型化潜效应状态，在未来驱动下滚动前推，并通过图路由到各目标专属节点，构成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基；以容量受控的残差补充直接驱动信息。

Result: 在临床、农业、环境与工业四个多目标系统上优于多种预训练与监督式已知未来协变量基线；匹配对照实验分离出潜动态、未来滚动、图路由与残差容量，其中未来滚动与图优先残差路由在四个系统上均提升预测性能。

Conclusion: 结构化潜效应状态与图路由能显式建模未来驱动对多目标的演化影响，滚动前推与图优先残差路由是关键有效组件，框架具备跨领域泛化性。

Abstract: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

</details>


### [204] [Copies or Sources? Measuring How LLM Aggregators Count Restated Evidence in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06192)
*Jianxin Gao,Runze Li,Tianyi Yu,Liangwei Ren,Bohan Chen,Zining Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，重复陈述（转述）对概率聚合的影响，提出将报告概率转换为独立读数单位，并计算副本权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中消息常被转发、重复和讨论回声，导致聚合器可能错误地将同一证据的重复陈述视为独立来源，从而高估证据强度并引发过早决策。

Method: 将报告概率转换为独立读数单位，为每个重复陈述分配副本权重（0表示仅计来源，1表示计所有陈述），并在三个测试平台（贝叶斯预言机消息日志、附加副本的网页文档、四种通信协议下LLM智能体团队日志）上，使用来自三个提供商的四个模型进行验证。

Result: 转发副本仅相当于0.06至0.42个新读数；在5%至40%的日志中，报告信念暗示了预言机从未做出的早期承诺；模型在控制日志上的副本计数倾向与网页副本和智能体日志一致；一段声明可将副本权重降至0.08以下；引用规则将早期承诺从11.2%降至1.1%。

Conclusion: 重复陈述会显著影响信念聚合，明确副本贡献或让智能体引用读数而非复述，可有效减少偏差并保留真实佐证。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) restate observations as a matter of course: relays forward them, shared boards repeat them and discussion rounds echo them. An aggregator that pools such messages should count sources, not statements. We convert a reported probability into units of independent readings, which assigns every restatement a copy weight, 0 for an aggregator that counts sources and 1 for one that counts every statement, and yields the implied decision under any cost structure. Three testbeds hold the evidence fixed and vary how it is restated: message logs with an exact Bayesian oracle, web documents with appended copies, and logs written by LLM agent teams under four communication protocols. Across four models from three providers, a forwarded copy counts for 0.06 to 0.42 of a new reading, mostly because some replies count every statement. On 5% to 40% of logs that state one reading three times, the reported belief implies an early commitment that the oracle never makes. The models that count copies least and most on controlled logs do so on web copies and agent-written logs as well. A one-paragraph declaration of what a copy contributes brings the copy weight on controlled logs to 0.08 or less. A rule that has agents refer to readings instead of restating them cuts belief-implied early commitment from 11.2% to 1.1% and preserves genuine corroboration.

</details>


### [205] [Population Scaling or Data Dilution? Dynamics of Local Topology Evolution in Decentralized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05476)
*Yin-Kuan Liang,Yan Gao,Yang Long*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 去中心化学习的扩展不仅取决于客户端数量N，还受数据分配、拓扑混合与通信能力耦合影响，实验表明通信结构比N本身更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在去中心化学习中，单纯增加客户端数量N为何无法单独解释性能变化，因为数据分配、拓扑相关的混合过程与通信容量可能同时改变。

Method: 在CIFAR-10上设置N∈{10,50,100,200}，对比三种拓扑：度数为2的环形、静态随机图、以及基于朋友的朋友发现的局部自适应拓扑LFHE；分析Metropolis谱隙、固定本地数据集大小与固定总数据集划分的差异，并考察LFHE度阈值的影响。

Result: 环形拓扑的Metropolis谱隙按Θ(N^{-2})衰减，导致模型分歧收缩变慢；固定本地数据集大小时，人口惩罚显著减小；环形进入高分歧状态，而静态随机图和LFHE接近共识；提高LFHE度阈值可提升精度与共识但传输成本大增。

Conclusion: 去中心化扩展由学习与通信动力学的耦合决定，而非仅由客户端数量N决定。

Abstract: Scaling decentralized learning changes not only the number of clients $N$, but also the dynamics of information propagation and consensus. We argue that the effect of increasing $N$ cannot be understood in isolation, because data allocation, topology-dependent mixing, and communication capacity may change simultaneously. We study these coupled effects on CIFAR-10 with $N\in\{10,50,100,200\}$, comparing a degree-two Ring, a Static Random graph, and Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a locally adaptive topology process based on friend-of-friend discovery. The Ring provides an analytically transparent failure mode: its Metropolis spectral gap decays as $Θ(N^{-2})$, implying progressively slower contraction of model disagreement as the population grows. Experiments show that holding the nominal local dataset size fixed substantially reduces the apparent population penalty observed when a fixed total dataset is divided among more clients. The remaining degradation depends strongly on communication structure: Ring enters a high-disagreement regime, whereas Static Random and LFHE remain close to consensus. Increasing LFHE's degree threshold further improves accuracy and consensus, but at a substantially higher model-transmission cost. These results show that decentralized scaling is governed by coupled learning and communication dynamics, rather than by the number of clients alone.

</details>


### [206] [LEON: Location Embeddings from OSM Neighborhoods via Hexagonal Graph Masked Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05497)
*Szymon Soltysiak,Radoslaw Malek,Jedrzej Kusnierz,Milosz Chojecki,Piotr Szymanski,Aleksandra Kawala-Sterniuk*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出LEON自监督框架，将GraphMAE适配于地理空间区域表示学习，利用H3六边形网格图和OSM设施分布模式学习空间嵌入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地理信息系统需要复杂空间表示学习技术从地理空间数据中提取有意义的模式，现有方法在利用地理数据固有空间结构和众包数据方面存在不足。

Method: 基于H3索引构建六边形网格图，应用掩码自动编码技术（GraphMAE），从OpenStreetMap设施分布模式中学习鲁棒的空间嵌入。

Result: 在EuroSAT卫星图像分类上准确率提升高达1.87%，在房价、犯罪预测和城市分析等地理预测基准上取得一致性能提升；学习到的嵌入具有高度结构化和独特性。

Conclusion: 自监督学习为利用广泛可用的众包数据进行地理空间区域表示学习提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Geographic information systems increasingly rely on sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques to extract meaningful patterns from complex geospatial data. This paper introduces LEON, a novel self-supervised framework that adapts Graph Masked Autoencoders (GraphMAE) for geospatial region representation learning. Our method leverages the inherent spatial structure of geographic data by constructing hexagonal grid graphs using H3 indexing and applying masked autoencoding techniques to learn robust spatial embeddings from OpenStreetMap (OSM) amenity distribution patterns. We evaluate LEON on multiple real-world datasets including EuroSAT satellite imagery classification and various geographic prediction tasks (housing prices, crime prediction, and urban analytics). Experimental results demonstrate that LEON achieves significant improvements in spatial understanding, with up to 1.87% accuracy improvement on EuroSAT classification and consistent performance gains across geographic prediction benchmarks. The learned embeddings exhibit highly structured and distinct properties, making them particularly suitable for downstream spatial analysis tasks. Our findings suggest that self-supervised learning provides an effective paradigm for geospatial region representation learning using widely available crowdsourced data.

</details>


### [207] [Logic-Logit: A Logic-Based Approach to Choice Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05501)
*Shuhan Zhang,Wendi Ren,Shuang Li*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种基于规则的可解释选择模型Logic-Logit，结合列生成与Frank-Wolfe算法高效提取逻辑规则，在合成与真实数据上实现优于基线模型的可解释性与准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有选择模型（参数、非参数或深度网络）中，神经网络虽计算能力强但参数多、缺乏可解释性，在需要透明度的场景中受限；而个体常采用启发式决策规则（OR-of-ANDs）形成考虑集后再选择，受此启发需开发可解释的偏好建模方法。

Method: 提出Logic-Logit规则型可解释选择模型，利用逻辑规则（合取式的析取）刻画选择过程；针对规则提取的NP-hard问题，创新性地结合列生成技术与Frank-Wolfe算法实现高效规则提取。

Result: 在合成数据集及商业和医疗领域的真实数据上评估，Logic-Logit在可解释性和准确性方面均显著优于基线模型。

Conclusion: Logic-Logit为偏好建模提供了新视角，有效学习并解释人类选择，在保持高准确性的同时提升了可解释性，适用于对透明度要求高的场景。

Abstract: In this study, we propose a novel rule-based interpretable choice model, Logic-Logit, designed to effectively learn and explain human choices. Choice models have been widely applied across various domains---such as commercial demand forecasting, recommendation systems, and consumer behavior analysis---typically categorized as parametric, nonparametric, or deep network-based. While recent innovations have favored neural network approaches for their computational power, these flexible models often involve large parameter sets and lack interpretability, limiting their effectiveness in contexts where transparency is essential. Previous empirical evidence shows that individuals usually use heuristic decision rules to form their consideration sets, from which they then choose. These rules are often represented as disjunctions of conjunctions (i.e., OR-of-ANDs). These rules-driven, consider-then-choose decision processes enable people to quickly screen numerous alternatives while reducing cognitive and search costs. Motivated by this insight, our approach leverages logic rules to elucidate human choices, providing a fresh perspective on preference modeling. We introduce a unique combination of column generation techniques and the Frank-Wolfe algorithm to facilitate efficient rule extraction for preference modeling---a process recognized as NP-hard. Our empirical evaluation, conducted on both synthetic datasets and real-world data from commercial and healthcare domains, demonstrates that Logic-Logit significantly outperforms baseline models in terms of interpretability and accuracy.

</details>


### [208] [Joint Estimation of Common-Slope Decay Rates and Spatial Amplitudes Using Parameterized Nonnegative Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05549)
*Jeremy B. Bai,Filip Elvander,Sebastian J. Schlecht*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文将房间脉冲响应（RIR）中共同斜率衰减率与幅度的联合估计建模为以Itakura-Saito散度为损失函数的参数化非负矩阵分解（IS-NMF），并提出贡献加权SAGE算法加速估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混响时间（RT）估计通常需要反向积分，且难以从RIR功率中直接获得频率相关的详细RT曲线；同时，联合估计衰减率与幅度存在计算效率问题。

Method: 采用IS-NMF对每个短时傅里叶变换频点进行参数化建模，使用标准SAGE算法得到幅度闭式更新和衰减率更新的凸子问题；进一步引入贡献加权SAGE，强调各分量对建模功率贡献大的观测。

Result: 合成数据实验表明，该方法能准确恢复分离良好的衰减，且损失下降比标准SAGE更快；对实测耦合房间RIR的应用得到了频率相关的RT曲线，并揭示了共享衰减分量的互补时空贡献。

Conclusion: 所提方法无需反向积分即可从RIR功率直接估计详细RT曲线，贡献加权SAGE有效加速了估计，并在实测耦合房间中验证了其有效性。

Abstract: We formulate joint estimation of common-slope decay rates and amplitudes from room impulse responses (RIRs) as parameterized nonnegative matrix factorization with the Itakura--Saito divergence as the loss function (IS-NMF). Estimation at each short-time Fourier transform frequency bin produces detailed reverberation time (RT) curves directly from RIR powers with no backward integration needed. Standard space-alternating generalized expectation-maximization (SAGE) algorithm yields closed-form amplitude updates and a convex subproblem for each decay rate update. To accelerate estimation, we introduce contribution-weighted SAGE, which emphasizes observations where each component contributes strongly to the modeled power. Experiments with synthetic data show accurate recovery of well-separated decays and faster loss reduction than standard SAGE. Application to measured coupled-room RIRs yields frequency-dependent RT curves and reveals complementary space-time contributions of the shared decay components.

</details>


### [209] [An equality condition for the Dobrushin bound on attention rollout and how often it holds in trained transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05558)
*Przemysław Rola*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文研究注意力- rollout 因子的 Dobrushin 系数不等式及其逐层乘积边界，刻画了等号成立的条件，并在多种模型上验证该条件的普遍性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在理解注意力 rollout 的谱性质，特别是逐层边界的紧性条件，以揭示不同架构中注意力矩阵的结构特征。

Method: 推导出 κ(½(I+A)) ≤ ½(1+κ(A))，并证明等号成立当且仅当存在实现 κ(A) 的 token 对互为自主导；在 DINOv2、RoBERTa、DistilBERT、DeiT-B、ViT-B/16 和 FT-Transformer 上，对头部平均注意力且限制于内容 token 进行实证检验。

Result: 在 DINOv2（三种规模）、RoBERTa 和 DistilBERT 中，条件几乎对所有输入和层成立；监督模型 DeiT-B 和 ViT-B/16 分别有 91% 和 64% 的输入-层对成立，失败均在深度后期；FT-Transformer 仅在 11-44% 的输入-层对成立。特殊 token 导致 DINOv2 和语言模型几乎全部失败，包含特殊 token 时条件仅在 82-97% 的输入-层对成立。

Conclusion: 逐层边界在多数自监督和语言模型中紧致成立，但监督视觉模型和表格模型失败较多；特殊 token 是破坏紧性的关键因素，表明内容 token 的注意力结构更符合理论条件。

Abstract: The Dobrushin coefficient of each attention-rollout factor satisfies $κ(\frac12(I+A))\le\frac12(1+κ(A))$, and multiplying these inequalities over layers bounds the coefficient of the whole rollout. We characterise exactly when the layerwise bound is tight: equality holds if and only if some token pair attaining $κ(A)$ is mutually self-dominant - each of the two attends to itself at least as strongly as the other attends to it. The condition is far from automatic: uniformly random stochastic matrices satisfy it only 24-30% of the time.
  When tested on the head-averaged attention of each individual input and restricted to content tokens - image patches, words or tabular features, excluding cls, register and separator tokens - the condition holds for essentially every input at every layer of DINOv2 (three model sizes), RoBERTa and DistilBERT. In the supervised models DeiT-B and ViT-B/16 it holds for 91% and 64% of input-layer pairs respectively, with all failures occurring late in depth. In FT-Transformer trained on two standard tabular benchmarks it holds for only 11-44% of input-layer pairs. The special tokens account for almost all failures in DINOv2 and the language models: when they are included, the condition holds for only 82-97% of input-layer pairs.

</details>


### [210] [Poisson-GENERIC Neural Operators: Exact Metriplectic Structure in Function Space via Casimir Entropies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05570)
*Jason Sulskis,Sathya Ravi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种无需投影即可满足GENERIC退化条件的神经算子，通过将可逆算子构造为相容的Lie-Poisson pencil或常数Fourier乘子，并在增广状态(u,s)上令熵为Casimir，从而精确保持反对称性、正性、两种退化性及Jacobi恒等式，并在多个PDE基准上优于无约束基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有热力学一致的神经算子通过将可逆算子投影到熵梯度的正交补来施加GENERIC退化条件，导致算子状态依赖并丧失Jacobi恒等式，仅得到metriplectic-degenerate而非真正的metriplectic结构。作者希望像GENERIC本身那样自然获得退化性，避免投影带来的结构破坏。

Method: 对非线性输运，可逆算子L取相容的Lie-Poisson pencil αD+λ(uD+Du)；否则取常数、平凡Poisson的Fourier乘子。在增广状态(u,s)上引入潜熵密度，使S=∫s成为L的Casimir，从而L δS/δz=0恒成立而无需投影。能量由固定的机械二次项、学习的无规范势和凸内能组成。摩擦算子M=AA^T逐点满足M δE/δz=0，其Onsager奇偶结构允许扩散与阻尼但可证明排除输运。采用离散梯度积分器获得精确的离散第一、第二定律。

Result: 在1D和2D的四个PDE、三种骨干网络(FNO、Transolver、CNO)上，模型在72个种子级比较中赢下61个；能学习到精确的输运与波符号，在热传导和Burgers方程上耗散率与真实值误差在13%以内，在平流方程上无耗散。常数L消融表明精确Jacobi的代价是失去Burgers，学习熵消融显示在每个可逆-不可逆问题上都会注入能量。

Conclusion: 该框架无需投影即可在任意参数下以机器精度保持斜对称性、正性、两种退化性及Jacobi恒等式（Lie-Poisson项在解析频带上），并给出热传导与阻尼波的精确闭式摩擦算子；第二定律在可检验的曲率条件下约束物理能量，离散梯度积分器保证精确的离散第一、第二定律，为构建结构保持的神经历算算子提供了新途径。

Abstract: Existing thermodynamically consistent neural operators impose the GENERIC degeneracy conditions by projecting the reversible operator onto the complement of the entropy gradient. This makes the operator state-dependent and forfeits the Jacobi identity, so the result is metriplectic-degenerate rather than metriplectic. We instead obtain degeneracy the way GENERIC does. For nonlinear transport, the reversible operator $L$ is the compatible Lie-Poisson pencil $αD+λ(uD+Du)$; otherwise it is a constant, trivially Poisson Fourier multiplier. On an augmented state $(u,s)$ with a latent entropy density, $S=\int s$ is a Casimir of $L$, so $L\,δS/δz=0$ holds identically without projection. The energy combines a fixed mechanical quadratic, a learned gauge-free potential, and a convex internal energy. The friction operator $M=AA^\top$ satisfies $M\,δE/δz=0$ pointwise, and its Onsager parity structure permits diffusion and damping while provably excluding transport. For any parameters, skewness, positivity, both degeneracies, and the Jacobi identity (on the resolved band for the Lie-Poisson term) hold to machine precision. Heat conduction and damped waves admit exact closed-form friction operators, the second law bounds physical energy under a checkable curvature condition, and a discrete-gradient integrator yields exact discrete first and second laws. On four PDEs in 1D and 2D with three backbones (FNO, Transolver, CNO), the model wins 61 of 72 seed-level comparisons against same-backbone unconstrained baselines, learns the exact transport and wave symbols, matches the true dissipation rate within 13% on heat and Burgers, and dissipates nothing on advection. A constant-$L$ ablation isolates the cost of exact Jacobi as the loss of Burgers, while a learned-entropy ablation injects energy on every reversible-irreversible problem.

</details>


### [211] [What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05577)
*Dhyey Dharmendrakumar Mavani,Rian Atri,Tairan Ji*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文通过BOOM基准审计可观测性基础模型Toto，区分线性探针的“可恢复性”与模型实际“使用”信息之间的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性探针只能表明标签可从隐藏状态中恢复，但无法判断该信息是否超越输入本身的揭示，也无法判断模型是否真正利用了这些信息，因此需要更严格的审计框架。

Method: 在BOOM上使用五个序列不相交的重划分，比较Toto冻结残差流的线性探针、读取原始输入窗口的模型，以及去除训练配置的Toto架构；同时进行残差交换与协调探针的零样本测试。

Result: 短/中节奏和指标类型在Toto残差中比最强原始窗口模型更易线性恢复（宏F1 0.766对0.633、0.545对0.498）；域几乎持平，序列基数在原始窗口中恢复更好；MOMENT-base呈现类似读出；交换高爆发供体残差可移动未来爆发性读出但未使预测持续更爆发；BOOM训练的协调探针在外部基准上零样本R^2为负。

Conclusion: 可恢复性不等于模型实际使用该信息，线性探针结果需结合基线比较与干预实验谨慎解读。

Abstract: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.

</details>


### [212] [polyview: A Python package for multi-view machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06491)
*Gwendal Debaussart-Joniec,Argyris Kalogeratos*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出polyview，一个统一且兼容scikit-learn的Python多视图学习工具包，支持端到端工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Python生态缺乏积极维护的统一多视图学习工具，难以支持端到端的多视图工作流。

Method: polyview提供多视图嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强及不完整视图处理功能，以核心类与工具实现异构工作流组合，并与scikit-learn兼容。

Result: 在五个真实多视图数据集上展示该包，并将其基于典型相关分析的组件与两个现有库进行比较。

Conclusion: polyview旨在成为多视图方法基准测试与原型设计的实用工具包，以及未来研究开发的基础。

Abstract: Multi-view learning jointly exploits multiple complementary representations of the same data and has become increasingly important in machine learning. However, the Python ecosystem lacks actively maintained, unified tooling for end-to-end multi-view workflows. In this paper, we present polyview, a Python package that provides tools for multi-view embedding, clustering, fusion, and view augmentation, as well as for handling incomplete views, all compatible with scikit-learn. The library offers a unified interface for composing heterogeneous multi-view workflows, including seamless transitions between multi-view and single-view stages. It is built around a core set of classes and utilities that enable composition of different methods and straightforward implementation of new ones. We illustrate the package on five real multi-view datasets and compare its components based on canonical correlation analysis with those of two established libraries. polyview aims to be both a practical toolkit for benchmarking and prototyping multi-view methods and a foundation for future research and development in this area.

</details>


### [213] [Signature-Based Feature Learning for Human Activity Recognition: A Reproducible Machine Learning Study of Representation, Depth, and Model Choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06553)
*Kamal Jarrar,Jacky Cresson,Christian Paroissin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了基于签名变换的特征表征在人类活动识别（HAR）中的作用，在可复现且防泄漏的框架下比较了原始信号、时间增广路径与lead-lag路径三种表征，并结合MLP与随机森林分类器进行实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管深度学习与手工特征广泛应用于HAR，但表征本身的作用常未被系统隔离；签名变换能数学化编码时间顺序与跨通道交互，但其在完全可复现、防泄漏框架下对HAR的价值尚不明确。

Method: 在UCI HAR数据集上采用完全可复现流程，保留原始训练-测试划分并使用受试者不相交验证以防泄漏；比较原始展平信号、时间增广路径和lead-lag变换路径三种表征，在多种截断深度下计算签名特征，使用MLP与随机森林在相同预处理和验证下评估，并复现了先前的K-means特征降维研究作为对比。

Result: 签名表征与随机森林结合时性能提升，最佳配置为时间增广六通道签名在深度6下使用基于熵的随机森林，达到0.858准确率和0.859宏F1，优于最强原始基线（0.816准确率）；lead-lag表征在中等深度具竞争力但未超过最佳时间增广模型；MLP模型未超过原始基线。

Conclusion: 基于签名的特征学习能提升HAR性能，但其收益取决于表征设计与分类器选择之间的匹配。

Abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) relies on transforming sensor signals into informative representations for classification. Although deep learning and handcrafted features are widely used, the role of representation itself is often not systematically isolated. Signature transforms provide a mathematically grounded way to encode temporal order and cross-channel interactions, but their value for HAR under a fully reproducible and leakage-aware framework remains unclear. To evaluate whether signature-based feature learning improves HAR performance compared with raw-signal baselines, and to assess the effects of embedding strategy, truncation depth, model choice, and sensor configuration. Experiments were conducted on the UCI HAR dataset using a fully reproducible pipeline with the original train--test split preserved and subject-disjoint validation to prevent leakage. Three representations were compared: raw flattened signals, time-augmented paths, and lead--lag transformed paths. Signature features were computed at multiple truncation depths and evaluated using multilayer perceptron (MLP) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers under identical preprocessing and validation procedures. A prior K-means-based feature reduction study was also reproduced for comparison. Signature-based representations improved performance when paired with RF models, the best configuration was time-augmented six-channel signatures at depth 6 using entropy-based RF achieving 0.858 accuracy and 0.859 macro F1, outperforming the strongest raw baseline (0.816 accuracy). Lead--lag representations were competitive at moderate depths but did not surpass the best time-augmented models. MLP models did not exceed raw baselines. Signature-based feature learning can improve HAR, but its benefit depends on alignment between representation design and classifier choice.

</details>


### [214] [HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06563)
*Han Luo,Bingbing Wen,Guang Yang,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Pan Lu,Lucy Lu Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出HERA框架，通过工具链与环境协同进化，提升LLM智能体在不可行任务中主动弃权的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在复杂工具使用环境中难以识别任务不可行、无有效解的情况；已有方法针对固定任务集优化模型或工具链，泛化到未见失败模式的能力有限。

Method: HERA包含两部分：(i) 通过受控环境变异，将可解任务自动转化为需弃权的任务，构建可验证的可行-不可行任务对；(ii) 协同进化流程，利用历史任务上的性能失败驱动工具链适配，并生成针对既往弱点的新的执行环境与任务。

Result: 在留出评估任务上，进化后的工具链将弃权准确率从61.7%提升至83.3%，可行任务完成率从68.3%提升至76.7%，两项指标均优于对比方法；最佳工具链可零模型特定优化地迁移到19个其他LLM，平均弃权准确率提升15.3个百分点，并使较小模型以约85%更低成本达到更强模型的表现。

Conclusion: HERA通过工具链与环境协同进化有效提升智能体弃权可靠性与泛化性，且具备跨模型迁移能力，可显著降低成本。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. Recent work has formalized this reliability gap as the problem of agentic abstention, and existing approaches typically optimize a model or agent harness against a fixed set of tasks, leading to limited generalization to unseen failure modes. We introduce HERA, a framework for harness-environment co-evolution for agentic abstention. HERA consists of (i) a pipeline to automatically construct verifiable pairs of feasible and infeasible tasks by applying controlled environment mutations that transform solvable tasks into cases requiring abstention, and (ii) a co-evolution procedure in which performance failures on previous tasks are used to drive harness adaptation and generate new execution environments and tasks geared towards previous weaknesses. On held-out evaluation tasks, an evolved harness from HERA improves abstention accuracy from 61.7% to 83.3% while improving feasible-task completion from 68.3% to 76.7%, achieving the highest abstention and feasible-task completion among the compared methods. The resulting best harness transfers across 19 other LLMs, improving abstention accuracy by 15.3 percentage points on average without any model-specific optimization, and enabling smaller models to match the performance of more powerful models at an estimated 85% lower cost.

</details>


### [215] [Delay-coordinate reconstruction and conditional-moment causal diagnostics in stochastic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05632)
*Jun Ohkubo*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该文提出随机系统延迟坐标重构的条件矩解释：延迟向量用于重构未来分布的条件矩而非唯一未来路径，并据此扩展收敛交叉映射（CCM）以诊断随机系统中的因果关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典延迟嵌入与部分观测重构基于确定性动力系统理论，但许多系统具有内在随机性，因此需要为随机系统建立类似的重构理论，并解决CCM在随机系统中通常不适用的问题。

Method: 从两个角度论证：一是随机微分方程的概率密度服从确定性Fokker-Planck方程，其矩层级可由有限矩闭合近似为Takens式有限维逼近；二是基于Koopman算子与Mori-Zwanzig形式，说明可观测量的时间演化给出条件期望，且系数空间Mori-Zwanzig方程中的正交“噪声”项在随机情形下消失。随后将该随机延迟重构观点用于重新审视CCM，并以加性与乘性耦合的耦合logistic系统进行讨论。

Result: 理论上，随机系统的延迟向量可重构未来分布的条件矩，有限矩闭合提供有限维近似；Mori-Zwanzig分析中正交噪声项在随机情形下消失，与矩基论证一致。应用上，虽然基于嵌入定理的CCM一般不能用于随机系统，但利用条件矩可以检验某些类型的因果关系，并在耦合logistic系统中展示了因果关系如何嵌入随机系统。

Conclusion: 延迟坐标重构可被推广为随机系统中的条件矩重构，从而为随机动力系统中的因果诊断提供理论基础，并表明CCM可在条件矩框架下有限度地适用于某些随机因果关系分析。

Abstract: Partial observation and delay-coordinate reconstruction are rooted in deterministic dynamical-systems theory, whereas there are many systems with intrinsic stochasticity. We propose a conditional-moment interpretation of delay-coordinate reconstruction for stochastic systems, in which a delay vector is used to reconstruct conditional moments of a future distribution rather than a unique future sample path. Two complementary arguments motivate this viewpoint. First, the probability density of a stochastic differential equation obeys a deterministic Fokker-Planck equation and, under certain assumptions, is represented by an infinite deterministic hierarchy of moments. Hence, a finite-moment closure suggests a Takens-like finite-dimensional approximation. Second, a discussion based on the Koopman operator theory clarifies that the time evolution of an observable in the Mori-Zwanzig formalism yields a conditional expectation in stochastic systems. Then, the orthogonal "noise" term in the coefficient-space Mori-Zwanzig equation vanishes in the stochastic cases; this result is consistent with the moment-based argument. As an application of this stochastic delay-reconstruction viewpoint, we revisit convergent cross mapping (CCM) for diagnosing certain causal relationships. Although CCM based on the embedding theorem cannot generally be applied to stochastic systems, it is possible to examine certain types of causal relationships by using conditional moments. Using coupled logistic systems with additive and multiplicative coupling mechanisms, we discuss how causal relationships are embedded in stochastic systems.

</details>


### [216] [When Does a Diffusion Model Decide What to Draw ?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05645)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文在CIFAR-10上测量扩散模型从纯噪声生成图像过程中何时对类别做出不可逆承诺，并提出committor这一直接测量方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型从纯噪声逐步去噪，但在某个噪声水平后会从‘可生成任何类别’转变为‘锁定某一类别’。作者希望量化这一决策发生的时间点，并检验训练模型对此的偏差。

Method: 直接测量方法为：冻结半成品图像，从该点多次重启生成，统计各类别出现频率，称为committor。同时提出更廉价的替代测量：分类器对两类的意见分裂为两个明显组时的噪声水平。

Result: 模型对粗粒度问题（车辆还是动物）的决策噪声水平约为细粒度问题（哪种动物）的两倍。廉价测量能正确排序决策顺序（秩相关0.73-0.88），但无法准确反映确切时间。

Conclusion: 扩散模型的类别承诺存在层次性：粗粒度类别先确定，细粒度后确定；分类器分裂法可近似排序但精度有限。

Abstract: A diffusion model starts from pure noise and removes it step by step. Somewhere along the way it stops being able to become "anything" and becomes committed to, say, a horse rather than a truck. We measure when this happens, and what a trained model gets wrong about it, on CIFAR-10. The most direct measurement is to freeze a half-finished image, restart the generation from that point many times, and count how often each class comes out. We call this probability the committor. Measured this way, the model settles coarse questions (vehicle or animal?) at roughly twice the noise level of fine ones (which animal?). A much cheaper measurement, the noise level at which a classifier's opinion about two classes splits into two distinct groups, gets the order of these decisions right (rank correlation 0.73-0.88) but not their exact timing. We then compare pretrained models with their

</details>


### [217] [The Review Lottery: Calibrating an Observational Estimator of Peer-Review Noise (ICLR 2017-2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06591)
*Feilian Huang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究仅利用公开评审数据构建观测估计器，估算会议论文若由不同评审组评审时接受/拒绝决定的变化程度，并在ICLR九年数据上校准与应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行第二次独立程序委员会是回答评审决定可变性的金标准，但成本极高，仅在NeurIPS 2014和2021实施过两次。

Method: 构建基于公开评审数据的观测估计器，并两次校准；应用于ICLR 2017-2025共36,113篇论文、134,912条评审。方法用贝叶斯有序probit模型将评分分解为论文质量与评审噪声，用logistic模型将评分映射为决定，并模拟两个独立委员会（后验抽样B=1,000；委员会规模k=2,3,4）。
