Result: 估计分歧率在k=2时为23-30%，k=4时为18-24%；30-50%的 accepted papers 会被拒绝。外部校准：NeurIPS 2021 k=3模拟分歧率为23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%]，报告值为23.0%，偏差+0.3pp；接受精度与委员会相关性分别在5pp和0.04内一致。内部校准：18,740篇4条以上评审论文中，随机无模型2+2评审拆分与k=2模拟在2018年及2021-2025年相差1pp内。纵向看，2017-2025评审噪声无稳健时间趋势。2020与2021 accepted-paper flip rates高有不同机制：2020采用四点量表压缩评分（23.7%论文组内方差为零），反事实显示粗化量表使分歧提高约7pp；2021则结合了样本中最低信噪比与最拥挤的接受阈值。LLM时代方面，2023年组内评分方差断点检验未发现断点，但设计功效极低，且无2022年后评审文本或置信度数据，因此未进行LLM归因。

Conclusion: 公开评审数据可用于估计会议决定对评审组变化的敏感性，ICLR多年结果显示决定分歧率较高，且不同年份高翻转率机制不同；但LLM影响因数据与设计限制无法归因。

Abstract: How much of a conference accept/reject decision would change if the same paper were reviewed by a different set of reviewers? Running a second independent program committee is the gold standard for answering this, but it is prohibitively expensive: done only twice (NeurIPS 2014 and 2021). We build an observational estimator of this quantity from public review data alone, calibrate it twice, and apply it to nine years of ICLR (2017-2025; 36,113 papers, 134,912 reviews). The estimator decomposes scores with a Bayesian ordered-probit model into paper quality and reviewer noise, maps scores to decisions with a logistic model, and simulates two independent committees (posterior draws B=1,000; committee sizes k=2,3,4). Estimated disagreement rates are 23-30% at k=2 and 18-24% at k=4; 30-50% of accepted papers would be rejected. External calibration: at the NeurIPS 2021 reviewer-count caliber (k=3), the simulated 2021 disagreement rate is 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs. reported 23.0% (bias +0.3pp); accept precision and committee correlation agree within 5pp and 0.04. Internal calibration: on 18,740 papers with 4+ reviews, random model-free 2+2 reviewer splits agree with the k=2 simulation within 1pp in 2018 and 2021-2025. Longitudinally, we find no robust time trend in reviewer noise over 2017-2025. The high accepted-paper flip rates of 2020 and 2021 have distinct mechanisms: the 2020 four-point scale compressed scores (23.7% of papers had zero within-paper variance), and a counterfactual shows coarsening the scale raises disagreement by about 7pp; 2021 instead combined the lowest signal-to-noise ratio in the sample with the most threshold-crowded acceptances. For the LLM era, a 2023 breakpoint test on within-paper score variance finds no break, but the design has almost no power, and no post-2022 review text or confidence data exist, so no LLM attribution is attempted.

</details>


### [218] [Graph Data Augmentation via Contrastive Generator Inversion ($\texttt{DCBA}$)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05653)
*Mateusz Stolarski,Michał Czuba,Łukasz Kraiński,Katarzyna Musial,Paweł Prałat,Bogumił Kamiński,Piotr Bródka*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出DCBA，一种基于模型的图数据增强方法，通过从观测网络推断合成图生成器的配置，以缓解图机器学习中数据不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图机器学习方法的发展常受限于大规模、多样化图数据集的缺乏，因此需要有效的数据增强技术。

Method: 使用ABCD生成器（产生具有社区结构的无标度网络），通过多正对比目标和软负加权学习图与生成器参数化的联合表示，从而预测ABCD配置。

Result: 实验表明，DCBA比算法逆建模基线更准确、鲁棒地恢复生成器参数；在社区检测中，用推断配置微调PRoCD，在合成网络上平均提升AMI 161%，在真实网络上提升273%。

Conclusion: DCBA能有效推断生成器配置以增强图数据，并显著提升下游社区检测任务的性能。

Abstract: Graphs provide a natural representation of many complex systems, ranging from social platforms to ecosystems. However, the development of graph-based machine learning methods is often constrained by the limited availability of large and diverse graph datasets. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{DCBA}$, a model-based approach to graph data augmentation that infers the configuration of a synthetic graph generator from an observed network. We instantiate the proposed framework using the $\texttt{ABCD}$ generator, which produces scale-free networks with community structure. Our model learns a joint representation of graphs and generator parametrisations using a multi-positive contrastive objective with soft negative weighting. The learned representation enables the prediction of an $\texttt{ABCD}$ configuration whose stochastic realisations preserve the macrostructural properties encoded by the generator. Experiments show that $\texttt{DCBA}$ recovers generator parameters more accurately and robustly than an algorithmic inverse-modelling baseline. Its downstream utility is further demonstrated in community detection, where inferred configurations used to fine-tune $\texttt{PRoCD}$ improve AMI on average by $161\%$ on synthetic and $273\%$ on real-world networks.

</details>


### [219] [Sharp Integrality Gaps in Calibration Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05679)
*Zinan Wang,Xinhao Yang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究了二元单位权重序列在总绝对变化代价下确定性校准距离C与分数松弛L之间的离线差距，将原有上界改进为紧的Θ(T^(1/3))量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Qiao和Zheng（2024）此前给出C ≤ L + O(√T)的上界，但该上界不够紧，需要确定C与L之间离线差距的精确最坏情况阶。

Method: 定义Δ_T为长度T输入上C-L的上确界，通过构造性下界与通用上界分析，并针对稀疏预测（m个不同预测值）及有理数预测/精度情形设计多项式时间无网格算法。

Result: 证明T^(1/3)/1000 ≤ Δ_T ≤ 41T^(1/3)（T≥216）；对任意输入有C ≤ L + m，且稀疏最坏情况阶为Θ(m)；有理数情形下多项式时间算法给出B ≤ L ≤ U，U-B < η，并构造代价至多U+m的精确校准紧致修复。

Conclusion: 确定性校准距离与分数松弛之间的离线差距最坏情况为Θ(T^(1/3))，稀疏情形为Θ(m)，且有理数预测下可高效求得近似校准与低代价紧致修复。

Abstract: We study the offline gap between deterministic calibration distance C and its fractional relaxation L for binary unit-weight sequences under total absolute-change cost. We sharpen the offline comparison C <= L + O(sqrt(T)) (Qiao and Zheng, 2024, Theorem 2) to the sharp worst-case order Theta(T^(1/3)). If Delta_T is the supremum of C - L over length-T inputs, then T^(1/3)/1000 <= Delta_T <= 41T^(1/3) for T >= 216. The upper bound holds for every input, while each T >= 216 has a rational lower-bound input. For every input with m distinct forecasts, C <= L + m, and the unrestricted-sample worst-case sparse order is Theta(m). For rational forecasts and accuracy, with binary-encoded multiplicities of separately assignable unit identities, a grid-free polynomial-bit-time procedure returns B <= L <= U, U - B < eta, and an exactly calibrated compact repair of cost at most U + m <= L + m + eta.

</details>


### [220] [Language models can notice an impossible engineering problem yet still report it as solved](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06668)
*Shaoliang Yang,Jun Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究测试了14个语言模型在30对力学问题上的表现，每对包含一个有效版本和一个因修改给定值或假设而变得不可能的问题，旨在区分模型解决有效问题的能力与拒绝不可能问题的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型能起草工程计算，但答案准确性不能表明它们是否能拒绝不可能的问题，因此需要评估模型对问题缺陷的识别与拒绝能力。

Method: 测试14个模型在30对力学问题上的表现，每对含有效版和不可能版；两个独立求解器验证答案并确认每个缺陷问题物理上不可能；分别评分有效问题解决和缺陷问题拒绝；初始提示未警告问题可能有缺陷；后续对四个模型重测，提供“flawed”选项并要求命名和解释缺陷。

Result: 在三个近期模型共90次回复中，12次未能拒绝缺陷问题；其中11次模型指出了缺陷、回答了修正后的问题，但仍报告原问题为“已解决”。重测中，三个模型拒绝率显著提高，但三个模型有效问题解决率下降。

Conclusion: 评估需要同时评分有效和缺陷版本，并区分缺陷识别与报告状态。

Abstract: Language models draft engineering calculations, but answer accuracy does not show whether they reject an impossible problem. We tested 14 models on 30 pairs of mechanics problems, each with a valid version and one made impossible by changing a given value or assumption. Two independent solvers verified every answer key and showed that each flawed problem was physically impossible. We scored solving of valid problems separately from rejection of their flawed counterparts. Each reply required a "solved" or "cannot solve" status; rejection meant "cannot solve" or withholding an answer. The initial prompts did not warn that problems could be flawed. Across three recent models, 12 of 90 replies failed to reject a flawed problem. In 11 of these replies, the model stated the flaw, answered a corrected problem and still reported the original as "solved", according to artificial intelligence raters and numerical checks. We later retested four models from one provider, offering "flawed" instead of "cannot solve" and asking them to name and explain the defect. Three models showed statistically significant increases in rejection, but valid-problem solving fell in three. Evaluations therefore need to score both versions and distinguish flaw recognition from the reported status.

</details>


### [221] [The Pushback Paradox: A Two-Probe Diagnostic for Language Model Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06673)
*Stefan Bühler,David Exler,Markus Reischl,Mark Schutera*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一个双探针基准，用主动探针测可利用性、被动探针测可停止性，合成合规指数κ来定位语言模型在顺从-抵抗谱上的位置，并评测了12个模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型对用户指令的合规程度存在两难：始终合规可被停止但也可被利用，始终抵抗则既不可利用也不可停止，因此需要一个可量化的谱系定位方法。

Method: 设计两个探针：主动探针中用户指令模型行动并接受较低收益，测量可利用性；被动探针中用户指令模型等待并放弃较高收益，测量可停止性；两者合规率合成合规指数κ。对12个语言模型进行评测。

Result: 七个模型在两个探针中大多遵循指令，并以指令为由为其行为辩护；仅Claude Sonnet-4.6和Claude Opus-4.7可被停止且不可被利用；Claude Opus-4.6和GPT-5-mini抵抗两种指令；没有模型是可被利用但不可被停止的。

Conclusion: 了解语言模型在合规指数κ上的位置对人类操作者和多智能体系统（无论分布式还是编排式）都很重要。

Abstract: Are language models compliant with user instructions? A model that always complies can be stopped but also exploited, while one that always resists can be neither exploited nor stopped. We contribute an open two-probe benchmark that can place any language model on this spectrum. In the active probe, a user instructs the model to act and accept a lower payoff, which measures exploitability. In the passive probe, the user instructs it to wait and give up a higher payoff, which measures stoppability. The two compliance rates combine into a compliance index $κ$. Applied to twelve language models, the benchmark shows that seven mostly follow the instruction in both probes and justify their action by pointing to the instruction. Only Claude Sonnet-4.6 and Claude Opus-4.7 can be stopped without being exploitable, Claude Opus-4.6 and GPT-5-mini resist both instructions, and no model is exploitable but unstoppable. Knowing where a language model sits on the compliance index $κ$ matters for human operators and for multi-agent systems, whether distributed or orchestrated.

</details>


### [222] [Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06790)
*Je Yang,Ivan Lobov,Thomas Karpati*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出BTTF端到端智能体验证框架，将仿真数据转为SQLite数据库，并用多智能体将自然语言查询转为SQL，在150个查询基准上达到95.33%执行准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI依赖数十亿晶体管的SoC，但芯片验证工作流仍高度依赖人工；现有LLM在EDA中的应用约74.6%集中于静态RTL代码生成，仿真后验证与交互式波形调试几乎空白。

Method: BTTF将大规模非结构化仿真转储提炼为规范化关系型SQLite数据库，并耦合协作式多智能体编排引擎，把自然语言验证查询翻译为模式感知的SQL，同时将信号异常与版本化RTL仓库关联。

Result: 在包含150个查询的基准测试中，BTTF取得了95.33%的执行准确率。

Conclusion: BTTF填补了仿真后验证与波形调试的基础设施空白，为自主EDA验证提供了一条可行路径。

Abstract: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. Across a 150-query benchmark, BTTF attains 95.33% execution accuracy, charting a practical path toward autonomous EDA verification.

</details>


### [223] [TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06824)
*Oliver Jaffe,Dane Sherburn*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出TasteVal基准，用计算效率量化前沿模型的实验研究品味，最佳模型Opus 5.5超越人类专家基线，且该能力正快速提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究品味（选择有趣问题、设计实验、解读结果）是AI进展预测的关键输入，但缺乏可量化评估实验部分的能力。

Method: 定义实验研究品味为计算效率（达到专家同等分数所需串行实验计算量），构建8个开放前沿AI研发任务，由Researcher模型迭代设计实验、固定Coder执行，预算为40 H100小时或120小时墙钟时间，招募24名人类专家建立基线，评估2023-2026年发布的20个模型。

Result: 最佳模型Opus 5.5超过专家基线，计算乘数为2.3x（95% CI 1.15-4.37），单次运行成本约为基线者平均的1/30；前沿模型计算乘数自2025年12月起约每3.0个月翻倍（95% CI 1.7-5.0），而2023年至2025年12月为每14个月；按最终归一化性能则无趋势断点，每14.6个月翻倍。

Conclusion: 实验研究品味可被量化为计算乘数，前沿模型在该维度已超越人类专家并加速提升，但按最终性能衡量增速未变，表明品味提升尚未转化为整体性能的加速。

Abstract: We introduce TasteVal, a benchmark to evaluate the experimental research taste of frontier models. We define research taste as the ability to pick interesting problems to solve, design experiments, and interpret experimental results. TasteVal measures the experimental component of research taste; given a fixed research problem, we measure how well a model iteratively designs experiments and draws conclusions from their outcomes. We operationalize experimental research taste as compute efficiency; a Researcher who reaches the same score as an expert human using half the serial experimental compute has twice the experimental taste. Experimental taste thus acts as a multiplier on experimental compute, making it a key input to forecasts of AI progress. TasteVal consists of 8 novel, challenging, open-ended tasks representative of frontier AI R&D. To isolate taste from coding ability, the model under evaluation acts as a Researcher that iteratively designs experiments while a fixed Coder agent implements them and reports their results. The Researcher executes until either the 40 H100 hour or 120 wall-clock hour budgets are exhausted. We recruit 24 human experts, at least 2 per task, and take the best expert attempt per task as the expert baseline. We evaluate 20 models released between 2023 and 2026. The best-performing model, Opus 5.5, exceeds our expert baseline, with a compute multiplier of 2.3x (95% CI 1.15-4.37), at roughly 1/30 of our baseliners' average per-run cost. On TasteVal, the compute multiplier of frontier models has doubled approximately every 3.0 months since December 2025 (95% CI 1.7-5.0), up from every 14 months between 2023 and December 2025. Measured by final normalized performance, frontier models show no trend break, doubling every 14.6 months. To keep TasteVal uncontaminated, we do not release the tasks.

</details>


### [224] [Inferring physical fields in coupled systems with unknown parameters from incomplete observations using physics-constrained attentive neural operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05723)
*Shilun Wei,Xiaoqiang Sun,Wei Li,Kejun Tang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种机器学习框架，仅利用单物理场的稀疏观测，同时重建耦合系统的所有物理场并识别未知参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决耦合系统中多物理场需同时重建、参数未知、观测仅限单个物理场且稀疏的挑战。

Method: 采用交叉注意力编码器将稀疏传感器观测映射到规则网格生成传感器条件隐表示，以Fourier神经算子（FNO）解码器捕获全局空间依赖重建所有耦合场；通过最小化观测损失、控制方程残差和边界/初始条件约束联合优化网络参数与未知物理参数。

Result: 在二维和三维顶盖驱动方腔流、二维圆柱尾流及二维非理想磁流体动力学问题上验证，能够从非完整观测中恢复未观测场和物理参数。

Conclusion: 该框架可有效实现未知耦合物理系统的全场重建与参数辨识，具有跨问题泛化能力。

Abstract: Given incomplete measurements of a single physical field in a coupled system with unknown parameters, can we infer its full physical state and identify the underlying parameters? This problem is challenging because multiple coupled fields must be reconstructed simultaneously from limited observations of only one, while the system parameters are unknown. In this work, we propose a machine learning framework for full-field reconstruction and parameter identification of unknown physical systems from sparse observations of a single physical field. Specifically, the cross-attention encoder propagates sparse sensor observations onto a regular grid to construct a sensor-conditioned latent representation, while a Fourier neural operator (FNO) decoder captures global spatial dependencies to reconstruct all coupled physical fields. The network parameters and unknown physical parameters are jointly optimized by minimizing observation losses, governing equation residuals, and boundary/initial condition constraints. The proposed approach is validated on two- and three-dimensional lid-driven cavity flows, a two-dimensional cylinder wake, and a two-dimensional non-ideal magnetohydrodynamics problem, demonstrating the recovery performance of unobserved fields and physical parameters from incomplete observations.

</details>


### [225] [Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05809)
*Lucas Rencker,Omid Tajalizadehkhoob,Khalid Elsayed,Artem Khachaturiants,Helda Pahlavani,Yan Guo,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的SPM图像分辨率增强框架，通过神经网络提高测量图像分辨率以提取关键参数，并利用迁移学习实现模型复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点需要亚纳米分辨率且不牺牲吞吐量的计量方法，而高吞吐量SPM工具虽已用于HVM，但进一步缩短成像时间仍需提升分辨率。

Method: 设计神经网络分辨率增强器，并采用迁移学习，用100 nm间距线/空结构的小数据集重新训练和校准预训练模型。

Result: 在200 nm间距线/空结构测量中验证了框架有效性，并证明迁移学习可使模型适应略有不同的结构。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效增强SPM图像分辨率，迁移学习支持预训练模型复用，减少新结构所需数据量。

Abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. We showcase the effectiveness of this framework using measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 200 nm. For the reusability of a pre-developed pre-trained model, we additionally leverage transfer learning and show that a new model for slightly differing structures can be re-trained and calibrated with a smaller data set of measurements performed on Line/Space structures with a pitch of 100 nm.

</details>


### [226] [Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05812)
*Yan Guo,Helda Pahlavani,Artem Khachaturiants,Khalid Elsayed,Jakob van de Laar,Erik Simons,Niranjan Saikumar,Hamed Sadeghian*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用框架，利用高速扫描探针显微镜图像训练机器学习网络，用于先进半导体节点工艺控制中的特征检测与缺陷识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进半导体节点工艺控制对计量设备的分辨率、吞吐量和数据丰富度要求日益提高，3D结构和EUV时代随机缺陷增加导致需要开发层和设备的专用图像处理算法，而机器学习可加速这一算法开发过程。

Method: 建立一个通用框架，将从高速扫描探针显微镜系统获得的图像用于训练网络，以实现参数提取的特征检测或缺陷识别。

Result: 该框架能够利用高速扫描探针显微镜图像训练网络，支持特征检测和缺陷识别两类任务。

Conclusion: 基于机器学习的图像处理方法可加速先进半导体工艺控制中专用算法的开发，所提通用框架为利用高速扫描探针显微镜图像训练网络提供了基础。

Abstract: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. With the emergence of ML-based image processing methods, this process of algorithm development for both cases can be accelerated. In this work, we provide the general framework under which the images obtained from high-speed scanning probe microscopy-based systems can be used to train a network for either feature detection for parameter extraction or defect identification.

</details>


### [227] [The Blind Spot Paradox: When Adaptive Classifiers Defeat Drift Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05853)
*Raphaël Minato,Fabrice Popineau,Arpad Rimmel,Bich-Liên Doan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 自适应分类器的内部更新会掩盖概念漂移，导致外部累积检测器失效，论文量化了这一盲区边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在自适应分类器（如ARF）中，模型自身更新循环与基于误差流的概念漂移检测器之间的操作冲突，即内部适应速度超过证据积累时，累积检测器（CUSUM、Page-Hinkley）无法达到阈值而漏检漂移。

Method: 对自适应随机森林（ARF）进行插桩分析，追踪漂移后误差瞬态的消除机制；推导有限时域边界，测量临界幅度下限（Δe_c = 0.120）；在合成漂移、ARMA-GARCH序列（ProteuS）和表格基准（BAF、INSECTS）上验证。

Result: 存活树仅通过增量叶更新就吸收了漂移后98.6%的误差瞬态；首次背景树交换仅贡献0.71%的消除误差量，却使外部检测率下降31个百分点。在标准阈值下，合成扫描中盲区出现在Δe≈0.25，而经典基准SEA（Δe≤0.21）未达到该盲区。低于Δe_c=0.120时，虚警预算阻止检测。

Conclusion: 自适应分类器的内部更新会造成概念漂移检测的盲区，表现为平稳流上的漏检和噪声基线上由内部树交换触发的虚警泛滥；经典基准因漂移幅度不足而未能暴露此问题。

Abstract: Monitoring concept drift from an adaptive classifier's error stream creates an operational conflict with the model's own update loop. When internal adaptation outpaces evidence accumulation, accuracy recovers before cumulative detectors (CUSUM, Page-Hinkley) can reach threshold. Instrumenting an Adaptive Random Forest (ARF) shows that surviving trees absorb 98.6% of the post-drift error transient through incremental leaf updates alone. The first background tree swap accounts for just 0.71% of this erased error volume, but drops external detection rates by 31 percentage points. We derive the finite-horizon boundary where cumulative evidence fails to cross threshold and measure a critical magnitude floor ($Δe_c = 0.120$) below which false-alarm budgets preclude detection. This failure manifests as missed shifts on stationary streams and false-alarm flooding triggered by internal tree swaps on noisy baselines. We validate on synthetic shifts, ARMA-GARCH series (ProteuS), and tabular benchmarks (BAF, INSECTS); on the synthetic sweep at a standard threshold, the blind spot appears at $Δe \approx 0.25$, showing why classical benchmarks like SEA ($Δe \le 0.21$) failed to reach it.

</details>


### [228] [On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05902)
*Matteo Fregonara,Tom Viering,Jan van Gemert*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文质疑“禁止在测试集上调超参数”的教条，通过实证研究测试集调参对性能膨胀的影响，发现其效应虽真实但常小于其他噪声，且模型排名基本不变，呼吁更细致看待并公开报告测试集调参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习领域普遍将测试集调参视为严重错误甚至学术欺诈，但实践中确实存在，因此需要量化其实际后果，以判断该禁令是否合理。

Method: 在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10及GLUE基准的三个任务上，系统比较在测试集与验证集上调超参数所导致的性能差异，并分析模型选择与排名变化。

Result: 测试集调参会造成真实且显著的性能膨胀，但幅度常小于其他噪声源；许多情况下，测试集调参与验证集调参得到完全相同的模型；模型排名在测试集调参后基本保持不变。

Conclusion: 一致的测试集调参未必会破坏基准或模型选择，应更细致地看待该行为，并鼓励研究者公开报告测试集调参情况。

Abstract: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

</details>


### [229] [Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05919)
*Nilushika Udayangani Hewa Dehigahawattage,Kishor Nandakishor,Marimuthu Palaniswami*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于单腕加速度计的可穿戴癫痫发作检测系统，采用时间序列ResNet深度神经网络，在79名患者中实现了高灵敏度和低误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前癫痫监测依赖昂贵的视频脑电图（VEEG），需要专业知识和住院环境，且具有侵入性；而癫痫日记因漏报而不可靠，导致治疗决策错误。因此，需要一种更耐受、可行的长期动态监测方案。

Method: 招募79名在VEEG监测下的患者佩戴加速度计设备收集数据，由认证癫痫专家审查同步VEEG记录生成发作起始、结束和类型标注。基于这些数据构建了基于时间序列ResNet架构的深度神经网络，用于区分发作与非发作事件。

Result: 在总计5576小时的记录评估中，发作检测灵敏度达95.65%，总体误报率为0.15次/24小时。在20名经历46次惊厥性发作的患者中，AUC-ROC为0.98，AUC-PRC为0.67。

Conclusion: 该发作检测系统有望用于长期动态癫痫监测。未来步骤包括在更大数据集中验证结果，并评估对其他发作类型的检测效用。

Abstract: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

</details>


### [230] [Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06006)
*Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文排队赌博机（CQB），提出WISE算法，在无已知时域、无协方差下界条件下实现速率最优的队列长度遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有衰减遗憾保证要么衰减速率次优，要么需要已知固定时域，且假设上下文级松弛和特征协方差最小特征值严格为正。本文旨在放宽这些限制并达到速率最优。

Method: 提出WISE（Widest Interval Selection with Elimination）算法。分析采用工作负载势函数度量等待作业在其最佳服务器上所需的期望服务尝试次数，其非空轮次漂移结合容量松弛保证的负项与次优服务选择的误差；再用椭圆势计数限制WISE选择宽置信区间的频率，从而限制大服务误差轮数。

Result: WISE在足够大的任意时间实现速率最优的\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})队列长度遗憾且无需已知时域。改进了现有下界对到达率的依赖，并显式给出其对特征维度和服务器数量的依赖；证明了另一个下界，量化归一化容量松弛减小时遗憾的增加，这是CQB的首个此类下界。仿真显示即使上下文级松弛失效，遗憾仍很小。

Conclusion: WISE在更弱假设下达到速率最优队列长度遗憾，并深化了CQB的下界理论，为上下文排队赌博机提供了更鲁棒且理论完备的解决方案。

Abstract: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

</details>


### [231] [Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06012)
*Giulio Viganò,Simone Melzi,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该工作从谱几何与算子理论视角研究Transformer注意力，将每个注意力头视为token序列上函数Hilbert空间之间的泛函映射，并推导出Token Difference Operator，用其谱结构刻画token空间信息路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准欧氏谱受sink影响存在结构性偏差，将质量集中与真实路由能力混为一谈，因此需要一种能解耦sink效应与路由能力的谱描述，并统一解释sink、路由崩溃与输出维度。

Method: 将token空间重新置于注意力诱导的内在概率几何中，构造Token Difference Operator，分析其谱结构与token空间信息到输出的路由关系，并基于该谱几何提出新的注意力不确定性估计器。

Result: 内在概率几何下的token difference谱能够将sink效应与路由能力解耦，给出头输出维度的谱刻画，并统一解释注意力图、sink、路由崩溃与输出维度；所提出的不确定性估计器与基于概率的分数互补，在长上下文输入上增益最大。

Conclusion: 该研究为注意力机制提供了统一的算子理论分析框架，表明谱几何可有效刻画注意力路由与输出维度，并为注意力启发式方法提供理论支撑，尤其在长上下文场景中具有实用价值。

Abstract: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

</details>


### [232] [GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06042)
*Azlaan Mustafa Samad,Wei Zhang,Adèle H Ribeiro*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出GO4CD算法，利用基因本体（GO）构建多粒度且更易满足可容许性的基因分区，结合CLOC进行簇级因果发现，在大肠杆菌调控子网络中显著降低不可容许分区比例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维基因调控网络因果发现计算困难且因密集连接难以解释；将基因分组为功能模块可提升可处理性与生物学可解释性，但现有簇级因果发现方法依赖预定义可容许分区，并要求簇间图无环，构建此类分区困难。

Method: GO4CD基于GO将参与同一生物过程的基因分组，并通过本体层次传播基因注释以获得不同粒度分区，偏好更可能可容许的分区；将其与Causal Learning over Clusters（CLOC）集成，在条件独立预言机及模拟基因表达数据上，使用多元条件独立检验评估真实马尔可夫等价类的恢复。

Result: 在多个大肠杆菌调控子网络上评估，GO4CD不可容许情况占18.1%，而语义相似度基线为65.3%–82.3%。

Conclusion: GO4CD更适合学习定义在具有生物学意义的基因簇上的因果基因调控网络。

Abstract: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple E.coli regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.

</details>


### [233] [Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06062)
*Pavamana K J,Chandramani Singh*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出激励感知的联邦多玩家多臂老虎机框架，并设计Buying-UCB算法，在玩家自利场景下平衡探索与协作，理论分析群组遗憾和购买成本上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦多臂老虎机框架假设所有玩家自愿共享观测，但实际中自利玩家缺乏参与协作的激励。

Method: 构建激励感知联邦老虎机框架，玩家共享信息获奖励、购买信息付成本；提出基于UCB的Buying-UCB算法，将共享激励与信息获取成本融入学习过程。

Result: 推导出群组遗憾和购买成本的上界，刻画完全协作联邦学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡；大量数值实验验证理论并展示不同协作与定价机制下的有效性。

Conclusion: 激励感知框架与Buying-UCB算法能有效应对自利玩家的协作问题，为联邦顺序决策提供激励兼容的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.

</details>


### [234] [On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06096)
*Nessim Ben Abbes,Duc Han Le,Sabri Mtibaa,Van-Tam Nguyen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 在图像-文本-表格三模态自监督学习中，增加第三模态反而常导致性能下降，称为多模态饱和；作者提出基于黎曼几何的R-VICReg来缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习中通常认为增加第三模态应提升或至少保持性能，但实验发现三模态模型在多数配对运行中不如其最佳双模态子集，需要解释并解决这一反直觉的失败现象。

Method: 在九个图像-文本-表格数据集上，使用VICReg和SimSiam进行配对实验，统计三模态与最佳双模态子集的性能对比；提出Riemannian VICReg（R-VICReg），在可学习的负曲率乘积因子上以平方测地距离对齐视图，并在曲率趋零时退化为经典VICReg。

Result: VICReg下55.6%的配对运行中三模态模型劣于最佳双模态子集，SimSiam下为51.1%；在45次配对运行中，R-VICReg将第三模态带来提升的概率从44.4%提高到64.4%，增益集中在VICReg饱和之处。

Conclusion: 多模态饱和源于对齐几何，R-VICReg通过黎曼几何对齐有效缓解该失败，使第三模态更可能带来性能提升。

Abstract: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.

</details>


### [235] [Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06128)
*Abhishek Srinivasan,Juan Carlos Andresen,Sepideh Pashami,Anders Holst*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种概率融合框架，将基于磨损的生存模型与基于传感器的深度学习模型集成，用于剩余寿命预测，并在多个N-CMAPSS数据集上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剩余寿命预测方法中，基于磨损的累积退化模型和基于传感器的瞬时健康模型各自只能提供部分信息，需要融合两者以提高预测的准确性和鲁棒性。

Method: 基于磨损、潜在健康、传感器观测和失效之间的显式结构假设，推导出原则性的组合规则，实现不确定性感知的自适应加权融合；其中磨损组件用参数生存模型学习，传感器组件用1D-CNN与事后不确定性模型学习。

Result: 在多个N-CMAPSS数据集上，融合模型相比单一组件提升了点预测精度，保持了C-index，并产生了更窄且校准良好的预测区间。

Conclusion: 基于磨损的生存模型和基于传感器的深度学习模型具有互补作用，其概率融合为全生命周期内更鲁棒、更一致的预测性维护提供了结构化路径。

Abstract: Predictive maintenance requires reliable remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: wear-based aging models that capture cumulative degradation and sensor-driven data models that reflect instantaneous health conditions, each providing only partial information. In this work, we propose a probabilistic fusion framework that integrates wear-based and sensor-based prognostic components through failure probability distributions. Based on explicit structural assumptions linking wear, latent health, sensor observations, and failure, we derive a principled combination rule that enables uncertainty-aware integration with adaptive weighting of the components. Experimentally, we assess this combination rule by learning the wear-based component using a parametric survival model and the sensor-based component using a 1D convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a post-hoc uncertainty model. Evaluation on multiple N-CMAPSS datasets demonstrates that the fused model improves point accuracy, preserves the C-index, and produces narrower yet well-calibrated prediction intervals compared to either component alone. The results highlight the complementary roles of wear-based survival model and sensor-based deep learning model, and show that their probabilistic integration provides a structured pathway toward more robust and consistent prognostics over the life-time.

</details>


### [236] [Machine learning for journal entry testing: A type-aware evaluation of anomaly detectors under a review budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06133)
*Jan Gronewald,Michel Scherer,Nijat Mehdiyev*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出类型感知评估框架，用FSR等指标替代传统ROC-AUC，揭示日志异常检测中高命中率掩盖的类型盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统评估忽略审查预算和异常类型，导致高命中率可能只集中于单一类型，无法反映检测器真实覆盖能力。

Method: 定义每类型召回、公平份额类型召回（FSR）、类型覆盖和首次命中排名；在四个真实客户账本（注入类型化异常）和一个公开合成账本上评估九种无监督检测器、一个监督参考及DeepSAD。

Result: 最大客户账本上PCA、AE、VAE前100条平均命中98个异常但至少95.8属同一类型；FSR偏好kNN并在三个账本上改变最优检测器；编码方式影响未见账户检测；公开账本上HBOS和ECOD在1386条内覆盖全部八种标记，而kNN在1000条时领先但交叉清算首次命中排名4641；DeepSAD将每100次审查平均命中从40.0提至68.3，但类型覆盖仅从2.7升至3.0。

Conclusion: 高命中率可掩盖系统性盲点，反馈驱动方法可能强化现有检测模式而不扩大异常覆盖，需采用类型感知评估。

Abstract: Journal entry anomaly detectors are commonly evaluated on the full population with ROC-AUC, precision and recall, ignoring the review budget and which anomaly types are found. We propose a type-aware evaluation combining per-type recall, fair-share type recall (FSR), which caps each type's credit at its budget share, type coverage and first-hit rank. We evaluate nine unsupervised detectors, a supervised reference and feedback-driven Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD) on four real client ledgers with injected typed anomalies and a public synthetic ledger. On the largest client ledger, principal component analysis (PCA), an autoencoder (AE) and a variational autoencoder (VAE) each place on average 98 anomalies among the first 100 postings, but at least 95.8 belong to one type. FSR instead favours a nearest-neighbour (kNN) detector and changes the top-ranked detector on three of four client ledgers. Representation also matters: one-hot encoding exposes unseen accounts, whereas frequency encoding leaves unseen contra accounts largely undetected. On the public ledger, the Histogram-Based Outlier Score (HBOS) and Empirical Cumulative Distribution-Based Outlier Detection (ECOD) reach all eight markings within 1,386 entries, whereas kNN, the hit leader at 1,000 entries, first reaches cross-linked clearing at rank 4,641, and the supervised row-level reference misses this marking within 1,000 entries. There, the adaptive DeepSAD review protocol raises mean hits per 100 reviews from 40.0 to 68.3 but type coverage only from 2.7 to 3.0. These findings show that high hit rates can conceal systematic blind spots and suggest that feedback can reinforce existing detection patterns without broadening anomaly coverage.

</details>


### [237] [SO(3)-RoPE for Spherical Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06229)
*Christian Libner,Chase van de Geijn,Alexander S. Ecker,Maurice Weiler*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出SO(3)-RoPE相对位置编码，将球面几何通过SO(3)酉表示融入Transformer注意力，构建SO(3)等变且兼容FlashAttention的SO3ViT，用于球面浅水动力学预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 球面数据广泛存在于科学应用中，但现有球面Transformer常忽略底层球面域的几何结构，导致极点附近的畸变和坐标奇异。

Method: 设计SO(3)-RoPE相对位置嵌入，利用SO(3)酉表示在注意力中编码球面几何，保证SO(3)等变性，并与FlashAttention兼容以维持原版Transformer的效率。

Result: 在旋转球面上的浅水动力学预测任务中，SO3ViT相比S2Transformer基线误差更低且运行时间更短。

Conclusion: SO(3)-RoPE能有效将球面几何引入Transformer注意力，在保持效率的同时提升球面动力学预测的精度与速度。

Abstract: Spherical data arise in many scientific applications. Often spherical transformers disregard the geometry of the underlying spherical domain, causing distortions and coordinate singularities near the poles. We introduce SO(3)-RoPE, a relative positional embedding that incorporates spherical geometry into transformer attention through unitary SO(3) representations. Our formulation is SO(3)-equivariant and compatible with FlashAttention, retaining efficiency of vanilla transformers. On shallow water dynamics prediction over a rotating sphere, our SO3ViT outperforms an S2Transformer baseline with lower errors and reduced runtime.

</details>


### [238] [SPDAlign: Interpretable Riemannian Alignment for EEG Forward Modeling Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06315)
*Shanglin Li,Shiwen Chu,Okan Koç,Chenyu Liu,Qibin Zhao,Motoaki Kawanabe,Mitsuo Kawato,Yi Ding*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出SPDAlign框架，利用黎曼流形上的线性变换实现无监督域自适应，解决EEG分布偏移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG非平稳性导致跨域分布偏移，传统方法需要昂贵的有标签校准数据。

Method: 基于EEG生成模型分析域特定前向过程引起的偏移，理论证明可在对称正定流形上通过线性变换恢复；SPDAlign先对齐域均值，再用Wasserstein Procrustes校正全局旋转。

Result: 在仿真实验中系统验证，并在多个公开EEG数据集上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: SPDAlign是全局线性且可解释的框架，能识别感兴趣频段、确定反映源-传感器关系的空间模式，并处理跨受试者变异性。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and communication. However, their practical utility is often limited as the non-stationary nature of the EEG data introduces distribution shifts across domains (e.g., sessions and subjects). Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drastically improve the utility of EEG data. In this work, we use a classic generative model of EEG to study distribution shifts introduced by the domain-specific forward process, which is associated with factors such as head geometry. We theoretically show that such distribution shifts can be recovered solely through linear transformations on the Symmetric Positive Definite manifold. Building on this insight, we propose SPDAlign, an interpretable framework for promoting domain-invariant EEG learning. SPDAlign first aligns the domain-specific means and corrects global rotations across domains using a recent optimal transport technique called Wasserstein Procrustes. We systematically study the proposed approach through simulations and demonstrate its competitive performance on extensive public EEG datasets. Additionally, SPDAlign is a globally linear framework and is intrinsically interpretable, so that the framework can identify frequency ranges of interest, determine the spatial patterns reflecting source-sensor relationships, and address cross-subject variability.

</details>


### [239] [Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06344)
*Junyou Zhu,Langzhou He,Fenying Cai,Christian Nauck,Ping Xiong,Chao Gao,Philip S. Yu,Klaus-Robert Müller,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文针对深度图神经网络中的过平滑问题，提出了基于主稳定性函数的统一模态稳定性分析框架，并据此设计了稳定性塑形深度图学习（SDGL）方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增加深度可扩大感受野，但常导致过平滑，即节点表示趋于一致，限制了深度GNN的性能。现有方法缺乏对过平滑的理论刻画。

Method: 将层深度视为时间、层更新视为图耦合动力学，把过平滑解释为特征的不良动态同步，利用主稳定性曲线评估同步稳定性。基于该理论，提出SDGL，包含两个互补实例：一个通过诱导受控图灵不稳定性以空间模式形成替代同步，另一个保持稳定的近临界传播。

Result: 在多种节点级和图级基准上，SDGL展现出更好的深度可扩展性，并相较于强基线取得一致的精度提升，包括具有长程依赖的图。

Conclusion: 该工作为深度GNN过平滑提供了统一的动力学稳定性理论工具，并验证了基于稳定性塑形的SDGL能有效缓解过平滑、提升深度模型性能。

Abstract: In deep graph neural networks, increasing depth enlarges the receptive field but often leads to over-smoothing, where node representations tend to align. We develop a unified, mode-wise stability framework for deep GNN propagation that provides a principled characterization of over-smoothing. By interpreting layer depth as time and layer updates as graph-coupled dynamics, over-smoothing can be understood as an undesirable dynamical synchronization of features, for which the master stability curve provides a theoretical tool to assess the stability of synchrony. Guided by this theory, we further propose Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning (SDGL) to mitigate over-smoothing in deep GNNs. SDGL has two complementary instantiations: one induces controlled Turing instability to replace synchronization with spatial pattern formation, and the other maintains stable near-critical propagation. Experiments on diverse node- and graph-level benchmarks demonstrate the improved depth scaling and consistent accuracy gains over strong baselines, including graphs exhibiting long-range dependencies.

</details>


### [240] [Multimodal Deep Survival Analysis for Sinkhole Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06365)
*Lucas Yuan,Minhee Kim,Zihan Li,Chunli Dai,Sanduni S. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage,Ming Ye,Kani Fu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出多模态Cox比例风险框架预测岩溶地区天坑易发性，将未报告位置视为右删失而非负样本，并在佛罗里达州案例中验证多模态融合优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天坑在岩溶地形中广泛分布，佛罗里达州因可溶碳酸盐岩、浅地下水和强降雨使塌陷普遍且空间异质。预测天坑位置与时间存在两大难题：无报告天坑位置不能直接标为真负样本；风险因素跨异构数据模态，需统一建模框架整合。

Method: 扩展Cox比例风险模型至多模态异构输入，采用模态特定编码器与跨模态融合层；将未报告位置作为右删失处理而非硬负标签，基于预测生存函数输出连续、时间感知的易发性；在佛罗里达州开展全州案例研究，使用空间分块验证与消融实验。

Result: 佛罗里达州案例研究表明，该方法能有效对天坑风险排序，并生成捕捉天坑发生空间变化的全州易发性地图；消融实验量化了多模态整合的收益。

Conclusion: 所提多模态Cox比例风险框架可同时解决未报告位置标注与异构数据整合问题，为天坑易发性预测提供连续、时间感知且空间分辨的风险图，多模态融合相比单模态具有可量化优势。

Abstract: Sinkholes are a widespread geohazard in karst terrain. In Florida, soluble carbonate bedrock, shallow groundwater, and intense rainfall combine to make subsidence both common and spatially heterogeneous. Predicting where and when sinkholes will occur is difficult for two reasons. First, locations without reported sinkholes cannot be directly labeled or sampled as true negative locations. Second, the potential factors governing sinkhole risk span heterogeneous data modalities and therefore require careful integration within a unified modeling framework. We address both problems with our proposed model, a multimodal Cox proportional hazards framework for sinkhole susceptibility. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend the proportional-hazards formulation to heterogeneous multimodal input through modality-specific encoders and a cross-modal fusion layer. Second, we treat unreported locations as right-censored rather than negative, avoiding hard-negative labeling and yielding continuous, time-aware susceptibility from the predicted survival function. Third, a statewide Florida case study with spatially blocked validation and ablation studies quantifies the benefit of multimodal integration. A Florida case study demonstrates that the proposed method effectively ranks sinkhole risk and produces a statewide susceptibility map that captures spatial variations in sinkhole occurrence.

</details>


### [241] [A Physics-Guided Transformer Framework for Electromigration Analysis in Multi-Segment Interconnects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06464)
*Pavlos Stoikos,Anuj Pathania,George Floros*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种物理引导的Transformer框架，对多段互连线进行快速电迁移应力预测，在IBM电源网格基准上实现低于8%的相对L2误差和最高2459.68倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工艺节点缩小导致电流密度上升，电迁移成为片上互连主要可靠性问题；识别易退化线需要准确的瞬态应力分析，但基于物理的求解器在大量互连上计算代价过高。

Method: 将每条线转换为几何与直流感知的分段token，用Transformer注意力捕捉线级上下文；轻量查询解码器预测选定位置与时刻的应力；训练目标结合归一化监督回归、线级相对L2损失以及物理引导的连续性与端通量项。

Result: 在IBM电源网格基准上，相对L2误差低于8%，与矩阵指数求解器相比最高获得2459.68倍加速。

Conclusion: 该物理引导Transformer能在保持较低误差的同时大幅加速多段互连线电迁移应力预测，为大规模互连可靠性分析提供高效替代方案。

Abstract: As technology scales to smaller nodes, increasing current densities make electromigration (EM) one of the dominant reliability challenges in on-chip interconnects. Accurate transient stress analysis is needed to identify wires susceptible to EM degradation, but applying physics-based solvers across many interconnects remains computationally expensive. This paper proposes a physics-guided transformer framework for fast EM stress prediction in multi-segment interconnect lines. The framework converts each line into geometry- and DC-aware segment tokens and uses transformer attention to capture line-level context. A lightweight query decoder then predicts stress at selected locations and time instants. The model is trained with an objective that combines normalized supervised regression, linewise relative-$L_2$ loss, and physics-guided continuity and terminal-flux terms. Experiments on IBM power grid benchmarks show that the proposed model achieves relative-$L_2$ error below 8\% and reaches up to 2459.68$\times$ speedup compared with the matrix exponential~solver.

</details>


### [242] [FairProp: Fair Node Representation Learning via Differentiable Propagation Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06484)
*Emmanouil Kariotakis,Aritra Konar*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究图神经网络中的群体公平性，为节点分类、链接预测和节点回归任务给出了公平性差距的上界，并提出FairProp方法将公平性嵌入传播过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN的消息传递机制会放大拓扑偏差，引发公平性担忧，而现有公平性研究多关注预处理或后处理，缺乏对传播过程本身公平性的理论保证。

Method: 针对三个下游任务推导群体公平性差距上界，识别偏差的两个来源：群体均值分离和最终表示的组内协方差；在APPNP的凸平滑问题中加入凸群体均值约束和组内协方差正则项，通过展开投影梯度下降得到FairProp，其层包含传播步骤和闭式投影，并证明线性收敛到唯一公平最优解。

Result: 节点分类上界不松于先前最紧结果；链接预测首次给出sigmoid激活后预测的公平性差距上界；节点回归首次提供此类上界。三个任务实验表明，仅使用精确群体均值均衡，FairProp也能提供强归纳偏置，在公平性-效用权衡上优于强基线。

Conclusion: 通过理论分析和FairProp方法，将公平性直接嵌入GNN传播过程，可实现可证明的公平性保证和良好的效用权衡。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are the standard tool for node representation learning and are increasingly used in high-stakes settings. Their message-passing backbone, however, can amplify topological bias, raising fairness concerns. We study group fairness at the level of downstream predictions for node classification, link prediction, and node regression, and bound the demographic parity gap for an arbitrary number of sensitive groups. Our node classification bound is provably no looser than the closest prior result. For link prediction, ours is the first bound on the parity gap of the deployed sigmoid-activated prediction rather than a pre-activation proxy, and for node regression we provide the first such bound. Across all three tasks, the analysis identifies two distinct sources of bias: the separation between group means and the within-group covariance of the final representations. Building on this insight, we embed fairness into propagation itself by augmenting the convex smoothing problem underlying APPNP with a convex group-mean constraint and a within-group covariance regularizer. Unfolding projected gradient descent on this problem yields FairProp, whose layers pair a propagation step with a closed-form projection and which provably converges linearly to the unique fair optimum. Experiments on three tasks show that FairProp, even with exact group-mean equalization alone, provides a strong inductive bias that achieves excellent fairness-utility trade-offs against strong baselines.

</details>


### [243] [Conditional Flow Matching for Single-Neuron Electrophysiology: Capturing Multimodal Responses Across Stimuli](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06520)
*Cameron Schofield,Luca Ghafourpour,Philip H. Wong,Costas A. Anastassiou,Richard E. Turner*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种基于条件生成模型（流匹配）的方法，用于单神经元电生理模拟，能够生成同一刺激下多样化的电压响应，克服传统确定性模型和现有机器学习代理的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大脑神经元对相同刺激表现出高度可变的电压响应，传统生物物理详细模型需通过大量确定性参数集合来捕捉这种变异性，计算成本极高；现有机器学习代理模型也仅能映射单一响应，无法体现这种变异性。

Method: 采用条件生成模型，具体为流匹配（flow matching），以输入电流为条件学习速度场，从而对单神经元电生理进行条件生成建模。在两种人类皮层中间神经元类型的生物物理详细模型上进行验证。

Result: 生成的响应在电生理特征分布、锋电位时间结构和兴奋性轮廓上高度复现，甚至与对应人类皮层神经元的实验记录匹配。在阈值附近，同一刺激幅度下可同时存在放电与不放电响应；在高幅度下，集合可分裂为去极化阻滞附近的低放电和高放电模式。模型能恢复这两种模式，而神经算子基线在阈值附近抑制放电，并在去极化阻滞处模糊模式间差距。

Conclusion: 条件生成模型（流匹配）能有效捕捉单神经元电生理的响应变异性，优于传统确定性方法和现有神经算子基线，为生物物理详细神经元建模提供了高效且表达力强的替代方案。

Abstract: Neurons of the brain exhibit a rich repertoire of electrophysiology dynamics with the same repeated stimulus eliciting very different voltage responses from the same cell. One common approach in biophysically detailed models is to capture this variability through ensembles of deterministic parametrizations, at a cost of hundreds of thousands of CPU hours. Existing machine learning surrogates inherit the same limitation, where a stimulus is mapped to a single voltage response. We address this challenge by learning a conditional generative model for single-neuron electrophysiology, using flow matching with a velocity field conditioned on the input current. On biophysically detailed models of two human cortical interneuron types, the generated responses closely reproduce the electrophysiological feature distributions, spike-time structure, and excitability profiles, even matching the experimental recordings from the corresponding human cortical neurons. Near the firing threshold, firing and non-firing responses coexist at the same stimulus amplitude, and at high amplitudes, ensembles may split into low- and high-firing modes near depolarization block. We show that our model recovers both modes in each case, while a neural operator baseline suppresses spiking near threshold and blurs the gap between modes at depolarization block.

</details>


### [244] [Separators Make Carry Propagation Learnable:The Geometry of Latent Carry in a Multiplication Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06605)
*Sama Satariyan,Raphael Cousin,G{é}rard Biau*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 训练小型Llama式Transformer在无思维链条件下学习4x4乘法，发现输入格式（数字间插入空格）将精确匹配准确率从1%提升至89%，进位在残差流中以环形角度编码并被因果使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究Transformer为何在多位数乘法中失败，以及预训练语言模型算术依赖输入范围启发式而非显式进位的可解释性问题。

Method: 从零训练小型Llama风格Transformer，在4x4乘法任务上不使用思维链；对比不同输入格式（是否在数字间插入空格）；通过分析输出位置学习顺序、残差流中进位编码、激活修补实验研究内部机制。

Result: 插入空格使精确匹配准确率从1%升至89%；输出位置按进位链顺序学习，中间数字（长程依赖最长）最后学会；分隔符token的预测槽以环形角度编码进位，不同进位值越多填充环越满；激活修补显示该状态在最后一层前被因果使用，最佳模型某中间列在块4后单独修补预测槽可传递源进位达84%；其他列进位先在相邻答案槽组装再到达自身；剩余错误几乎均为差一错误。

Conclusion: 输入格式对Transformer学习多位数乘法至关重要，模型通过残差流中的环形角度表示进位并因果使用，错误模式与进位或循环数字编码的小误差一致。

Abstract: Transformers asked to multiply multi-digit numbers in a single forward pass often fail, and interpretability studies of pretrained language models find arithmetic solved by input-range heuristics rather than by an explicit carry. We train small Llama-style transformers from scratch on 4x4 multiplication without chain of thought and find that the input format is decisive: inserting a space token between digits raises exact-match accuracy from 1% to 89%. Output positions are learned in carry-chain order, with the middle digits, which have the longest-range dependencies, learned last. Inside the model, the separator token that predicts each digit (its prediction slot) encodes the carry-in as an angle on a ring in the residual stream; examples with more distinct carry values fill more of the ring. Activation patching between examples matched on the column sum shows that this state is causally used before the last layer: patching the prediction slot alone transfers the source carry in up to 84% of cases after block 4 for one middle column of our best model, while for other columns the carry is first assembled at the neighboring answer slot before reaching its own. Remaining errors are almost always off by one, consistent with a small error on the carry or on the circular digit code.

</details>


### [245] [Beyond the Model: The Critical Role of Data Filtering in Clinical Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06640)
*Noah Subedar,Colin Campbell,Wenjing Zhang,Dan Perri,Sarah Culgin,Andrew Hamilton-Wright*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文主张将机器学习中临床数据的过滤决策视为科学方法的一部分，而非常规预处理步骤，并呼吁建立可解释、透明的预处理流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习临床研究常依赖预处理和过滤流程，但这些过滤决策会改变数据统计结构，可能人为降低或增加预测任务复杂度，从而影响结果可靠性。

Method: 通过论证和讨论，分析过滤选择对数据分布和模型性能的影响，强调需要可解释且透明的预处理流程。

Result: 过滤决策会人为改变预测任务复杂度，影响数据分布与模型性能，但当前研究往往忽视其科学意义。

Conclusion: 应将过滤选择作为科学方法的组成部分，并推动可解释、透明的预处理流程，以帮助研究者理解过滤决策的原因及其对数据和模型的影响。源代码已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) studies using clinical data often rely on preprocessing and filtering pipelines before model development. The filtering decisions made in these pipelines can alter the dataset's statistical structure and may artificially reduce or increase the complexity of the prediction task. We argue that filtering choices should be treated as part of the scientific method rather than as a routine preprocessing step. We further discuss the need for explainable and transparent preprocessing pipelines that allow researchers to understand why specific filtering choices are made and how these choices affect the resulting data distribution and model performance. All of the source code for this work is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [246] [TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06657)
*Chengyu Yu,Leon Jacopo Costa,Zoja Anžur,Mohan Li,Gašper Slapničar,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Mitja Luštrek,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: TrustmeWatcher是一个集成应用，连接计算机活动追踪、自我报告数据收集、本地AI预测和可解释性界面，用于工作场所感知研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工作场所感知研究常将行为轨迹与自我报告分开收集，工具与结果界面分离，缺乏整合。

Method: 复用ActivityWatch的OS级监视器收集计算机活动，增加应用层：生成交互式屏幕时间仪表板，同步StreamDeck问卷，对齐活动记录与自我报告为标记数据，用AI本地预测六项状态分数和整体幸福感，通过XAI解释预测，隐私控制可暂停摄像头和眼动仪。

Result: 部署了应用和研究工作流，使用17名参与者的记录，整合了活动回顾、数据收集、隐私控制、本地预测和面向参与者的XAI评估界面。

Conclusion: 该应用和研究工作流成功整合了活动审查、研究数据收集、隐私控制、本地预测及参与者界面，用于XAI评估。

Abstract: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

</details>


### [247] [Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06674)
*Srija Chakraborty*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种联合建模Black Marble M波段与昼夜波段信号的机器学习框架，用于构建可跨区域、季节和异常类别的集成异常检测器，提升夜间灯光异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有夜间灯光异常检测主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号敏感性不足，限制了检测能力。

Method: 提出机器学习框架，同时建模Black Marble M波段和Day/Night Band信号，迭代构建可扩展至不同区域、季节、异常类别以及陆地和海洋的检测器集成；根据相关波段和检测器一致性生成不同置信水平的检测集。

Result: 提高了真实检测率，减少了虚假检测，在自然灾害监测和能源开采应用中展现出较强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合建模M波段与DNB信号的集成方法可有效提升夜间灯光异常检测的泛化性和准确性，适用于自然灾害监测与能源开采等场景。

Abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

</details>


### [248] [Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06675)
*Xiaochuan Gong,Ang Li*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究在线性可分数据上使用大常数步长梯度下降（GD）求解逻辑回归的收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分析仅能证明达到损失ε需要加速率Õ(1/√ε)，且对振荡动态的紧控制仅限二维数据，缺乏任意维度下更快的收敛保证。

Method: 证明大步长η=1/ε的GD在任意维度下达到损失ε仅需O(ln^p(1/ε))步，其中p仅依赖间隔和数据秩。证明通过将振荡阶段递归嵌套划分区间，用间隔和秩限制嵌套深度，并用计数论证限制每层区间数，从而改进从振荡到稳定阶段的过渡时间界。

Result: GD在大步长下达到损失ε的步数为O(ln^p(1/ε))，p由间隔和数据秩决定，显著快于现有Õ(1/√ε)速率。

Conclusion: 大常数步长GD在线性可分逻辑回归中具有多对数步复杂度，振荡阶段的结构可由间隔和秩有效控制。

Abstract: We study gradient descent (GD) with a large constant stepsize for logistic regression on linearly separable data. Existing analysis shows an accelerated rate of $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrtε)$ to reach loss $ε$ with an aggressive stepsize, although the loss may initially oscillate. Tighter control of the oscillatory dynamics has been available only for two-dimensional data. We prove a substantially faster rate in arbitrary dimension: GD with a large stepsize $η=1/ε$ reaches loss $ε$ within $O(\ln^{p}(1/ε))$ steps, where $p$ depends only on the margin and the rank of the data. Our proof improves the bound on the transition time of GD from the oscillatory to the stable phase, after which the loss decreases monotonically. We split the oscillatory phase into recursively nested intervals. The margin and the rank bound the nesting depth, and a counting argument bounds the number of intervals at each depth, together yielding the polylogarithmic step complexity.

</details>


### [249] [Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06685)
*Jiawen Du,Arshan Ali Khan,Chenhao Zhang,Zachary Plotkin,Li Shen,Qi Long,Yun Li,Can Chen,Tianlong Chen,Nicholas Konz*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出MM-KG多模态知识图谱，将患者多模态证据与生物医学知识显式链接，提升临床问答的可追溯性与可验证性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床预测系统难以显式表示患者多模态证据与外部生物医学知识之间的链接，导致既无法追溯证据来源，也无法通过删除关系来量化其贡献。

Method: MM-KG将异构多模态患者观测与生物医学概念表示为同一类型图中的独立层，通过显式对齐边连接：先用模态特定协调器将EHR文本、影像、基因组和生物样本数据转为映射到UMLS概念的带类型观测，再由路由优先对齐器链接到生物医学知识图谱，最后经查询条件检索选出紧凑子图供LLM或GNN使用。在MIMIC-IV和ADNI上构建MM-KG，并用2x2设计分离患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互。

Result: 在需同时依赖两类来源的问题上，单一来源均远高于随机水平，二者组合在MIMIC上产生药物控制的AUROC交互效应+0.194，ADNI上+0.299；五候选排序中MM-KG较MindMap的Hits@1高+0.131，并在需查阅患者的项目上优于适配的GraphCare；删除检索包中唯一承载答案的关系后Hits@1回落至无知识基线；查询条件检索以少6.8倍上下文达到0.731 AUROC，而静态知识图谱上下文对普通结局预测无一致增益。

Conclusion: 知识图谱对临床LLM的价值不在于作为背景上下文，而在于显式链接多模态患者证据与问题所需关系；MM-KG使这些链接可检索、可追溯、可检验。

Abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.

</details>


### [250] [Game Plan: What AI can do for Football, and What Football can do for AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.09192)
*Karl Tuyls,Shayegan Omidshafiei,Paul Muller,Zhe Wang,Jerome Connor,Daniel Hennes,Ian Graham,William Spearman,Tim Waskett,Dafydd Steele,Pauline Luc,Adria Recasens,Alexandre Galashov,Gregory Thornton,Romuald Elie,Pablo Sprechmann,Pol Moreno,Kris Cao,Marta Garnelo,Praneet Dutta,Michal Valko,Nicolas Heess,Alex Bridgland,Julien Perolat,Bart De Vylder,Ali Eslami,Mark Rowland,Andrew Jaegle,Remi Munos,Trevor Back,Razia Ahamed,Simon Bouton,Nathalie Beauguerlange,Jackson Broshear,Thore Graepel,Demis Hassabis*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文综述了AI在足球分析中的前沿进展，强调统计学习、博弈论与计算机视觉的交叉融合如何推动预测性和规范性足球分析，并成为AI研究的独特缩影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 职业足球队数据采集激增、算力提升及机器学习进步，使得AI技术应用于足球分析成为可能，旨在解决个体球员与团队协同行为分析中的新科学挑战。

Method: 综述方法，结合统计学习、博弈论和计算机视觉，展示预测模型的反事实分析以及点球博弈论分析与球员属性统计学习的结合。

Result: 展示了上述领域交叉所支持的分析类型，包括反事实分析和点球博弈论与统计学习的融合案例。

Conclusion: 足球分析不仅改变足球运动本身，也为AI领域带来巨大价值，并有望扩展到其他真实和虚拟运动。

Abstract: The rapid progress in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning has opened unprecedented analytics possibilities in various team and individual sports, including baseball, basketball, and tennis. More recently, AI techniques have been applied to football, due to a huge increase in data collection by professional teams, increased computational power, and advances in machine learning, with the goal of better addressing new scientific challenges involved in the analysis of both individual players' and coordinated teams' behaviors. The research challenges associated with predictive and prescriptive football analytics require new developments and progress at the intersection of statistical learning, game theory, and computer vision. In this paper, we provide an overarching perspective highlighting how the combination of these fields, in particular, forms a unique microcosm for AI research, while offering mutual benefits for professional teams, spectators, and broadcasters in the years to come. We illustrate that this duality makes football analytics a game changer of tremendous value, in terms of not only changing the game of football itself, but also in terms of what this domain can mean for the field of AI. We review the state-of-the-art and exemplify the types of analysis enabled by combining the aforementioned fields, including illustrative examples of counterfactual analysis using predictive models, and the combination of game-theoretic analysis of penalty kicks with statistical learning of player attributes. We conclude by highlighting envisioned downstream impacts, including possibilities for extensions to other sports (real and virtual).

</details>


<div id='Inference'></div>

# Inference [[Back]](#toc)

### [251] [Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03769)
*Yi Xie,Zhanke Zhou,Yi Fan,Yong Ge,Bo Han,Bo Liu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文提出接收者相对有界协调框架，研究多智能体LLM系统中短消息与原始上下文的选择条件，以及更强发送者的增益条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，发送者拥有广泛上下文而执行者仅有局部视图，需要明确何时短消息能改善执行者决策、何时原始上下文更优、何时更强发送者有帮助。

Method: 提出接收者相对有界协调框架，将消息效用表示为接收者增益减协议税；给出三阶段分解（外化、吸收、动作闭包）；在单交叉条件下分析发送者升级；跨六个基准测试同一Qwen协议，并进行固定消息重放。

Result: ContextBench联合准确率从0.633升至0.775，但ToolSandbox从0.889降至0.653；固定消息重放显示即使正确工件恢复仍存在闭包失败。

Conclusion: 压缩是否优于原始上下文取决于税额节省与信息遗漏及解码器失配损失之比较；即使贝叶斯充分压缩也可能因有界执行者无法利用其表面形式而失败；据此提出的推理时选择器改善了评估通信 regime 的准确率-成本前沿。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

</details>


### [252] [Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03830)
*Arthur Louette,Alejandro Sánchez Roncero,Gaspard Lambrechts,Pascal Leroy,Julien Hansen,Petter Ögren,Damien Ernst*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出记忆状态评论家（memory-state critic），仅用状态与策略自身记忆条件化评论家，即可获得无偏策略梯度，无需额外循环网络建模历史。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非对称actor-critic中，仅以状态条件化的评论家定义不良且产生有偏策略梯度；而状态-历史评论家虽无偏，却需额外的循环逼近器来编码历史，增加计算与实现复杂度。

Method: 将评论家条件化于特权状态与策略的内部记忆（即策略选择动作所依据的历史表示），称为记忆状态评论家；理论上证明其定义良好且梯度无偏，且评论家损失无需反传进该记忆。在双四旋翼视觉追逃环境中评估，追捕者为学习智能体，逃避者每回合从固定启发式行为池采样，覆盖两种场地类型。

Result: 记忆状态评论家优于状态-历史评论家且收敛更快；相比仅状态评论家保持无偏，并在墙式场地中略有优势，此时actor的历史包含仅靠特权状态无法获得的信息。

Conclusion: 以策略自身记忆条件化评论家即可实现无偏策略梯度并省去第二循环逼近器，是一种更高效且性能更优的非对称actor-critic设计。

Abstract: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

</details>


### [253] [KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03842)
*Jianbin Zhang,Xin Sun,Shanwen Wang,Wei Ye,Susanto Rahardja*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出KVE-KD框架，通过教师模型动态识别任务相关视觉token并指导知识蒸馏，提升视觉语言模型跨模态推理能力且无推理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型知识蒸馏方法对所有视觉token施加统一监督或依赖静态token选择，难以区分任务相关线索与背景噪声，导致跨模态推理性能下降。

Method: 以最终预生成文本token作为统一语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉token贡献分析锚点表示变化定位目标跨模态融合层；在该层基于锚点条件注意力分布排序视觉token，并用归一化熵选出关键视觉证据，指导聚焦式视觉特征蒸馏。

Result: 在六个基准测试上超越现有跨模态蒸馏方法，在复杂推理和细粒度视觉理解任务上提升尤为显著，且不引入推理时额外开销。

Conclusion: KVE-KD通过动态关键视觉证据引导蒸馏，有效对齐师生任务相关视觉表示并抑制背景噪声，为资源受限设备部署视觉语言模型提供了高效方案。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.

</details>


### [254] [Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03894)
*Yikai Zhao,Saurabh Pandey,Pradeep Kumar Misra*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练方法，利用低成本开源代理模型并行评估LLM智能体工具调用的错误概率，通过生成式似然与判别式裁决等读取方式恢复缺失的置信信号，并用于实时门控与置信反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的LLM智能体产生的工具调用、查询和代码可能静默出错，而前沿聊天API隐藏了token概率，智能体自述置信度接近随机，重采样又因模型高度重复而无效，因此需要一种低成本、无需访问模型内部的方式来检测错误。

Method: 并行运行一个低成本开放权重代理模型，读取与智能体相同的上下文、schema和候选动作，通过教师强制、请求PMI、判别式裁决和工具选择竞争等互补读取方式，从其log-probabilities中为调用打分。原则是：生成式似然定位错误的参数值，判别式裁决捕获整体错误的调用，错误类型未知时采用集成。该方法免训练、无需访问智能体内部，仅增加一次预填充。

Result: 在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，而智能体自述置信度仅0.598；生成式读取在另外三个智能体上提升+0.07至+0.28。相比自一致性，在近确定性智能体上以1/K成本获得+0.14至+0.19增益。实时门控在50%覆盖率下提升可接受动作准确率+0.05至+0.30；置信反馈在实时执行基准上提升任务成功率+0.119和+0.137（p<=1e-4），在步骤错误静默场景下比随机值对照提升+0.078（p=0.003）。

Conclusion: 该免训练代理模型读取方法能有效恢复LLM智能体工具调用的错误信号，支持实时门控和置信反馈两种部署模式，显著提升动作准确率和任务成功率，且成本低、无需访问智能体内部。

Abstract: A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples.
  We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call.
  On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

</details>


### [255] [SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03934)
*Yueting Li,Weihang Ding*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个基于Tiny Tapeout制造班次中人工设计开源电路的模拟集成电路设计基准，包含273个拓扑不同的顶层设计，评估原理图到网表的转录和器件尺寸设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟集成电路设计基准难以回答两个问题：模型是否学到了可迁移的电路技能而非回忆熟悉示例，以及其输出是否在定义的工艺和测试条件下工作。

Method: 从Tiny Tapeout制造班次关联的人工设计开源电路中构建基准，每个源文件在固定容器化环境中按提交修订版本处理，导出原理图图像和SPICE网表作为精确结构参考；提交日期支持训练截止分析，作者测试台提供仿真上下文；评估原理图到网表转录和器件尺寸设计。
