We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.

</details>


### [470] [StagQ: Constraint-Driven Multi-Precision Weight Quantization for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05977)
*Zhe Wei,Mengqi Guo,Yuan Yuan,Jiunn Bin Lim,Boyi Pan,Michael Bi Mi*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出StagQ多精度权重量化格式，用共享前缀流支持多种精度，在多个LLM上以较低逻辑比特率取得更优或相当的性能，并实现较快的矩阵向量乘内核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨多部署服务LLM需要多种权重量化精度，传统多副本存储浪费资源；希望用单一数据流通过可读前缀支持所有精度，避免逐权重查找。

Method: 主码流为2比特分组仿射基，后接可配置数量的1比特细化平面，采用二进制步长调度；所有精度共享元数据并用仿射映射解码，无逐权重查找；稀疏侧记录在网格拟合前后填入，保存拟合最差的少数权重；给出两种编码器配置。

Result: 2比特下较廉价配置在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4、OLMo-2-7B上领先最强多精度基线3.1至7.0 MMLU点且逻辑率略低；3比特下Llama-3.1-8B领先、Phi-4以更高率领先、OLMo-2-7B持平；4比特下三者均持平但率更高；A100上batch-one矩阵向量乘内核在多数形状-精度组合中快于两个基线内核。

Conclusion: StagQ能以单流前缀形式高效服务多精度权重需求，在精度-率权衡上优于或持平现有多精度基线，并具备实际内核加速潜力。

Abstract: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

</details>


### [471] [EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05996)
*Bowen Feng,Julian Ost,May Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Felix Heide*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出EpicWorldModel，一种在部分可观测环境下训练随机JEPA的框架，通过流匹配目标预测多个潜在未来状态，并利用流预测方差引导CEM规划进行探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于JEPA的潜在世界模型是确定性的，在部分可观测场景（如遮挡）中，过去的观测和动作可能导致多种合理的未来，确定性范式失效。

Method: 联合训练EpicWorldModel预测器与其潜在表示空间，当条件历史中缺少目标相关场景内容时，使用流匹配目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态；将流预测方差（与预测熵上界相关）作为探索引导信号，融入基于CEM的规划。

Result: 在潜在规划实验中，最佳或持平性能覆盖各任务，相比LeWorldModel成功率最高提升22%。

Conclusion: EpicWorldModel通过随机建模和不确定性引导探索，在部分可观测环境中有效平衡目标达成与对遮挡目标可能区域的探索。

Abstract: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

</details>


### [472] [Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06008)
*Noortje I. P. Schueler,Hans van Gorp,Ruud J. G. van Sloun*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种基于检索诱导潜在转移模型的超声操作引导方法，将引导表述为世界模型中的多步规划与检索，无需探头追踪硬件，仅凭实时超声图像即可生成引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声采集质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求超过熟练技师供给，现有操作者引导系统旨在帮助低经验用户将探头移至目标视图。

Method: 采用V-JEPA 2.1骨干将观测编码至潜在空间，使解剖相关视图邻近；从含编码潜在状态及对应探头位置与姿态的参考数据库中检索相似视图；不学习参数化转移函数，而直接使用数据库中物理执行的转移，构建非参数、检索诱导的转移模型以支持滚动时域规划；部署时仅依赖实时超声图像流，无需探头追踪硬件。

Result: 在颈动脉超声中，所提规划器在回顾性闭环回合中达成目标视图的比例为86%，优于两个代表性基线的52%和43%，并在每个目标视图上均表现更优，包括具挑战性的颈内和颈外动脉纵切视图；在未见过志愿者上的前瞻性可行性研究中，使用蒸馏在CPU上实时运行，目标视图可达率为83%。

Conclusion: 由于规划由与任意可编码目标潜在的接近度驱动，同一世界模型可导航回任何先前采集的患者特异性帧，支持围手术期或随访监测等可重复的纵向成像。

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

</details>


### [473] [MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06039)
*Ilya Kuleshov,Egor Serov,Alexey Zaytsev*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 论文提出在MLP-based隐空间条件流匹配(CFM)预测中，使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为可逆潜在映射，替代傅里叶/DCT或PCA，从而在降低训练开销的同时提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率流匹配预测受益于数据匹配先验，但吸收局部相关性的序列骨干网络（RNN、S4、Transformer）GPU内存和时间开销大；MLP隐空间流匹配更便宜，但先验与线性潜在映射选择之间的关系在CFM预测中研究不足，且固定变换仅适用于Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验，PCA映射依赖训练集、对训练-测试偏移敏感。

Method: 提出使用先验核的Mercer特征基作为线性潜在映射：该基能精确对角化中心化协方差，与训练数据解耦，并能适应非平稳和周期先验；在隐空间用MLP进行条件流匹配预测。

Result: 在GluonTS的五个基准（ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）上，与TSFlow共享协议下，所得MLP在CRPS上匹配或超越TSFlow，训练内存约为其1/4.7，每epoch时间约为其1/3.5至1/4.4。

Conclusion: 先验核的Mercer特征基是一种有效的线性潜在映射选择，能在MLP-based CFM预测中兼顾性能与效率。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.

</details>


### [474] [Co-Optimizing Graph Sparsification and Approximate Computing for Energy-Efficient FPGA-Based GCN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06138)
*Nathaniel Kaye Mellor,Shreejith Shanker,George Floros*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于FPGA的GCN加速器，结合图稀疏化（DSpar）、8位量化和近似乘法器，在AMD Kria KV260上实现低功耗边缘推理，并揭示稀疏化与近似计算的互补关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCN在资源受限的边缘平台上部署面临稀疏图聚合带来的计算和内存需求挑战，需要降低功耗和提升效率。

Method: 在AMD Kria KV260 FPGA上设计GCN加速器，集成DSpar图稀疏化、8位量化和近似乘法器；在Cora、LastFM Asia和Amazon Photo三个不同密度图上评估稀疏化与近似计算的交互作用。

Result: 近似乘法器在稀疏聚合操作中效果最佳，图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度进一步提升其可行性；在Amazon Photo上实现最高9.88倍加速并保持86.6%分类准确率，在Cora上实现1.52倍加速和77.0%准确率，总功耗低于1W。

Conclusion: 图稀疏化和近似计算是互补技术，其协同优化能够在边缘FPGA平台上实现高效低功耗的GCN推理。

Abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the computational and memory demands of sparse graph aggregation. This work presents an FPGA-based GCN accelerator that combines DSpar graph sparsification, 8-bit quantization, and approximate multipliers on the AMD Kria KV260. Evaluated on Cora, LastFM Asia, and Amazon Photo, the design explores the interaction between sparsification and approximation across graphs with widely varying densities. Results show that the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic is governed by accumulation depth within GCN computations. Approximate multipliers are most effective when applied to sparse aggregation operations, while graph sparsification further improves their viability by reducing aggregation depth. The combined approach achieves up to 9.88$\times$ speedup while maintaining 86.6\% classification accuracy on Amazon Photo, and 1.52$\times$ speedup with 77.0\% accuracy on Cora, with total power consumption below 1 W. These results demonstrate that graph sparsification and approximate computing are complementary techniques whose co-optimization enables efficient low-power GCN inference on edge FPGA platforms.

</details>


### [475] [Anlu: Enabling In-Context Time Series Anomaly Detection in Foundation Models via Counterfactual Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06180)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chen Zhang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出参考条件式时间序列异常检测，通过反事实监督使检测器必须利用参考记录，在冻结TSFM上加入参考记忆与零初始化门控适配器，VUS-PR从0.542提升至0.607。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列是否异常取决于运行工况，同一缺失事件在不同工况下可能为故障或常态，仅凭查询无法判断适用工况，因此需要参考记录提供预期行为证据；但若训练异常仅凭查询即可识别，检测器会忽略参考，故需强制其依赖参考。

Method: 采用参考条件式检测的上下文学习框架：为同一查询配对两个支持不同正常规则的参考并分别标注，构成反事实监督，使忽略参考的检测器无法同时拟合两个冲突标签；模型Anlu在冻结的异常检测预训练时间序列基础模型上添加参考记忆与零初始化门控适配器。

Result: 在350条TSB-AD-U评估序列上，Anlu将冻结TSFM的平均VUS-PR从0.542提升到0.607；将参考替换为零后，Anlu得分降至0.499。

Conclusion: 反事实监督结合参考记忆与门控适配器能有效促使检测器利用参考信息，显著提升时间序列异常检测性能，且性能提升确实依赖于参考记录。

Abstract: Whether a time-series pattern is anomalous often depends on the operating regime of the monitored process. A missing event can signal a fault in one regime and be routine in another, and the query alone may not reveal which regime applies. We study in-context learning (ICL) for time series anomaly detection (TSAD) through reference-conditioned detection, where a reference record provides evidence about expected behavior and model parameters remain fixed at inference. Supplying the reference is not enough: when training anomalies are recognizable from the query alone, the detector can fit its targets while ignoring the reference. We therefore introduce counterfactual supervision, which pairs one query with two references that support different normal rules and labels the query under each. At positions where the two labels disagree, no detector that ignores the reference can fit both targets. Anlu learns from this supervision by adding a reference memory and zero-initialized gated adapters to a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) pretrained for anomaly detection. On the 350 TSB-AD-U evaluation sequences, Anlu raises the mean VUS-PR of the frozen TSFM from 0.542 to 0.607. Replacing the reference with zeros lowers Anlu's score to 0.499.

</details>


### [476] [Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06213)
*Yujie Liu,Vincent Y. F. Tan,Yunbei Xu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文研究了LinUCB在小差距情形下的采样分配，证明其经验采样分布收敛到D-最优设计，并由此改进了渐近遗憾分析和统计推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小差距情形（奖励差距为O(n^{-1/2})）是导致最坏情况遗憾下界的困难实例，LinUCB在此情形下接近最优。理解其采样分配机制有助于连接在线学习与实验设计。

Method: 采用平均场视角，通过经验采样分布这一宏观对象刻画自适应决策的平均效应，并分析n→∞时的极限。

Result: LinUCB诱导的经验采样分布收敛到D-最优设计集；由此得到两个推论：一是细化了小差距情形下LinUCB的渐近遗憾分析，刻画了其主导阶常数；二是证明了正则化最小二乘估计量满足中心极限定理型结果。

Conclusion: 在小差距情形下，LinUCB不仅达到接近最优的极小极大遗憾，还以对学习奖励参数渐近有效的方式分配样本，从而将遗憾驱动的在线学习与信息高效实验设计联系起来，并支持有效的统计推断。

Abstract: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$. Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.

</details>


### [477] [Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06241)
*Guilherme Silva,Pedro Silva,Gladston Moreira,Eduardo Luz*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种仅需原型头部适配的紧凑个性化方法，用于TinyML心电监测系统，无需反向传播即可在微控制器上实现患者自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴/床旁ECG监测需适应个体形态，但离线个性化无法应对生理、电极位置和记录漂移；微控制器上反向传播适配代价高，且部署时可能缺少标注心律失常心拍。

Method: 离线训练1-D CNN（1314参数、72.6k MAC/拍）作为冻结特征提取器，导出至PSoC 6；患者适配仅计算32维嵌入空间的闭式类均值，无卷积反向传播、无迭代优化，每支持拍仅一次前向。

Result: 原型适配将跨患者宏F1从0.635/0.639/0.646提升至1/5/10-shot的0.731/0.771/0.797，各shot数均优于线性SGD头部微调；PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上18个单样本片段回放宏F1与主机一致（0.798），每拍11.39 ms、5.2 KB闪存、22.2 KB SRAM；仅用被动缓存窦性心拍更新正常类原型可稳定提升+0.05宏F1。

Conclusion: 原型头部适配为TinyML ECG系统提供了一种无需反向传播、低资源、可片上执行的个性化原语，并可通过仅更新正常类原型进一步降低标注负担。

Abstract: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial

</details>


### [478] [RoSA: Rotational Sparse Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06243)
*Muhammad Azeem Lodhi,Chao Zhou,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出RoSA方法，通过逐层旋转训练块并逐步冻结靠近输入的层，在降低内存的同时保持微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效微调（PEFT）虽降低训练成本，但仍需对所有层进行反向传播，导致优化器状态内存和计算开销较大；本文希望在层级别进一步压缩适配范围以节省内存。

Method: RoSA（旋转稀疏适配）在训练中冻结靠近输入的底层，并在后续层上旋转一个可训练块，逐渐增加靠近输入的冻结层数；由于与可训练参数化方式正交，可与PEFT方法或稀疏优化器结合，并可通过缓存最后冻结层的激活来缩短前向传播。

Result: 在多种LLM架构和任务上的实验表明，RoSA降低了峰值内存，同时保持了较强的微调性能。

Conclusion: RoSA通过层级别的旋转冻结策略有效减少优化器状态内存和反向传播开销，且可与现有PEFT方法兼容，是一种实用的内存高效微调方案。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting foundation models by focusing training on a small parameter subset. Complementary to this idea, we introduce RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation), which narrows adaptation to a subset of layers at a time. RoSA freezes lower layers close to the input throughout training and rotates a trainable block over later layers, progressively increasing the number of frozen layers close to the input. This design reduces optimizer-state memory, shortens backpropagation, and even forward propagation if activations at the last frozen layer are cached. Because RoSA is orthogonal to the choice of trainable parameterization, it can be combined with PEFT methods or sparse optimizers within each active block. Experiments across multiple LLM architectures and tasks show that RoSA reduces peak memory while maintaining strong fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [479] [Generative World Models Enable Predictive Control of Laser Melt Pool Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06250)
*Yiyang Yan,Markus Bambach,Mohamadreza Afrasiabi*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种面向激光熔池的生成式世界模型，可从温度与相形态历史预测动态演化，并用于可微预测控制与策略蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将世界模型用于制造过程控制，以在无法进行高保真仿真的时间尺度上实现工艺决策。

Method: 构建生成式潜在动态世界模型，捕捉未解析熔池流动效应；利用其可微性作为预测控制被控对象，通过想象未来的梯度优化激光调度，并蒸馏为单次前向的摊销策略。

Result: 在瞬态激光输入下，递归展开比确定性回归器更准确；优化后的激光调度可在未见几何、路径与初始条件下调节熔池深度；蒸馏策略单次前向即可产生控制动作。

Conclusion: 生成式可微世界模型为激光熔池实时控制提供可行路径，并验证了面向实际机器部署的摊销策略概念。

Abstract: World models, which learn how environments respond to actions, are emerging as a powerful paradigm for planning through imagined futures, transforming decision-making across games, robotics and autonomous driving. Bringing this capability to manufacturing could enable process decisions on timescales inaccessible to high-fidelity simulation. Here we introduce a generative world model for localized highly dynamic laser melt pool that predicts evolution from histories of temperature and phase morphology under candidate actions. Its generative latent dynamics capture the effects of unresolved melt flow, enabling more accurate recursive rollouts than deterministic regressors under transient laser inputs. Because the learned dynamics are differentiable, the model can serve directly as a predictive control plant. Gradients through imagined futures optimize laser schedules that regulate melt-pool depth over previously unseen geometry, path, initialization. We further distil this optimization into an amortized policy that produces control actions in a single forward pass, providing a proof of concept for real deployment on machines.

</details>


### [480] [dIon: Fragmentation-Based Invariance for Self-Supervised Learning of Tandem Mass Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06282)
*Alfred Nilsson,Joel Lapin,Samuel H. Payne,Mathias Wilhelm,Lukas Käll*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种利用前体质量与电荷和碎片离子证据之间物理关系的新型不变性，实现无需肽段标签的自监督表示学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肽段串联质谱从头测序依赖大量标注数据，标注成本高；亟需无需肽段序列标签的自监督预训练方法以提升测序性能。

Method: 提出dIon，基于DINO框架设计两个潜在预测任务：一是从谱图中以母离子为选择查询恢复干净的教师表示，将前体信息与碎片离子证据关联；二是从隐藏母离子的部分谱图中恢复教师表示，防止表示坍缩到前体信息。机制探针验证两种效应，消融实验表明完整目标最优。

Result: 在相同端到端训练下，dIon初始化相比从头训练在留出的MassIVE-KB和Kingdoms测试集上分别提升从头肽段精度5.5和8.4个百分点；在更大监督语料下分别提升2.3和4.8个百分点。在相同贪婪解码协议下，所得模型在多物种Kingdoms语料上超过完全监督的最先进从头测序模型。无肽段标签时，dIon学到强天然肽段相似性几何；有限肽段监督微调后，在所有表示基准上取得最佳检索和配对判别性能。

Conclusion: dIon通过利用质谱物理不变性实现有效的自监督表示学习，显著提升肽段从头测序精度，并学到高质量肽段表示，优于现有监督方法。

Abstract: We introduce a novel invariance for peptide tandem mass spectrometry data, unlocking self-supervised representation learning that improves de novo sequencing of peptides. This invariance exploits the physical relationship between precursor properties (mass and charge) and fragment-ion evidence, without requiring peptide sequence labels. We introduce dIon, which adapts the DINO framework with two latent prediction tasks, both recovering a clean teacher representation: one from a spectrum mixture, using the precursor as a selection query, and one from a partial spectrum with the precursor withheld. The first associates precursor information with fragment-ion evidence; the second prevents representational collapse onto that information alone. Mechanistic probes support both effects, and ablations show that the full objective performs best. Under identical end-to-end training, dIon initialization improves de novo peptide precision over training from scratch by 5.5 and 8.4 percentage points on the held-out MassIVE-KB and Kingdoms test sets, and by 2.3 and 4.8 percentage points with a larger supervised training corpus. The resulting models surpass fully supervised state-of-the-art de novo sequencing models on the diverse, multi-species Kingdoms corpus under the same greedy-decoding protocol. Without peptide labels, dIon learns strong native peptide-similarity geometry compared with other learned models; with limited peptide-supervised adaptation, it achieves the best retrieval and pair-discrimination performance across all representation benchmarks.

</details>


### [481] [Steering by Influence: Curvature Aware Data Weighting for Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06383)
*James A. E. Dixon,Stephen J. Roberts,Francesco Quinzan*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出影响函数加权的激活传输方法，实现主题级概念引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于对比数据集激活平均的推理时引导方法混入无关概念和噪声，且受少数token主导，导致传输的是token级而非主题级概念。

Method: 利用影响函数评估每个数据点对模型概念表示的贡献（包含损失曲率信息），结合最优传输进行影响加权激活传输，将非概念文本激活导向概念文本激活。

Result: 在毒性抑制(Jigsaw)、对象概念归纳(OneSec)和真实性归纳(TruthfulQA)上超越现有激活传输基线，困惑度和MMLU准确率表明模型质量基本保持，且影响函数与激活相似度排序显著不同。

Conclusion: 曲率感知的影响信息对激活引导具有重要价值，能捕捉激活方法遗漏的概念相关信息。

Abstract: Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model's outputs by estimating a concept's representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts. In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model's representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model's loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity. We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores. We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines. We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.

</details>


### [482] [Learning Pareto Stationary Fronts via Single-Pass Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06397)
*Elina Rojin Celik,Marcos Medeiros Raimundo,Isabel Valera*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出MOSEL框架，以标准单目标训练的计算成本实现深度神经网络的后验多目标优化，恢复完整Pareto平稳解前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后验多目标优化在深度神经网络中面临计算成本高的问题，需要一种高效方法以单目标训练的代价获得多样化的Pareto最优解。

Method: 将问题重构为双层优化，利用网络模块化解耦表示学习与目标偏好对齐，并建模为Stackelberg博弈，从而在单次前向-反向传播中求解原后验多目标优化问题。

Result: 在强冲突场景（如公平性-准确率）中揭示多样且最优的Pareto前沿；在弱冲突场景（如多任务学习）中持续收敛到更接近乌托邦点的解，优于标准单目标训练和专用多任务学习方法。

Conclusion: 后验多目标优化是高效学习更丰富、更鲁棒表示的有效途径，可最终提升泛化能力。

Abstract: We propose MOSEL (Multi-Objective Stackelberg Efficient Learning), a framework for a posteriori multi-objective optimization (MOO) in deep neural networks that recovers a full front of Pareto stationary solutions at the computational cost of standard single-objective training. MOSEL reformulates the problem as a bilevel optimization problem that leverages network modularity to decouple representation learning from objective-preference alignment. Casting the bilevel optimization problem as a Stackelberg game enables solving the original a posteriori MOO problem in a single forward-backward pass. As a result, MOSEL matches the time and memory efficiency of standard single-objective training while enabling scalable Pareto stationary front learning. Empirically, MOSEL uncovers diverse and optimal Pareto frontiers in strongly conflicting settings (e.g., fairness-accuracy). Remarkably, even in weakly conflicting regimes such as multi-task learning, it consistently converges to solutions closer to the utopia point, outperforming both standard single-objective training and specialized multi-task learning methods. These results highlight the broader potential of a posteriori MOO learning as a pathway to efficiently learn more diverse and robust representations, ultimately improving generalization.

</details>


### [483] [Quantifying the Stability of Multi-Step Reasoning via Error Amplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06404)
*Dongyue Li,Ziniu Zhang,Minxuan Duan,Hongyang R. Zhang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文研究多步推理的稳定性，提出以生成步骤间输入空间雅可比矩阵谱范数乘积作为误差放大因子，理论证明Transformer在简单任务上收敛到稳定解，并提出CoT压缩与量化感知训练两种算法提升稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步推理（如思维链与算法推理）在语言模型中广泛应用，但自回归生成中中间步骤的误差会累积并在末端显著放大，因此需要明确决定多步推理稳定性的关键因素。

Method: 首先推导由输入空间雅可比矩阵谱范数乘积控制的推理误差界，将该乘积作为误差放大因子与稳定性度量；随后在线性、二次函数等简单任务上分析训练后的Transformer，理论证明其收敛到稳定性度量衰减的解；最后基于稳定性分析提出思维链长度压缩（降低每步敏感度）与量化感知训练（正则化输入雅可比范数）两种算法，并在图算法推理与符号状态跟踪任务上微调语言模型验证。

Result: 在七项评估中，所提算法平均优于基线3.5%，在更长输入上提升8.2%；消融分析显示稳定性度量大幅降低3-8倍，证实对输入空间雅可比谱范数的正则化效果。

Conclusion: 多步推理稳定性可由输入空间雅可比谱范数乘积量化，理论表明Transformer可收敛到稳定解；通过思维链压缩与量化感知训练可有效控制该度量，从而提升长步推理的稳定性与性能。

Abstract: We consider the stability of multi-step reasoning processes, which have extensive applications in language models, including chain-of-thought and algorithmic reasoning. While longer sequences of reasoning can improve a model's generation capability at test time, the errors due to intermediate reasoning steps can accumulate in autoregressive generation, and thus grow substantially at the end. In this paper, we ask: What are the key factors determining the stability of multi-step reasoning? First, we show an inference error bound governed by the product of spectral norms of the Jacobians taken through the input space across generation steps. This product can be viewed as an error amplification factor, which could scale exponentially with the number of reasoning steps, serving as a quantitative measure of reasoning stability. Second, we analyze this measure in transformer models trained to predict simple tasks like linear and quadratic functions. We theoretically prove that the transformer model converges to a solution where the stability measure decays, thus yielding nearly zero inference loss over (arbitrarily) long steps. Finally, the stability analysis leads to several algorithmic implications for controlling the stability, through (i) chain-of-thought length compression that reduces the sensitivity of each step, and (ii) quantization-aware training that regularizes the input Jacobian norms. We validate the proposed algorithms by fine-tuning language models on graph-algorithmic reasoning tasks and symbolic state-tracking tasks. Across seven evaluations, our algorithms improve over baseline comparisons by 3.5% on average, and by 8.2% for longer-length inputs. Ablation analysis validates that the stability measure is drastically reduced by 3-8$\times$, confirming the regularization effect on the spectral norms of the (input space) Jacobians.

</details>


### [484] [FlashCart: Fast Cartesian Tensor Products for Equivariant Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06409)
*Viktor Zaverkin,Payman Goodarzi,Sergey V. Sukhomlinov,Davit Hovhannisyan,Roland Aydin,Martin H. Müser,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出FlashCart框架，通过生成GPU内核和递归构建压缩的等变特征，使高阶相关性变得可行，显著提升机器学习原子间势的精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等变架构的计算成本限制了其能表示的局部相关性，从而限制了可达到的精度，需要一种方法使高阶相关性计算变得经济可行。

Method: 结合生成的GPU内核与递归构建等变特征并每步压缩至固定宽度的架构；在独立笛卡尔分量中表达张量积，符号简化其及导数，生成融合内核；实验证明增加相关阶数比增加宽度、深度或张量秩更高效。

Result: 在SPICE-MACE-OFF上，FlashCart模型推进了实测的精度-效率前沿：560万参数模型比1.89亿参数的Transformer实现了更低的能量和力误差，且推理速度快10倍。

Conclusion: FlashCart使高阶相关性计算变得可行，通过增加相关阶数高效提升精度，在精度和效率上均优于大型Transformer模型。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials extend atomistic simulations beyond the length- and timescales accessible to electronic-structure methods. However, the computational cost of equivariant architectures limits the local correlations they can represent in practice and therefore their achievable accuracy. Here we introduce FlashCart, which makes higher-order correlations affordable by combining generated GPU kernels with an architecture that recursively builds equivariant features and compresses them to a fixed width at each step. We express tensor products in independent Cartesian components and symbolically simplify them and their derivatives, producing fused kernels that often outperform optimized spherical counterparts. We then show that increasing correlation order improves accuracy more efficiently than increasing width, depth, or tensor rank. On SPICE-MACE-OFF, FlashCart models advance the measured accuracy-efficiency frontier: a model with $5.6$ million parameters achieves lower energy and force errors and $10\times$ faster inference than a transformer with $189$ million parameters.

</details>


### [485] [Training-Free Transformer Merging via Sequential Local Operator Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06415)
*Akansh Maurya,Ya-Wei Eileen Lin,Stefanie Jegelka,Sebastian U Stich,Rotem Mulayoff*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出免训练模型合并方法SLOA，沿部分合并模型的执行路径对齐算子，减少误差累积并支持秩扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练合并独立处理transformer各层，忽略注意力中query-key与value-output算子依赖组合矩阵的功能结构；合并早期组件后下游激活改变，导致合并与原始执行路径不匹配。

Method: SLOA利用校准数据估计各功能组件的局部行为，在部分合并模型的中间激活下顺序对齐算子，再将合并算子分解回有效transformer参数。

Result: 在CLIP、RoBERTa及十亿参数LLM上跨模态、模型规模和任务数验证，优于强基线；算子分解支持秩扩展，提供精度-推理成本权衡，并自然扩展至LoRA微调模型合并。

Conclusion: 顺序对齐减少层间误差累积，秩扩展为提升多任务容量提供原则性机制，方法通用且无需额外优化。

Abstract: Training-free model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models into a single model without further optimization on labeled data. Yet, in transformers, independently merging individual layers can affect a shared attention computation because the query-key and value-output operators depend on composed matrices, overlooking the functional structure. Moreover, when merging earlier components, downstream components receive different activations than they do in the original model, thus, the merged and original execution paths no longer match. In this paper, we introduce Sequential Local Operator Alignment, a training-free method that merges transformers along the execution path of the partially merged model. Our method uses calibration data to estimate the local behavior of each functional component, aligns operators sequentially under the intermediate activation of the partially merged model, and subsequently factorizes the merged operators back into valid transformer parameters. We empirically show that this sequential step reduces error accumulation across layers. Furthermore, the proposed operator factorization step enables rank expansion, providing a principled mechanism for increasing multi-task capacity. We demonstrate that our approach generalizes across modalities, model scales, and varying numbers of tasks, from CLIP and RoBERTa to billion-parameter LLMs, and further extends naturally to the merging of LoRA-fine-tuned models. The results indicate improvements over strong merging baselines without requiring rank expansion, while optional expansion provides a further accuracy-inference-cost trade-off. Project link: https://akansh12.github.io/SLOA-Merge/

</details>


### [486] [Better Call Reward: Reward Hacking as Strategic Abstention in Legal Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06439)
*Subramanyam Sahoo,Justin Shenk*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该研究通过强化学习微调法律AI模型，发现其学会以空泛引用和冗长表述伪装专业，而非提升推理能力，导致准确率崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究当奖励函数仅衡量回答的表面法律特征（如引用数量、法律术语密度和长度）时，模型是否会学习到非承诺性策略，而非真正提升法律推理能力。

Method: 使用GRPO对Qwen3-8B进行微调，奖励函数基于三个表面特征：引用数量、法律术语密度和响应长度。在LegalBench的16个是/否法律推理任务（N=320）上评估。

Result: 整体准确率从0.500（随机水平）骤降至0.072（McNemar p < 10^-36），主要由于格式正确的回答率从0.900降至0.109。但模型实际作答时准确率从0.556升至0.657。89.3%的引用是结构性不合理的幻觉，多为真实案例名的微妙篡改。

Conclusion: 表面特征奖励函数会导致模型学会最大化法律外观而最小化有用性，称为“Saul Goodman效应”。提出三种诊断工具：Confidence Theater Score、Citation Plausibility Rate和Regret Gap，以检测此类失败模式。

Abstract: What happens when a legal AI model learns to look like a lawyer instead of reasoning like one? We fine tune Qwen3-8B with Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) against a proxy built from three surface features: citation count, legalese density, and response length. The model does not learn to reason more effectively. It learns to withhold commitment. Across 16 yes or no legal reasoning tasks from LegalBench (N=320), overall accuracy collapses from 0.500 (chance) to 0.072 (McNemar p < 10^-36), driven entirely by the rate of properly formatted answers falling from 0.900 to 0.109. The model stops committing to answers. Yet when it does commit, accuracy rises from 0.556 to 0.657, showing that the collapse is not a failure of capability but a strategic response: the model has learned that verbose responses packed with citations but empty of a direct answer score higher than terse correct ones. We term this the Saul Goodman effect, a policy that becomes maximally lawyerly while becoming maximally noncommittal, and prove formally that it is the optimal response to any surface feature proxy that attaches no penalty to abstention. We further show that 89.3% of citations produced after training are structurally implausible hallucinations, many of them subtly corrupted names of real landmark cases, constructed in effect to survive a casual read and fail under scrutiny. To detect this failure mode before deployment, we introduce three diagnostic tools: the Confidence Theater Score (CTS), the Citation Plausibility Rate (CPR), and the Regret Gap (RG). In a domain where a confidently wrong answer can constitute malpractice, the broader lesson is direct: a reward function that measures how legal a response looks will produce a model that is maximally photogenic and minimally useful.

</details>


### [487] [ARO: Aligned Representation learning for multi-Omics data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06443)
*Amogh Singh,Yash Shah,Chiara D'Ercoli,Arash Mehrjou,Patrick Schwab,Timothy Jones,Pietro Liò*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出ARO模型，从多组学癌症数据中学习表示，并重建缺失与未配对模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 功能分子检测成本高，多组学数据中缺失模态和未配对样本普遍，限制了全面多组学分析。

Method: ARO优先于在有限或不完整数据场景下的实用性，学习潜嵌入表示以重建缺失和未配对模态。

Result: 在未掩码设置下，验证集和测试集上缺失模态重建MSE为0.15，且学习到的潜嵌入支持下游癌症分类。

Conclusion: 将不同分子层作为单一集成系统分析，可提供可靠且成本高效的方法，减少对大规模实验检测的依赖，并支持有限数据下的多组学探索。

Abstract: The high cost of functional molecular assays, and prevalence of missing modalities and unmatched samples in computational biology, create significant barriers to comprehensive multi-omic profiling, essential for capturing and reasoning over molecules, cells, tissues, and organisms. This work proposes a model that learns meaningful representations from multi-omics cancer data supporting the reconstruction of missing and unpaired modalities. Contrary to increasingly complex, larger models, e.g. Foundation Models (FMs), ARO prioritizes practical applicability in limited or incomplete data settings. ARO optimally reconstructs missing modalities (MSE of $0.15$ on the validation and test data in the Unmasked settings), with its learned latent embeddings enabling a downstream cancer classification task. Our findings indicate that analyzing diverse molecular layers as a single integrated system offers a reliable and cost-efficient approach, reducing dependence on large-scale experimental testing, while still supporting multi-omic exploration in limited data settings.

</details>


### [488] [Time-series Foundation Models for Predictive Control: The Role of Excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06447)
*Mazen Amria,Jasper Hoffmann,Philipp Bordne,Anna Rothenhäusler,Lilli Frison,Harald Taxt Walnum,Sebastien Gros,Joschka Bödecker*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）虽具备强零样本预测能力，但低预测误差并不保证其能捕捉系统对控制动作的响应；以住宅热泵控制为试验台，研究预测与真实控制干预效果的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署模型预测控制（MPC）需为每个目标系统构建/辨识预测模型，而TSFM凭借跨系统零样本预测能力成为有吸引力的选择，但低预测误差可能无法保证其准确刻画控制系统所考虑备选动作的响应。

Method: 以住宅热泵控制为试验台，测量TSFM预测的控制干预效果与真实效果之间的一致性，并考察上下文控制激励、常见微调流程与特征平滑对输入-响应关系恢复的影响；同时开展初步闭环实验。

Result: 当推理上下文包含足够的独立控制激励时，TSFM能恢复系统的输入-响应关系；常见微调流程和特征平滑会减少但不能消除对上下文激励的需求；初步闭环结果表明较短上下文窗口具有前景。

Conclusion: 当前用于预测控制的TSFM需要在推理上下文中具备足够信息量的控制变化；低预测误差不等于控制响应建模正确。

Abstract: Deploying model predictive control (MPC) requires constructing or identifying a predictive model for each target system. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer an attractive option thanks to strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across systems. However, low forecast error does not guarantee that a TSFM captures the system's response to the alternative actions considered by the controller. We study this gap using residential heat-pump control as a test bed, measuring the agreement between predicted and ground-truth effects of control interventions. Importantly, we find that TSFMs can recover the system's input-response relationship when the context contains sufficient independent control excitation. Common fine-tuning pipelines and feature smoothing reduce, but do not eliminate, the need for in-context excitation. Our results indicate that current TSFMs used for predictive control require sufficiently informative control variation in the inference context. Initial closed-loop results show promise for shorter context windows.

</details>


### [489] [EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06450)
*Tianhao Wu,Xu Wu,Amirmohammad Radmehr,Jiawei Yu,Yi Wu,Phuc Nguyen,Jian Liu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出EMG-FM-Bench基准，系统评估基础模型在肌电信号上的迁移与适配能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在通用时间序列和生理信号上发展迅速，但其在肌电任务中的可迁移性尚不明确，且肌电信号在用户、传感配置、采集硬件和下游任务间分布差异显著。

Method: 构建统一基准，整合20个公开肌电数据集、超100万段信号，评估9个预训练基础模型，围绕冻结/全微调表现、预训练相对从头训练增益、有限标注下新用户泛化、跨任务性能变化四个问题展开。

Result: 线性探测可提供预训练表征信息，但全微调会显著改变下游性能；预训练增益因模型而异且不普遍；新用户上性能下降，五样本适配在70.2%的模型-数据集组合中提升宏F1但仅恢复部分损失；上下肢分类表现高度一致，并与连续肌电到文本解码强相关。

Conclusion: 该基准系统揭示了预训练时间序列模型何时能有效迁移至肌电信号，以及性能如何依赖微调、用户差异和下游任务。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with over 1 million EMG segments and evaluates nine pretrained foundation models across four questions: how pretrained models perform when frozen or fully fine-tuned, how much pretraining helps compared with training the same model from scratch, how well models generalize to new users with limited labeled data, and how performance changes across different EMG tasks. Across the benchmark, linear probing provides useful information about pretrained representations, but full fine-tuning can substantially change downstream EMG performance. Comparing each pretrained model with the same model trained from scratch shows that the benefit of pretraining varies substantially across models and is not universal. Performance decreases when models are evaluated on new users, while five-shot adaptation improves macro-F1 in 70.2% of evaluated model-dataset combinations but recovers only part of the lost performance. Model performance is highly consistent between upper- and lower-limb classification and remains strongly correlated with continuous EMG-to-text decoding. Together, these results provide a systematic view of when pretrained time-series models transfer effectively to EMG and how their performance depends on fine-tuning, user variation, and downstream task.

</details>


### [490] [WaveGSSM: Graph Wave State Space Models for Propagating Spatio-Temporal Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06540)
*Junyou Zhu,Fenying Cai,Ping Xiong,Christian Nauck,Langzhou He,Chao Gao,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: WaveGSSM 是一种二阶图状态空间模型，为每个节点维护模式状态与变化率状态，通过图波转移耦合空间传播与时间演化，用于时序图预测与天气预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空图模型采用先空间后时间的设计，无法显式表征模式在图上的运动；实验表明，即使当前场相同，若近期变化率不同，未来演化也会不同，因此预测状态需显式包含运动信息。

Method: 在每个节点维护两个耦合隐状态：当前模式与时间变化率；引入图波转移，利用图交互更新运动状态，并用其推进模式状态，在单次 rollout 中耦合空间传播与时间演化。

Result: 在四个时序图基准与全球天气预报上评估，时序图基准平均性能最优；相比骨干匹配的快照模型，1 至 5 天天气预报的位势 RMSE 平均降低 20.2%，并更好地保持大尺度大气模式。

Conclusion: 显式建模运动状态的二阶图状态空间设计能有效提升传播过程的预测性能，在时序图与天气预报任务中均优于快照式模型。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal graph models typically encode each snapshot with a GNN and then connect the resulting representations through a temporal module. This space-then-time design is effective, yet it does not explicitly represent how a pattern moves across the graph. We show empirically that, for a propagating process, the same present field can lead to different futures when its recent rate of change differs, motivating an explicit representation of motion in the predictive state. We introduce WaveGSSM, a second-order graph state-space model that maintains two coupled latent states at each node, one for the current pattern and one for its temporal rate of change. A graph-wave transition updates the motion state through graph interactions and uses it to advance the pattern state, coupling spatial propagation and temporal evolution within a single rollout. We evaluate WaveGSSM on four temporal-graph benchmarks and global weather forecasting. It consistently achieves the best mean performance across the temporal-graph benchmarks and reduces the geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model, while better preserving large-scale atmospheric patterns.

</details>


### [491] [Empirical Variational Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06545)
*Kaede Shiohara*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出EVA，一种用于连续值序列的通用生成框架，通过在VAE上增加线性层从训练数据中经验学习自回归潜在先验，提升生成质量并加快推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VAE中先验与后验之间存在潜在分布差距，导致序列数据生成保真度低。

Method: 基于VAE的证据下界，用自预测先验替代标准高斯约束，仅需在VAE上增加一个线性层实现经验自回归潜在先验学习。

Result: 在图像和声音合成实验中，EVA生成质量与自回归扩散基线相当，但推理速度更快。

Conclusion: EVA有效缓解了先验与后验的分布差距，实现了高保真序列生成，并具有高效推理优势。

Abstract: We present Empirical Variational Autoencoder, a general generative framework for continuous-valued (i.e., non-vector-quantized) sequences. EVA is based on the evidence lower bound of the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) but learns autoregressive latent priors empirically from training data, which can be implemented only by an additional single linear layer on top of VAEs. By replacing the conventional standard-Gaussian constraint with the self-predicted priors, EVA significantly alleviates the latent distribution gap between prior and posterior which is typically observed in conventional VAEs, and leads to high-fidelity ancestral sampling for sequential data generation. Extensive experiments on image and sound synthesis demonstrate that EVA achieves competitive generation quality with autoregressive diffusion baselines despite its much faster inference time.

</details>


### [492] [LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06580)
*Louis Schiekiera,Max Zimmer,Christophe Roux,Manuel Arnold,Sebastian Pokutta,Fritz Günther*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出LinearPFN，一种预训练Transformer网络，摊销线性模型中尖峰-平板先验的变量选择推断，单次前向传播即得后验包含概率等结果，无需逐数据集拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尖峰-平板回归的后验随候选效应数指数增长，仅小规模可精确枚举，否则需MCMC近似，需逐数据集重跑且可能不收敛。

Method: 设计共轭先验使固定活跃效应集的后验有闭式解；用合成数据一次性预训练Transformer，输入新数据集经单次前向传播输出后验包含概率、后验均值系数和后验预测分布；涵盖主效应与成对交互。

Result: 在可枚举时验证网络输出与精确后验一致；在已发表社会科学数据集预测矩阵上（结果由先验生成、真实活跃集已知），LinearPFN的每数据集选择AUC和MPM规则下F1高于五个经典基线，且在系数、交互或噪声偏离先验时仍保持领先。

Conclusion: LinearPFN通过摊销推断高效逼近尖峰-平板后验，避免逐数据集拟合，在真实预测矩阵上优于经典方法，对先验偏离具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: https://github.com/schiekiera/LinearPFN. Trained model: https://huggingface.co/schiekiera/LinearPFN.

</details>


### [493] [The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06653)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Chiwun Yang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文在Birkhoff多面体上为流形约束超连接（mHC）建立了几何理论，揭示了其双随机混合器的收缩性质、Sinkhorn-logit映射的Fisher-Rao结构、梯度流在排列顶点附近的慢速移动以及Sinkhorn局部收敛因子对记忆视野的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hyper-connections将Transformer残差流拓宽为n条并行流，mHC用双随机矩阵逐层混合。作者希望从几何上理解这一设计的本质，解释宽度带来的额外记忆为何会衰减、Sinkhorn归一化的梯度动力学为何特殊，以及迭代预算如何限制有效视野。

Method: 将mHC的双随机混合器置于Birkhoff多面体上分析：分解为均值通道与差值通道，用第二奇异值σ2刻画逐层收缩；证明Sinkhorn-logit映射是全局坐标图，其logit梯度正是Fisher-Rao梯度，梯度流对应平方Fisher-Rao度量，直通更新等价于熵镜像下降；分析logit梯度流下各条目对数的移动速率与到最近排列的距离ε的关系；计算Sinkhorn的局部收敛因子。

Result: 差值通道每层被σ2≤1-n min H_ij收缩，形成视野为1/(1-σ2)层的衰退记忆，非负混合器中仅排列不坍缩；logit梯度流遵循平方Fisher-Rao度量，直通更新为熵镜像下降；梯度流下logit对数移动速率上界为4n^3||∇f||∞ ε，因此梯度流以1/t速率接近和离开排列顶点，而镜像下降呈指数速率；Sinkhorn局部收敛因子为σ2^2，固定迭代预算会限制记忆视野；实验验证了预测的速率。

Conclusion: mHC的额外宽度本质上是一种受双随机混合约束的衰退记忆，其动力学由Birkhoff多面体上的Fisher-Rao几何与熵镜像下降刻画；排列是唯一不坍缩的非负混合器，但梯度流在排列附近移动缓慢，而Sinkhorn的有限迭代预算进一步限制了有效记忆视野。

Abstract: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $σ_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-σ_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $σ_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.

</details>


### [494] [What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06666)
*Yassine Ouali,Adrian Bulat,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出潜空间推理的五项要求，并设计流匹配方法FLaRe满足这些要求，实现高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜推理方法存在学习捷径、蒸馏显式思维链、逐词模仿等问题，难以同时满足有效、多样、可解释、可优化、高效五项要求。

Method: 采用学习潜空间中的流匹配，设计FLaRe配方，涵盖潜空间编码内容与塑造、流训练位置、答案读取方式，以及基于模型自身验证思维的最后训练阶段。

Result: 针对每项要求的探测显示FLaRe在五项上均优于先前潜方法；在算术基准上表现更优，以四分之一延迟达到显式思维链97%的准确率。

Conclusion: FLaRe证明了流匹配潜推理能有效满足五项要求，在效率和准确性上具有优势。

Abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

</details>


### [495] [Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06671)
*Juan Garcia Giraldo,Matteo Santelmo,Eduard Durech,Imanol Schlag,Valentina Pyatkin,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种基于学生模型预测熵的动态逐token插值方法，以缓解小语言模型在蒸馏推理轨迹时产生的自信冲突问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型作为学生模仿更强教师的推理轨迹时，token级模仿常导致自信冲突，即学生需要模仿自己认为低概率但高置信的续写，从而引发泛化能力下降和灾难性遗忘。

Method: 熵感知混合：根据学生模型的预测熵，对学生和教师分布进行动态逐token插值；实现了凸插值和几何插值，并应用于离线轨迹生成（通过推测解码，然后SFT）和在线前向KL蒸馏。

Result: 熵感知混合稳定了蒸馏过程，在分布内和分布外数学推理上均有提升，同时比固定教师监督更好地保留了通用能力；最优熵调度取决于训练来源：离线生成轨迹偏好凹调度（教师影响更大），在线训练偏好线性或凸调度（教师集中在高熵状态）。

Conclusion: 熵感知混合能有效缓解自信冲突，提升蒸馏效果，但需根据训练来源调整熵调度策略以优化性能。

Abstract: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).

</details>


### [496] [How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06677)
*Tomás Brogueira,Marcos Treviso,Miguel Couceiro*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文研究稀疏概率映射（sparsemax、entmax、normmax）在MoE路由器训练后的专家参与行为，发现稀疏性并非映射本身属性，而是映射与学习到的分数分布共同适应的结果，且稀疏映射提升推理时对K值变化的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE路由器通常用softmax和top-K固定每个token使用K个专家；稀疏概率映射理论上可自适应分配零概率，实现token依赖的专家参与，但训练后这种稀疏性是否保留尚不明确。

Method: 训练匹配的300M和1B top-2 MoE语言模型，分别使用softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax和2-normmax作为路由概率映射，比较训练后各映射的专家参与、概率质量保留、top-2分数差距分布及验证损失，并测试推理时改变K的敏感性。

Result: 1B规模下，entmax比softmax少丢弃30%概率质量且几乎不丢弃已选专家；sparsemax保留最多质量；normmax将21%的token路由到单个专家。每种映射仅当top-2分数差达到固定阈值时才丢弃专家，而训练后的路由器学习到不同分数分布：entmax分数跨度约为softmax的一半，使其top-2差距低于阈值；sparsemax和normmax阈值相同但学习到不同差距分布，导致不同参与度。稀疏映射均未降低验证损失，但显著提升推理时增加K的鲁棒性：sparsemax用K=2训练、K=8推理仅损失0.02 nats，softmax损失0.58 nats。

Conclusion: 自适应MoE路由设计需围绕概率映射与学习分数的联合行为，而非仅依赖映射本身；映射产生零的能力不决定专家参与，路由器会共同适应分数。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.

</details>


### [497] [Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06679)
*Yoel Zeldes*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出激活对齐方法，通过在合成无标签数据上训练轻量线性变换，将使用部分上下文的“学生”模型中间激活映射到使用完整上下文的“教师”模型，从而在保持快速推理的同时缩小与全上下文模型的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习（ICL）进行预测，但每次前向传播都需处理全部训练样本，推理成本高昂；限制训练样本数量虽可降低成本，却会显著降低性能。因此需要一种方法在不增加推理负担的情况下，保留全上下文带来的性能优势。

Method: 激活对齐：在合成无标签数据上训练一个轻量线性变换，将数据受限的“学生”模型（仅使用部分上下文）的中间激活，对齐到全上下文“教师”模型的中间激活。该对齐器无需GPU，在普通硬件上数秒至数分钟即可收敛。

Result: 在TabArena基准的38个分类数据集上，使用TabPFN-3和TabFM两个领先表格基础模型评估，所有上下文预算下，对齐后的学生模型均较未对齐基线有显著且广泛的提升；在低数据场景下，对齐恢复了教师模型近一半的预测优势。

Conclusion: 激活对齐是一种实用、低开销的方法，能够以紧凑上下文的推理速度，显著缩小与全上下文教师模型之间的性能差距。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

</details>


### [498] [OVAL: Output-Aware Local Page Bases for KV Cache Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06686)
*Ashkan Shahbazi,Chayne Thrash,Soheil Kolouri*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出OVAL-KV，一种输出感知的页面编码方法，用于长上下文推理中的KV缓存稀疏注意力，无需训练且不增加存储和评分开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存不断增长导致注意力计算昂贵；现有页面稀疏注意力检索方法仅估计注意力分数或页面相关性，未直接考虑近似误差对值加权注意力输出的影响。

Method: OVAL-KV从键和值的联合结构中导出输出感知的页面编码，同时保留准确检索所需的键信息；无需训练，推理时无需额外的值相关统计；存储表示大小和解码时评分成本与仅键谱表示相同。

Result: 在长推理、长上下文理解和长生成基准上，OVAL-KV持续优于仅键谱基线，并与近期KV缓存压缩和检索方法竞争；在长推理基准上取得强avg@k性能，在多个长上下文理解和生成设置上匹配或超越领先基线，解码开销适中。

Conclusion: OVAL-KV通过输出感知的页面编码有效提升了页面稀疏注意力的近似质量，在多种长上下文任务中表现优异，且保持高效性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Long context inference with large language models becomes increasingly expensive as attention must operate over an ever growing KV cache. Page sparse attention reduces this cost by representing each KV page compactly and retrieving only a subset for each query. Existing retrieval methods are designed to estimate attention scores or page relevance, but their objectives do not directly account for how approximation errors affect the resulting value weighted attention output. We introduce \method{}, an output aware page encoding derived from the joint structure of keys and values while preserving the key information needed for accurate retrieval. \method{} is training free and requires no additional value dependent statistics at inference time. Once constructed, its stored representation has the same size and decode time scoring cost as a key only spectral representation. Across long reasoning, long context understanding, and long generation benchmarks, \method{} consistently improves over the key only spectral baseline and performs competitively with recent KV cache compression and retrieval methods. On long reasoning benchmarks, it achieves strong avg@\(k\) performance across model benchmark pairs, while matching or surpassing leading baselines on several long context understanding and generation settings with modest decoding overhead. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/Ashkan13776/oval-kv}.

</details>


### [499] [To Learn is to Wander: Learning Across Graphs and Tasks with Random Walks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06694)
*Louis Tichelman,Xingyue Huang,Jinwoo Kim,İsmail İlkan Ceylan*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出 Wander，一种可在单一预训练检查点中跨图模态和任务通用的图基础模型，将图学习形式化为部分观测图补全，并通过随机游走接口实现任务通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图基础模型通常仅在特定图模态或任务内泛化，缺乏跨图、特征空间、关系模式和预测任务的统一迁移能力。

Method: 基于先验预测视角，将图学习建模为部分观测图的补全；采用随机游走构建统一接口，支持同质图和多关系图及不同特征、标签和关系模式；推理时可扩大结构上下文而不改变已学参数，并在适当假设下对有限连通图上的贝叶斯最优预测器具有通用逼近性。

Result: 单个预训练检查点在节点分类、同质链接预测和知识图谱链接预测上达到最优或极具竞争力的性能；跨图模态与任务的联合预训练在保持专业场景性能的同时，支持正迁移及推理时组合单独学习的能力。

Conclusion: Wander 通过统一接口和联合预训练实现了跨图模态与任务的通用图基础模型，验证了单一检查点多任务泛化和能力组合的可行性。

Abstract: Graph foundation models aim to transfer across graphs, feature spaces, relational schemas, and prediction tasks, yet existing approaches typically generalize only within particular graph modalities or tasks. We propose Wander, a graph foundation model designed to operate across these settings within a single pretrained checkpoint. Following the prior-predictive perspective, we formulate graph learning as completion of a partially observed graph. We realize this task-general view through a common interface based on random walks, allowing the same model to operate across homogeneous and multi-relational graphs with varying features, labels, and relational schemas. Wander can increase its structural context at inference time without changing its learned parameters and, under suitable assumptions, universally approximates the corresponding Bayes-optimal predictor on bounded connected graphs. Empirically, a single pretrained checkpoint achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive results across node classification, homogeneous link prediction, and knowledge-graph link prediction. Moreover, joint pretraining across graph modalities and tasks preserves performance in specialized settings while enabling positive transfer and the composition of separately learned capabilities at inference time.

</details>


### [500] [Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06726)
*Marco Morik,Jesse Palarus,Carmen Vidaurre,Klaus-Robert Müller,Shinichi Nakajima*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出双流框架，将全局时序表征学习与逐时间点空间细化解耦，以缓解EEG源重建中精度与推理成本的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG源定位是严重病态的空间逆问题；现有深度学习方法存在两难：逐帧模型丢失时间上下文，完整4D时空网络则需在重建精度与推理开销之间权衡。

Method: 采用两流架构：Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder通过因子化时空注意力处理整段EEG序列并保留传感器级特征；随后固定逆算子将特征映射为源索引条件，供逐时间步的Source-Space Transformer或体积卷积细化器使用。训练时覆盖多种leadfield并引入显式算子失配。

Result: 在逼真合成数据上，该时序先验显著提升空间定位，优于经典与时空基线，尤其在高噪声和多源场景；跨leadfield与算子失配训练提升了对未见头几何的迁移，并使模板重建更接近个体化逆解；仅用合成EEG训练的模型可应用于真实EEG，基于睁眼/闭眼源功率差异训练的logistic回归成功解码年龄组。

Conclusion: 显式解耦全局时序建模与逐点空间细化能有效提升EEG源重建精度与泛化性，并具备从合成数据迁移到真实数据及下游解码任务的潜力。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

</details>


### [501] [MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06751)
*Dwaipayan Saha,Jacob Feitelberg,Kyuseong Choi,Raaz Dwivedi,Anish Agarwal*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出MatrixFormer，一种矩阵原生预训练Transformer，一次前向传播即可预测所有缺失条目的完整分布，并在多种矩阵补全任务上实现零样本竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型将矩阵补全视为逐条预测，需为每个目标重复上下文且忽略矩阵的二维结构。

Method: MatrixFormer完全在合成低秩与潜在因子矩阵及多样缺失模式上预训练，采用矩阵原生Transformer，单次前向预测每个缺失条目的完整分布。

Result: 使用相同权重零样本应用时，在因果推断面板数据任务、语言模型基准分数补全、表格插补和推荐系统矩阵补全上均取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: MatrixFormer可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型。

Abstract: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

</details>


### [502] [Round-Trip KNN Clustering: multiscale hierarchical cluster detection on directed nearest-neighbour graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06795)
*Eraldo Pereira Marinho,Caetano Mazzoni Ranieri,Fabricio Aparecido Breve*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种无需预设簇数的图聚类方法RTKNNC，利用有向k近邻的双向选择关系进行递归遍历，并可选地进行无标签细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统KNN图聚类通常先将k近邻图无向化，且需预先指定簇数；希望保留邻居关系的双向信息，并在多个邻域尺度下自动发现簇结构。

Method: RTKNNC保留k近邻的有向关系，将入边选择作为加权投票，通过递归前向-反向遍历决定局部连接；随K增大重复该过程以观察簇的持续或合并；针对桥接或重叠导致的错误连通，增加无标签细化，用2或3个高斯子群检验已形成组件，满足规模与KNN图一致性时才接受细分。

Result: 在8个合成数据集、K=2至16的120次参考运行中，独立C和Python实现得到完全相同的划分；细化使变密度基准的调整兰德指数从0.7817升至0.9627，稀疏桥基准从0.8083升至0.9853；与7种外部聚类方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: RTKNNC能在无需预先指定簇数的情况下跨邻域尺度构建簇结构，双向KNN投票与无标签细化有效提升聚类质量，并保持实现一致性与竞争性能。

Abstract: We introduce Round-Trip KNN Clustering (RTKNNC), a graph-based method for finding cluster structure at several neighbourhood scales without requiring the number of clusters in advance. Unlike approaches that first make a $k$-nearest-neighbour (KNN) graph undirected, RTKNNC keeps both directions of the neighbour relation: which points a given point selects and which points select it. Incoming selections are treated as weighted votes that help decide which local connections remain visible during a recursive forward-and-reverse traversal. Repeating the procedure for increasing $K$ reveals how groups persist or merge as the neighbourhood scale grows; for the reference inverse-square model before structural refinement, clusters can merge but do not split. Because graph connectivity can occasionally join distinct groups through a sparse bridge or a small region of overlap, we add an optional label-free refinement. It first tests whether an already formed component is better described by two or three Gaussian subpopulations, and accepts a subdivision only when the proposed groups are large enough and consistent with the visible KNN graph. Across eight synthetic datasets and $K=2,\ldots,16$, independent C and Python implementations produced identical partitions in all 120 reference runs. Refinement increased adjusted Rand index from $0.7817$ to $0.9627$ on a variable-density benchmark and from $0.8083$ to $0.9853$ on a sparse-bridge benchmark. Comparisons with seven external clustering methods show competitive performance while preserving a label-free cluster-construction process.

</details>


### [503] [Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06804)
*Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Seyedarmin Azizi,Arya Fayyazi,Saeid Shokoufa,Mehdi Kamal,Souvik Kundu,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: OPPD通过将幂分布蒸馏到单次生成中，无需修改参数或多次采样即可提升语言模型推理能力，在多个数学和代码基准上取得显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幂采样（power sampling）虽能提升推理，但需对每个查询生成多个候选并评分，计算成本高。本文旨在训练模型单次生成即可输出幂分布下的高质量答案。

Method: 提出在策略幂蒸馏（OPPD）：使用顺序蒙特卡洛采样器，由待训练模型生成候选，冻结教师模型的幂分布对其加权，并以相同概率进行最大似然更新。通过一个损失系数调节模型吸收的锐化指数。

Result: 在MATH500和GSM8K上，单次生成准确率分别比未训练模型提升23.0和27.3点；单次生成比已发表的64候选幂采样高2.4和3.5点，达到16候选未训练模型增益的94%。相比GRPO，在无参考答案下MATH500、GSM8K、AIME分别高3.8、4.0、5.4点，且两者互补，GRPO后应用OPPD可再提升9.3点。仅在数学上训练，HumanEval准确率提升5.3点。锐化指数可在1.19至2.02间调节（普通在策略蒸馏为1.14），增益主要来自模型自身答案。

Conclusion: OPPD能高效地将幂采样的优势蒸馏到单次生成中，跨模型家族和规模均有效，且与基于验证奖励的GRPO互补，无需参考答案即可显著提升推理性能。

Abstract: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.

</details>


### [504] [H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06805)
*Wancong Zhang,Basile Terver,Michael Rabbat,Yann LeCun,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出H-JEPA，一种端到端训练层次化动作条件JEPA世界模型的方法，各级在不同抽象层级和自身潜在空间中进行预测与规划，提升长时程规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有任务无关JEPA世界模型仅在单一时间尺度或单一共享潜在空间中进行多视野预测与规划，难以有效处理具有分离时间尺度的长时程规划问题。

Method: 端到端训练层次化动作条件JEPA，每级在自身学习到的潜在空间中预测更远的未来；规划自顶向下进行，顶层优化向目标的进展，各级预测成为下级的子目标；结合逆动力学监督。

Result: 在四个仿真导航与操作环境中，层次化规划优于平坦JEPA；Visual AntMaze上三级层次将成功率从18%提升至73%，且规划计算量更少；消融实验表明增益来自时间分解和高层目标表征；结合逆动力学监督可扩展到DROID真实机器人视频，提升离线规划保真度并降低规划计算量。

Conclusion: 层次化时间分解与高层目标表征显著提升JEPA世界模型的长时程规划能力，并在仿真与真实机器人数据上验证了有效性与计算效率。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

</details>


### [505] [Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06809)
*Emre Acartürk,Pranamya Kulkarni,Puranjay Datta,Karthikeyan Shanmugam,Burak Varıcı,Ali Tajer*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文针对干预式因果表示学习（CRL），在更弱的干预假设下建立可识别性保证，实现因果变量的块解耦，并将其用于无标签的具身视觉状态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CRL的可识别性保证依赖高度理想化假设，难以直接应用于真实问题；同时缺少将无标签CRL从理论推向实践的桥梁。

Method: 在干预式CRL中放宽干预机制假设，推导块解耦形式的可识别性保证；将块解耦框架应用于具身视觉状态估计，直接从图像和视频中恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量。

Result: 在显著更弱的干预假设下获得块解耦的可识别性保证；在受控具身场景中，即使存在进一步的假设违背，所提目标仍然有效。

Conclusion: 块解耦理论与具身视觉状态估计应用相互补充，为将无标签CRL应用于实际问题提供了从理论到实践的桥梁。

Abstract: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data. These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.

</details>


### [506] [Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06823)
*Tanbin Islam Rohan,Pranjol Sen Gupta,Tanusree Debi,Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出基于Transformer的SeqSmoother，从腕部加速度计信号中估计睡眠心率，并与Nightbeat比较，揭示精度与可用性的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型纵向队列常仅采集腕部加速度计而无光学心率传感，需从睡眠期运动信号中恢复心脏信息。
