*Xiaxun Xie,Qingqing Long,Meng Xiao,Wei Ju,Yuanchun Zhou,Xuezhi Wang,Hengshu Zhu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出首个评估AI智能体与AI科学家从实证数据生成机制性假设能力的基准MechHypoBench，并揭示现有方法生成的假设与真实机制存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的机制性假设对科学发现至关重要，但AI智能体与AI科学家将实证发现转化为机制性假设的能力尚未得到充分检验。

Method: 构建MechHypoBench基准，整合来自14个科学领域的论文推导机制与包含1798万条记录的真实数据集，保留观测复杂性并指定底层机制；智能体分析观测并提出开放式假设；开发评估框架，通过保留条件下的后果评估开放式机制性假设。

Result: 对通用智能体和AI科学家的实验表明，生成的假设与底层机制之间存在显著差距。

Conclusion: 当前AI智能体与AI科学家在从实证数据生成机制性假设方面能力不足，MechHypoBench为评估和改进该能力提供了基准。

Abstract: Data-driven mechanistic hypotheses are essential to scientific discovery because they explain how underlying processes produce observed phenomena. AI agents and AI scientists increasingly support scientific data analysis. However, their ability to turn empirical findings into mechanistic hypotheses remains insufficiently examined. To address this gap, we introduce MechHypoBench, the first benchmark for evaluating whether AI agents and AI scientists can generate such hypotheses from empirical data. It combines paper-derived mechanisms from 14 scientific fields with real-world datasets containing 17.98 million records. The construction retains the observational complexity of empirical data while providing a specified underlying mechanism. Agents analyze the observations and propose open-form hypotheses. We develop an evaluation framework that assesses open-form mechanistic hypotheses through their consequences under withheld conditions. Experiments with general agents and AI scientists reveal a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and the underlying mechanisms.

</details>


### [577] [Beyond Overparameterization: Provable Learning of Input-Convex Multi-Layer Polynomial Networks with Active Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04999)
*Jinqi Tang,Qian Chen,Shihong Ding,Cong Fang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出ASPIRE算法，通过主动查询和逐层对角化，首次在多项式时间内实现深层多项式网络的参数级恢复，样本复杂度随深度仅多项式增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络理论多局限于过参数化设置，NTK方法缺乏高效样本复杂度保证，特征学习分析常限于浅层或特定架构，且难以实现参数级恢复。

Method: 针对L层偶次k次单项式激活且高层权重非负的多项式网络，利用输入凸性和主动查询，提出ASPIRE（基于特征方向的迭代恢复主动采样）算法，逐层采样对角化以恢复所有网络参数。

Result: ASPIRE算法以δ精度恢复所有网络参数，样本复杂度为Õ_{k,L}(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e})，多项式时间运行，指数仅随深度多项式增长。

Conclusion: 这是首个对深层目标网络的参数恢复保证，其指数仅随深度多项式增长，也首次从理论上证明了高质量数据在神经网络训练中的有效性，并展现出显著的指数级分离。

Abstract: The theoretical understanding of multi-layer neural networks is largely confined to overparameterized settings, which obscure parameter identifiability and incur high sample complexity. Neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides a general theory for wide networks, but does not offer efficient sample-complexity guarantees. Recent feature-learning results go beyond kernel methods for single-neuron, multi-index, and hierarchical targets. However, the analysis is often restricted to shallow or specific architectures and to the overparameterized regime. We break this paradigm to achieve parameter-level recovery of deep target networks, albeit by using active data queries. Specifically, we study $L$-layer polynomial networks with even degree-$k$ monomial activations and nonnegative higher-layer weights. This structure makes the target network input-convex, while the optimization landscape remains highly nonconvex with respect to the parameters. Leveraging input convexity and active queries, we propose \textbf{ASPIRE} (\textbf{A}ctive \textbf{S}am\textbf{P}ling for \textbf{I}terative \textbf{R}ecovery via \textbf{E}igendirections), a layerwise sampling-based diagonalization algorithm that recovers all network parameters to $δ$-accuracy with sample complexity $ \widetilde O_{k,L}\left(d^{L^2+O(L)}δ^{-2e}\right) $ in polynomial time. To our knowledge, this is the \emph{first} parameter-recovery guarantee for deep target networks whose exponent grows only polynomially with depth, as well as the \emph{first} justification for the effectiveness of using high-quality data in neural network training, with a remarkably \emph{exponential} separation.

</details>


### [578] [Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05071)
*Mikhail Persiianov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出离散动作匹配（DAM），用于从无配对时序边缘分布中学习种群动态，并在合成和真实数据上验证了其重建与插值能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从无配对时序边缘分布学习种群动态是一个不适定逆问题，需要对底层动态做结构假设；现有方法难以在离散状态空间中有效处理。

Method: 基于离散Wasserstein几何，为给定边缘路径和传输几何推导最小动能流的动作最小化目标；发现离散动作的密度依赖性可简化为邻近密度比，在快照的经验插值上先估计这些比值，再学习动作势，所得场定义图支撑的马尔可夫采样器。

Result: 在受控合成动态和真实小鼠原肠胚数据上评估了边缘重建与插值；额外实验从配对样本近似数值表面传输路径。

Conclusion: DAM为离散状态种群动态学习提供了基于动作最小化的有效框架，能同时实现边缘重建、插值及图上的马尔可夫采样。

Abstract: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.

</details>


### [579] [Learning Field Reconstruction from Incomplete Data by Globally Correcting Local Estimates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05375)
*Renhao Zhong,Zihan Zhou,Chiyuan Ma,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 针对训练样本不完整时物理场重建的困难，提出一种局部构建、全局修正的估计器，先学习局部场估计，再通过全域观测进行残差校正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文-查询方法虽能提供有效训练目标，但无法在训练场不完整时辨识完整场分布；有限数据下弱证据易导致过度平滑，需引入基于观测的局部空间结构先验。

Method: 共享的坐标条件预测器从非完整patch学习局部场估计，重叠预测融合为观测条件共识场；全域估计器保留原始观测，在冻结的局部估计上学习残差修正，并将局部估计及其与观测的差异作为显式输入和预测起点。

Result: 在三个具有真实观测缺口的海洋数据集上，于保留的源支持值上取得最低MSE和最高PSNR，相比最强外部基线MSE降低28.9%–34.5%。

Conclusion: 局部构建与全局修正相结合的两阶段估计器能有效利用不完整观测中的局部结构，并借助全域证据修正，显著提升物理场重建精度。

Abstract: Reconstructing physical fields from training samples that are always incomplete requires learning spatial structure from fragmented observations.Existing context--query work establishes how held-out observations provide valid training targets, but this does not make the complete-field distribution identifiable when every training field is incomplete.With finite data, weak evidence of sharp transitions and localized variations can further favor averaged predictions that attenuate local detail.A structural prior is therefore needed to favor plausible completions; local spatial relationships offer one grounded in the observations.We propose a locally constructed, globally revisable estimator that explicitly learns local field estimates and subsequently corrects them using full-domain observations.A shared coordinate-conditioned predictor learns from incomplete patches, allowing relatively well-observed neighborhoods to provide direct supervision of local structure.Its overlapping predictions are reconciled into an observation-conditioned consensus field.A full-domain estimator retains the original observations and learns a residual correction around this frozen field estimate, allowing locally constructed structure to be revised by broader evidence.The local estimate serves as both an explicit input, accompanied by its discrepancies with the observations, and a prediction starting point that the global model can revise.On three real-world ocean datasets with authentic observation gaps, our estimator achieves the lowest MSE and highest PSNR on withheld source-supported values, reducing MSE by 28.9\%--34.5\% against the strongest external baseline.

</details>


### [580] [ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05074)
*Qifan Zhang,Ziran Zhou,Ruijie Li,Jincheng Tang,Hao Wang,Qihao Qiao,Chunliu Wang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出ReDiffNet，一种基于可靠性条件差分表示的网络，用于低光照无人机RGB-红外小车辆检测，通过模态可靠性引导证据选择与互补恢复，在DroneVehicle和VEDAI上分别达到85.3%和73.9% mAP50。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光照无人机RGB-红外小车辆检测对夜间交通监控、应急响应和城市巡检至关重要，但光照变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影和热响应退化导致模态可靠性空间变化，且车辆视觉范围小进一步削弱边界、方向线索和热响应，因此需要基于局部模态可靠性选择可信观测并利用互补判别信息。

Method: ReDiffNet包含三个模块：退化感知可靠性学习估计相对空间可靠性；不确定性引导差分恢复利用跨模态差异恢复模糊区域的互补线索；可靠性条件重建将保留和恢复的证据整合为统一表示。

Result: 在DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集上分别达到85.3%和73.9% mAP50。

Conclusion: ReDiffNet通过模态可靠性引导的证据选择与互补恢复，有效提升了低光照无人机RGB-红外小车辆检测性能。

Abstract: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

</details>


### [581] [PharmAgent: Constraint-Aware Search with Frozen Language Models for Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05431)
*Nihui Shao,Guanxing Chen,Jilong Shi,Zhengyang Bai,Haohuai He,Zhenchao Tang,Qiujie Lv,Yu-An Huang,Zhi-An Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出约束感知分子搜索方法PharmAgent，利用自适应外部状态（拉格朗日控制器与结构索引回放）在有限评估预算下优化目标活性并满足可开发性约束，在五个任务上均取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典分子优化方法需定制规则或训练才能融入化学指令与性质反馈；冻结语言模型虽可条件化编辑，但缺乏显式约束控制与相关经验。

Method: PharmAgent由拉格朗日控制器将接受状态中的违规转化为累积约束压力，并将该历史与当前性质测量分离；结构索引回放提供相关已评估转移以指导后续提议；课程式逐步激活约束，候选与当前解在同一当前目标下比较，接受状态决定乘子更新；推导了接受状态违规在乘子中累积的精确恒等式。

Result: 五个任务各五次独立运行：仅目标搜索的曲线下面积和（AUC）为3.9208，较MOLLEO提升37.3%；带在线约束的性质调整AUC为0.7076，较最强在线基线ExLLM提升53.8%；在仅目标与约束感知搜索中均排名第一，在线比较覆盖全部五个基线框架；完整系统在目标质量、性质调整性能与Pareto超体积上均优于所有消融变体；五个分子案例均达到可行最终状态。

Conclusion: PharmAgent通过自适应外部状态实现约束感知分子搜索，在目标优化与约束满足间取得有效平衡，性能显著优于现有基线，且各消融与案例验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Molecular optimization must improve target activity and satisfy developability constraints within limited evaluation budgets. Classical methods require tailored rules or training to incorporate chemical instructions and property feedback. Frozen language models can condition edits on this information, but need explicit constraint control and relevant experience. We therefore present PharmAgent, a constraint-aware molecular search method driven by adaptive external state. Its Lagrangian controller translates violations in accepted states into accumulated constraint pressure, keeping this history separate from current property measurements. Structure-indexed replay complements this feedback with relevant evaluated transitions that guide subsequent proposals. As a curriculum progressively activates constraints, candidates and the incumbent are compared under the same current objective, and the accepted state determines the next multiplier update. We derive an exact identity that characterizes how accepted-state violations accumulate in the controller's multipliers. Across five tasks with five independent runs, PharmAgent achieves a summed area under the target-score curves (AUC) of 3.9208 in target-only search, improving over MOLLEO by 37.3%. With online constraints, it achieves a property-adjusted AUC of 0.7076, improving over the strongest online baseline, ExLLM, by 53.8%. These results rank first among all evaluated methods in both target-only and constraint-aware search. The online comparison covers all five baseline frameworks. The full system leads every ablation variant in target quality, property-adjusted performance, and Pareto hypervolume. All five molecular cases reach feasible final states, documenting target gains and trade-offs.

</details>


### [582] [Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05108)
*Richard Lee Kim,Yeongmin Kim,Gyuwon Sim,Taekyu Kim,Minsang Park,Il-chul Moon*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出BoNG方法，将Best-of-N采样原理融入扩散模型反向过程，通过粒子间不对称引导交互，提升生成样本的奖励对齐和平均质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Best-of-N采样仅在最终选择阶段利用奖励信息，不改进反向扩散轨迹，导致平均对齐未提升且仅适用于单输出场景。

Method: BoNG在去噪粒子间引入不对称引导交互，将当前BoN粒子作为引导信号作用于其余粒子群，在线进行BoN选择并调整反向扩散过程，使粒子群向高奖励区域移动。

Result: 在36项对比中，BoNG在29项表现最佳，对SMC和Vanilla BoN的胜率80.56%；支持多输出，ImageReward为最新样本引导方法的1.3倍，速度提升1.6倍。

Conclusion: BoNG通过将BoN采样融入反向扩散，不仅提升最终最佳样本，还改善生成样本的平均质量，并支持高效多输出生成。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.

</details>


### [583] [Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05127)
*Niruta Chapagain,Rohit Raj,Bertwin Kurisinkal Shine,Aditya A S*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 比较固定权重、梯度归一化和基于规则自适应控制的物理信息神经网络（PINN），发现自适应控制可降低PDE残差但增加边界条件损失，提出应使用独立指标评估PINN训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应方法在训练中动态调整PDE、边界和初始条件损失的权重，导致加权总损失不可直接比较，因此需要评估不同权重策略对各项物理约束和求解精度的影响。

Method: 在热方程基准和简化的Czochralski热流体问题上，以匹配设置对比固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）和基于规则的自适应控制器（AgenticPINN）；另用高斯过程代理在修正的Czochralski CFD参数扫描上进行逐案例留出测试。

Result: 在晶体生长MLP实验中，自适应控制将PDE残差从10^-5量级降至10^-6量级，但边界条件损失从10^-5量级升至10^-2量级；热方程基准上，GNPINN相对L2场误差最低（0.054），AgenticPINN PDE残差最小但相对L2误差为1.368；高斯过程代理在温度扫描的温度场误差约6%，在晶体旋转扫描的轴向速度误差约42%。

Conclusion: 自适应控制可改善方程满足程度，但可能削弱其他物理约束；PINN训练应使用独立的PDE、边界条件和解误差指标进行评估，而非仅依赖加权总损失。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

</details>


### [584] [Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05143)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 针对强化学习策略在分布外幅度偏移下性能退化的问题，在SAC及BAPR基础上研究CS-BAPR族，通过六种训练稳定设置与不同actor头组合提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习策略在分布外幅度偏移下容易性能恶化，需要提升其鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Method: 以soft actor-critic (SAC)及其贝叶斯遗忘分段鲁棒(BAPR)前身为起点，研究因果符号BAPR(CS-BAPR)家族；将六种训练稳定设置与替代actor头结合，包括带NMU启发的二次修正的神经加法单元(NAU)、Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)，以及使用ReLU或tanh激活的多层感知机(MLP)。

Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或性能数值。

Conclusion: 摘要未给出明确结论，仅提出CS-BAPR方法框架与actor头设计组合。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

</details>


### [585] [The Functional Structure of Post-Compression Recovery in Low-Rank LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05504)
*Zishan Shao,Liang Tian,Georgiy Zemlevskiy,Kangning Cui,Lixun Zhang,Yixiao Wang,Ting Jiang,Jinhee Kim,Yixuan Chen,Rui-Feng Wang,Fan Yang,Hai Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 低秩压缩方法在压缩后恢复过程中表现出异质性，本文将其形式化为可复现的压缩诱导功能结构（恢复压力），并开发标准化功能表征来追踪其在整个恢复过程中的演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同低秩压缩方法产生的LLM在相同恢复程序下响应不同，方法间的相对优势在恢复后可能缩小、扩大甚至反转，因此需要探究这种恢复异质性是否反映了标量损失演化之外的功能结构。

Method: 在每种骨干网络内开发标准化的功能表征，适用于异构低秩方法；主要采用反向表征，辅以前向表征，在独立探针下分析模块级结构。

Result: 反向表征揭示可复现的模块级结构，前向表征无需损失或反向传播即可恢复相关结构；端点恢复压力与后续恢复响应相关，恢复期间模块级结构非均匀重组，局部更新引发超出直接更新模块的分布式响应。

Conclusion: 恢复异质性反映了可复现的压缩诱导功能结构（恢复压力），追踪该演化结构可与标量损失互补地观察恢复进展。

Abstract: Different low-rank compression methods can produce compressed LLMs that respond differently to the same post-compression recovery procedure, and relative advantages observed between methods at the compression endpoint may shrink, grow, or even reverse after recovery. We ask whether this recovery heterogeneity reflects functional structure beyond scalar loss evolution, and how that structure evolves throughout recovery. Our results establish that this heterogeneity reflects a reproducible compression-induced functional structure, which we formalize as recovery pressure. To characterize this structure consistently throughout recovery, we develop a standardized functional characterization within each backbone that is applicable across heterogeneous low-rank methods. The primary backward characterization reveals reproducible module-wise structure across independent probes, while a complementary forward-only characterization recovers related structure without loss or backpropagation. We further find that recovery pressure measured at the endpoint is associated with subsequent recovery response; during recovery, its module-wise structure is reorganized non-uniformly, and localized updates induce distributed responses beyond directly updated modules. Further evidence indicates that tracking this evolving structure provides a complementary functional view of recovery progress alongside scalar loss.

</details>


### [586] [Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05196)
*Yew Lee Tan*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文研究在风险监管的单调性约束下，学习型聚合相对于手工设计聚合的价值，发现两者在可分离族内可相互替代，但学习通道在特定场景具有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险监管对评分施加方向性约束，要求评分对每个暴露输入单调非减。现有部署流程（手工聚合+符号约束梯度提升）已免费满足该约束。作者希望固定可容许性，衡量学习聚合本身的价值，而非比较约束与无约束模型。

Method: 采用循环网络，状态为经典风险统计量（指数加权移动平均和高水位标记及学习变换），构造上对每个输入和每个MC-dropout样本单调。通过函数回归分析学习单调通道与手工统计量的关系。

Result: 学习单调通道以Spearman ρ≥0.996复现几何加权可分离族，近似窗口统计量但有上限，在连续性（ρ=0.924）、时间定位（0.628）和暴露下限（0.829）上失败；显式可容许基可修复每个失败（秩相关1.000）。在可分离族内，学习与工程聚合可替代，学习通道在全样本和指定容量下不落后。优势包括：覆盖衰减区域（AUC差0.019），高维比较器在数据稀缺时退化更快，训练支持外树集成评分变平而严格递增头保持排序。

Conclusion: 没有单一现有方法在所有三个轴上占优；学习聚合在可分离族内是替代品，其优势取决于具体现有方法。

Abstract: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $ρ\ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($ρ= 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.

</details>


### [587] [Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05199)
*Dhia naouali*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 比较扩散采样中，早期步骤传输的扰动与新鲜各向同性噪声在晚期潜状态下的放大效应，发现前者角增益更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准测量用新鲜各向同性噪声回答晚期潜状态对扰动的放大问题，但采样中实际扰动已被早期步骤变换，需直接比较两种情形。

Method: 对每条轨迹，将中心扰动从早期步骤传输到晚期状态，再以与新鲜各向同性扰动相同的幅度重放其方向，之后两者经历相同的剩余更新。

Result: 所研究采样器的中位配对成形-新鲜角增益比在1.14到2.35之间；原始主队列每条轨迹中成形角增益均超过匹配的新鲜对应值；潜RMS端点变化和感知特征表示中同样出现该效应；跨轨迹置换成形方向会削弱效应，包括类内置换。

Conclusion: 早期采样方向在端点引起更大变化，该优势既依赖于与接收轨迹的对齐，也依赖于共享的方向结构。

Abstract: How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining
  updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature
  changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

</details>


### [588] [More Claims, Less Evidence: Bounded Verification of AI-Generated Digital Knowledge Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05547)
*Feliks Bańka,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文针对生成型知识对象在验证预算受限时，部分检查通过能否代表整体可靠的问题，提出以“通过预测值”（PVP）为核心的贝叶斯有界验证模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字图书馆、知识库和AI知识服务依赖生成系统产出多断言知识对象，但生成规模远超人工验证能力，评审者只能检查少量断言，导致断言级验证与整体置信度之间存在根本性缺口。

Method: 构建以PVP为中心的贝叶斯有界验证模型：在固定验证容量下，分析证据价值随工件规模增大而下降、随验证预算增加而提升、且在错误稀疏时更脆弱的规律；并在FEVEROUS和FEVER数据集上开展受控实验进行验证。

Result: 实验支持模型预测：在固定数量虚假或未支持断言周围添加受支持断言，会提高通过概率但同时降低通过的信息量；模型还能给出维持目标PVP所需的最小验证预算。

Conclusion: 该模型为AI辅助质量保障工作流提供了实用组件，用于在发布或下游使用前评估生成知识对象的整体可靠性，并指导验证预算配置。

Abstract: Digital libraries, repositories, and AI-mediated knowledge services increasingly rely on generative systems to produce summaries, descriptions, and other multi-claim knowledge objects. Yet generation can scale far more easily than verification capacity: a reviewer may need to decide whether an object is suitable for publication or downstream use after checking only a small fraction of its claims. This creates a fundamental gap between claim-level verification and confidence in the object as a whole. The central question is therefore what a successful partial check implies about the reliability of the complete artifact when its size grows but the verification budget does not. This paper contributes a Bayesian model of bounded verification centered on the Predictive Value of Pass (PVP). The model predicts that evidentiary value decreases as artifacts grow under fixed verification capacity, improves with larger verification budgets, and is especially fragile when errors are sparse. Controlled experiments on FEVEROUS and FEVER support these predictions and show that adding supported claims around a fixed number of false or unsupported claims can make passing more likely while making a pass less informative. The model further yields the minimum verification budget required to maintain a target PVP, providing a practical component for AI-assisted quality-assurance workflows in which generated knowledge objects must be checked before publication or downstream use.

</details>


### [589] [LifeLong Digital Twin: A Unified Modeling Paradigm and Agent Harness for Event-Driven Lifelong Health State Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05566)
*Jin Jiang,Sean Yates,Jasper Chong,Raymond Brooks,Alex Lawson,Yuqin Qin,Liangcai Gao*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出LifeLong Digital Twin统一事件驱动建模范式，将生命事件组织为每日健康状态并累积为终身健康上下文，配合Agent Harness整合多模态证据，在疾病轨迹预测、风险排序和多时间跨度预测任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类健康是贯穿生命历程的动态轨迹，整合纵向记录、遗传变异、分子谱和环境暴露等全生命周期健康信息对全人建模至关重要，但仍面临重大挑战。

Method: 构建LifeLong Digital Twin事件驱动建模范式，将生命事件组织为每日健康状态并累积为终身健康上下文；配套Agent Harness在语言模型文本上下文之外引入多模态证据；在25个疾病终点、三个任务上评估四种语言模型。

Result: 模型平均F1在轨迹预测的疾病识别上提升22.0%，在五年疾病结局上提升18.3%；甲状腺疾病F1达到0.669。

Conclusion: 该框架为全人数字孪生及个性化终身疾病预防研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Human health is a continuous, dynamic trajectory shaped by the cumulative interplay of biological processes, clinical events, behaviors and environmental exposures across the life course. Unifying the full breadth of lifelong health information, including longitudinal records, genetic variation, molecular profiles and environmental histories, is essential for whole-person modeling and remains a major challenge. We introduce LifeLong Digital Twin, a unified, event-driven modeling paradigm that organizes Life Events into daily Health States and accumulates them into Lifelong Health Context. An accompanying Agent Harness incorporates multimodal evidence beyond the language model's textual context. We evaluate four language models across 25 disease endpoints on three tasks: Disease Trajectory Forecasting, Disease Risk Ranking and Multi-horizon Disease Prediction. The approach yields marked gains over the reference condition: model-averaged F1 increases by 22.0% for disease identification in trajectory forecasting and 18.3% for five-year disease outcomes; thyroid-disease F1 reaches 0.669. The framework provides a foundation for whole-person digital twins and research on personalized lifelong disease prevention.

</details>


### [590] [Factoriax: A GPU-Accelerated Factorio-Style Simulator for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05569)
*Mickey Beurskens,Tristan Tomilin,Thiago D. Simão*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 GPU 加速的工厂建造模拟器 Factoriax，并发布 Easy Rocket 基准及 PPO 训练结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为研究智能体在资源收集、机器建造与自动化生产管线中的长期规划与空间配置能力，提供快速可扩展的模拟环境。

Method: 使用 JAX 实现 Factoriax 模拟器；在 Easy Rocket 基准中，智能体需在限定游戏 tick 内建造 Rocket；采用 PPO 算法和基于人工设计成就的课程奖励进行训练。

Result: 10 亿步 PPO 训练（约 50 万 episode）在单张 NVIDIA A100 上约 8 分钟，标准笔记本 GPU 约 84 分钟；训练后智能体学会收集资源、合成机器并放置，但未能形成功能性空间配置，无法完全完成基准。

Conclusion: Factoriax 提供了高效训练环境，但 Easy Rocket 基准仍未被解决，智能体在空间配置规划上存在不足，该挑战留待未来研究。

Abstract: We introduce Factoriax, a GPU-accelerated factory-building simulator written in JAX. In Factoriax, an agent must collect resources, build machines using those resources, and then automate the collection and crafting process by arranging machines on the map to build production pipelines. This paper discusses the structure of the Factoriax simulator and an initial benchmark called Easy Rocket in which an agent is tasked with building a resource-intensive machine called the Rocket in a limited number of game ticks to escape the planet. We also publish results from a number of PPO-based training runs on Easy Rocket. Factoriax is built to be fast. A 1-billion-step PPO training run, equivalent to 500,000 episodes, runs on Easy Rocket in about 8 minutes on a single NVIDIA A100. A standard laptop GPU can complete the same run in about 84 minutes. Our trained PPO agent learns to gather resources, craft machines from those resources, and place them on the map through a curriculum reward directly tied to a manually designed set of achievements. After training, the agent does not place machines in a functional spatial configuration, failing to fully complete the benchmark, and leaving the challenge open for future attempts.

</details>


### [591] [Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05240)
*Xilin Dai,Hongzhou Chen,Yifan Hu,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出Pythia，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的时间序列基础世界模型，通过共享预训练学习上下文条件潜在动态，并在MUSE上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本上下文和辅助观测提供互补信息，但可复用的多模态预测表示尚未被充分探索。

Method: 采用联合嵌入预测架构，利用停止梯度的数值参考指导对预测未来状态的上下文修正；独立的概率解码器适应冻结的预测表示和观测历史，解耦世界模型预训练与观测空间预测。

Result: 在MUSE上，Pythia-Tiny的MASE为0.6879，WSQL为0.4269，相对已发布MUSE排行榜最强模型分别降低误差6.26%和5.00%。

Conclusion: 支持将预测表示学习与概率读出分离，并表明实体描述、事件和协变量具有互补贡献。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.

</details>


### [592] [Better Retrieval, Limited Clustering Gains: A Controlled Study of Multilingual Company Entity Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05573)
*Yijiashun Qi,Yuxuan Li,Hanzhe Guo*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 在固定候选预算和下游决策规则下，改进名称检索对配对分类器不变时公司聚类影响甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究检索性能提升为何难以传导至最终聚类质量，明确瓶颈所在阶段。

Method: 基于多语言E5编码器，采用随机负样本与硬负样本训练，固定正样本调度，在72,660条候选边预算下评估多视图选择器与主匹配器，并使用3,633个名称、2,880个源身份和882个银标准正例对进行检验。

Result: 多视图选择器将直接配对召回率从53.74%提升至76.98%；主匹配器仅新增7个正确和2个错误共聚对，聚类召回率从32.54%升至33.33%，精确率从95.99%降至95.45%；208个新检索银正例中202个低于决策阈值；随机负样本与硬负样本训练得到相同最终划分。

Conclusion: 检索增益的即时损失发生在现有确认阶段，编码器评估必须同时测量最终聚类质量。

Abstract: Improved name retrieval may have little effect on company clusters when the pair classifier remains unchanged. We examine this dependency by adapting multilingual E5 encoders under fixed candidate budgets and downstream decision rules. Random-negative and hard-negative training use identical positive schedules. Checkpoints are selected before collecting a new GLEIF sample of 3,633 names, 2,880 source identities and 882 silver-positive pairs. At 72,660 candidate edges, adaptation with a multi-view selector increases direct pair recall from 53.74% to 76.98%. The primary matcher adds only seven correct and two incorrect co-cluster pairs: cluster recall rises from 32.54% to 33.33%, while precision falls from 95.99% to 95.45%. Of 208 newly retrieved silver-positive pairs, 202 fall below its decision threshold. Random-negative and hard-negative training produce identical final partitions. An AI-assisted, single-reviewer audit of 137 pairs supports the observed pattern, although its predominantly LEI-derived evidence does not establish independent gold labels. The results locate the immediate loss of retrieval gains at the existing confirmation stage and show why encoder evaluation must also measure final cluster quality.

</details>


### [593] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05250)
*Hoang-Thang Ta*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文在ExtraSensory个人情境识别数据集上评估多种KAN变体，并与MLP和TabM对比，发现KAN在F1指标上显著优于MLP、与TabM相当，但训练耗时更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN近年来在多种AI任务中受到关注，但其在个人情境识别任务上的有效性及计算效率尚缺乏系统评估，因此需要与MLP、TabM等基线进行对比研究。

Method: 在ExtraSensory数据集上使用五个用户折、每折三个随机种子进行主实验，报告Macro-F1、Micro-F1和训练时间的平均值，并对网格大小、网格数量和数据归一化进行浅层消融实验，比较多种KAN变体与MLP、TabM。

Result: 所有评估的KAN变体在Macro-F1和Micro-F1上显著优于MLP，性能与TabM相当；但KAN变体通常需要更多训练时间，TabM在预测性能与训练效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

Conclusion: KAN在个人情境识别中具有潜力，但计算效率仍是其重要挑战；源代码已公开。

Abstract: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.

</details>


### [594] [A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05625)
*Hind Yousif Alhammadi,Isam Mashhour Al Jawarneh*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了一个基于ArcPy的ArcGIS Pro自动化工具，用于从Landsat 7/8/9数据中提取地表温度（LST），并集成了可选的大语言模型（LLM）用于结果解读与报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LST提取需要手动选择波段和重复的栅格计算，效率低且易出错，因此需要自动化工具来简化流程、提高精度和效率。

Method: 工具自动化了辐射定标、基于NDVI的比辐射率校正和热转换等多步工作流；支持单景和批量处理，并可选配LLM进行统计结果解释与报告生成。

Result: 处理时间从手动约11-58分钟缩短至工具处理约4-11分钟；在阿联酋哈伊马角（RAK）测试，获得LST范围约25°C至50°C，与当地天气条件相符，验证了LST制图的准确性。

Conclusion: 该工具减少了人为错误，提高了热与环境遥感应用的精度和效率，并提供了基于LLM的交互式结果解读界面。

Abstract: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depending on batch size, the tool reduced the processing time from around 11-58 minutes when done manually to around 4-11 minutes using the tool. We tested the tool with data from Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) in the UAE, and the LST obtained for Ras Al Khaimah ranged from approximately 25C to 50C, demonstrating an accurate LST mapping compatible with the weather conditions of RAK. In summary, our tool reduces human errors and improves processing accuracy and efficiency for thermal and environmental remote sensing applications, in addition to providing an interactive LLM-based interface for result interpretation.

</details>


### [595] [A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05269)
*Xilin Dai,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出统一缩放律与统一时间序列学习理论，通过大规模实验揭示模型容量与历史信息如何支持预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解模型容量和历史信息在时序预测中的作用，以指导容量缩放、上下文分配及模型设计。

Method: 在6个领域、23个数据集-频率任务上，分析21个检查点的18,768个实验单元；提出五参数缩放律，并用高斯回归理论分析规则识别与预测能力。

Result: 缩放律在输入长度2048和4096下对Toto 2.0的容量缩放曲线预测MAPE为1.09%和1.50%；实验表明历史信息可被保留、跨查询重用并贡献长上下文预测。

Conclusion: 研究为容量缩放、上下文分配及保留和应用历史规则的模型开发提供了理论依据和实证支持。

Abstract: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.

</details>


### [596] [Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05279)
*Arathi Nair M,J. Harshan,Anwitaman Datta*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出DAFL框架，通过建立数据增强量与联邦学习收敛性的关系，为每个客户端-类别对确定最小增强量，以最小化增强与训练时间并约束全局类别不平衡，从而提升少数类F1分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中类别不平衡会损害少数类性能，常用方法通过增强少数类样本实现本地类别平衡，但现有方法将增强视为启发式操作，未明确增强量对联邦学习收敛的影响，导致过度增强和训练时间增加。

Method: 首先建立数据增强与联邦学习收敛行为之间的关系；基于此提出DAFL（分布式增强框架），联合最小化增强量和训练时间，同时约束全局类别不平衡，为每个客户端-类别对计算所需的最小增强量。

Result: 实验结果表明，DAFL在持续提升少数类F1分数的同时，显著减少了训练时间，尤其在严重全局类别不平衡和高标签比例不平衡的情况下表现突出。

Conclusion: DAFL通过量化增强与收敛的关系并优化增强量，有效解决了联邦学习中类别不平衡问题，在提升少数类性能的同时降低了训练开销。

Abstract: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

</details>


### [597] [Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05292)
*Weihan Li,Tianshi Zheng,Junhao Wu,Xinlei Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 后训练不再奖励某信息时，该信息可能被擦除、改道或缩放，本文提出可区分这三种命运的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征压缩的常见说法混淆了信息的三种命运：擦除、仍表征但不再用于决策、以及方差缩小但仍被表征和使用。

Method: 在预训练可恢复贝叶斯信念状态的模型中，用仅读取隐藏状态粗函数的奖励定义精确的奖励零核，分别测量信息可恢复性、决策因果依赖性和激活方差占比；结合理论分析KL锚定强化学习、无锚监督目标与谱压缩。

Result: 在受控世界中，后训练主要对奖励零信息改道或缩放且保持可解码；无锚时决策可停止使用但表征存活，有锚时继续使用；擦除仅出现在长期权重衰减且奖励与下一词预测均不可见的区分上。开放语言模型也显示相同分离。

Conclusion: 后训练选择预训练信念状态的因果商：奖励定义决策等价，锚与状态更新保护被忽略的部分，优化决定其余信息被擦除、改道还是缩放。

Abstract: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

</details>


### [598] [A Testable Theory of Atomic Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05794)
*Kenny Peng,Jon Kleinberg,Nikhil Garg*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出并验证了语言模型表示中存在原子特征的理论，稀疏字典随规模增大按流行度逐步恢复原子，并在大规模SAE上得到证实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究语言模型内部表示是否可由原子特征构成，并检验稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征随规模增长的稳定性，挑战传统认为SAE特征会分裂的观点。

Method: 建立原子特征理论，推导“恢复原则”并给出三个可检验预测；在两种大型嵌入模型上训练规模从512到131,072的SAE进行验证。

Result: 小SAE中的多数特征被所有更大SAE共享；不同数据训练的SAE共享双方流行特征；足够大的SAE能同时恢复父特征与子特征，预测均成立。

Conclusion: 结果表明基于原子特征的表示科学理论具有前景，且扩展SAE规模在实践上具有潜力。

Abstract: We develop and test a theory of language model representations in which there exist atomic features. Our main theoretical insight is that in such a model, sparse dictionaries (e.g., SAEs) of increasing size recover an increasing prefix of the most prevalent atoms in the training data. This "recovery principle" yields three testable predictions: many features in small SAEs are shared by all larger SAEs, SAEs trained on different data share features prevalent in both, and sufficiently large SAEs recover both parent and child features. In contrast to conventional wisdom that SAE features are unstable and "split" as size increases, we find that these predictions hold on SAEs of sizes ranging from 512 to 131,072 trained on two large embedding models. From a theoretical perspective, our results suggest the promise of a scientific theory of representations based on atomic features. Practically, our results suggest the promise of scaling SAEs.

</details>


### [599] [Measurement-First Auditing of Agentic Leaderboards: Contamination Susceptibility, Matched-Control Re-evaluation, and Scorer Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05830)
*Dishu Yang,Qi Su,Hongbo Qin,Hansong Zhang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出一种证据分级的污染审计框架，区分训练暴露、评测检索和流程泄漏三个渠道，并按开放/部分/封闭/未知编码；在HAL九种配置中未发现封闭渠道但确认四起事件，对SWE-bench Verified的定位差距进行行为学复现，结果不确定且评分器未通过验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体排行榜使用公开基准，其任务陈述和含解答的工件可能长期可访问，导致污染风险；但现有污染指控常缺乏与证据强度匹配的区分，需要按所需证据分层审计。

Method: 提出测量优先的审计框架，按证据要求区分三个渠道：训练时暴露、评测时检索、流水线/脚手架泄漏，各渠道按fail-closed规则编码为open、partial、closed或unknown。在九种HAL配置上完成27项渠道评估；随后将框架的行为学组件用于SWE-bench Verified的文件定位差距，采用结果盲法、同仓库匹配对照、对称提示泄漏筛查、配对与仓库感知的不确定性分析及评分器验证，在GPT-4.1和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上评测。

Result: 27项渠道评估中无一项为closed，但在四种配置中确认了污染事件。行为学分析中，经对称筛查和配对完整性排除后保留100对；GPT-4.1显示+10.0个百分点的配对加权Top-3基准相关差距，但预指定的配对bootstrap和事后仓库平衡分析的95%区间均包含零，差距不确定。复现评分器未通过验证门：对共识人工标签，两个模型均无法建立足够的评分器敏感性，且DeepSeek-V4-Flash在正确金标比较中的两次触发均为假阳性。

Conclusion: 缺乏来源证据、适当对照、对称泄漏筛查和已验证评分器时，不应提出更强的污染指控；结果未确立训练数据成员资格、污染流行率或基准导致的分数膨胀。

Abstract: Agentic leaderboards increasingly evaluate systems on public benchmarks whose task statements and solution-bearing artifacts can remain accessible. We propose a measurement-first audit framework that distinguishes contamination claims according to the evidence required to support them. It separates three channels that require different evidence: training-time exposure, evaluation-time retrieval, and pipeline/scaffold leakage. Each channel is coded as open, partial, closed, or unknown under a fail-closed rule. Across nine Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) configurations, none of the 27 channel assessments was coded closed, but incidents were confirmed in four configurations. We then apply the behavioral component of the framework to a reported file-localization gap on SWE-bench Verified, using an outcome-blind, same-repository matched-control design with symmetric prompt-leakage screening, paired and repository-aware uncertainty analyses, and scorer validation, evaluated on GPT-4.1 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Among the 100 pairs retained after symmetric screening and the pair-integrity exclusion, GPT-4.1 showed a $+10.0$-point pair-weighted Top-3 benchmark-associated gap, but the 95\% intervals from both the prespecified paired-bootstrap procedure and the post-hoc repository-balanced analysis included zero, leaving the benchmark-associated gap inconclusive. The reproduction scorer did not pass its validation gate: against consensus human labels, sufficient scorer sensitivity could not be established for either model, and both DeepSeek-V4-Flash firings on correct-gold comparisons were false positives. Without provenance evidence, appropriate controls, symmetric leakage screening, and validated scorers, stronger contamination claims are not warranted. The results do not establish training-data membership, contamination prevalence, or benchmark-induced score inflation.

</details>


### [600] [MiniCorp: The Last Mile of the AI Agent Firm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05912)
*Jingying Zeng,Zhenwei Dai,Jinning Li,Changho Shin,Dylan Zhang,Yuxuan Lu,Qi He,Dakuo Wang,Kai-Wei Chang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出MiniCorp企业模拟器，通过内外双世界交互生成大规模纵向企业数据，并支持反事实重放，以研究AI自主运营公司。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AGI需要纵向企业数据，但此类数据稀缺、获取成本高、受隐私限制；历史档案不完整且仅记录已发生事件，无法展示替代决策的结果。

Method: MiniCorp以电商公司为例，连接外部世界（建模客户、动态竞争者、市场机制）和内部世界（智能体观察事件、讨论选项并做战略决策）；决策对市场产生持久影响，反馈影响后续决策；持续记录通信与决策，并通过检查点支持同一情境在不同决策下重放，实现反事实比较。

Result: 端到端保真度评估对齐真实市场实证模式；实验显示智能体跨角色协调并适应市场反馈，在明确长期战略指导下，即使早期回报弱也能持续广告探索。

Conclusion: MiniCorp为研究AI运营公司提供环境，并为智能体训练和评估提供可扩展的纵向及反事实企业数据源。

Abstract: The last mile toward enterprise AGI is a company that runs itself. Training and adapting such agents require longitudinal enterprise data, which remain scarce, costly to acquire, and often restricted by privacy constraints. Historical archives are also frequently incomplete and record only what actually happened. They cannot show the outcomes of alternative decisions. We introduce MiniCorp, an office simulator for studying how agents can collectively run a company while generating enterprise data at scale. Using an e-commerce company as a demonstration, MiniCorp connects two interacting worlds. The external world models customers, dynamic competitors, and market mechanisms. The internal world consists of agents that observe events, discuss their options, and make strategic decisions. These decisions have lasting effects on the market, and the resulting feedback informs the firm's later decisions. As the firm and market interact, MiniCorp continuously records the agents' communications and decisions. These records preserve the information available at the time and the business results that followed. Checkpointing allows the same situation to be replayed under different decisions, providing comparisons unavailable in static archives. We evaluate end-to-end fidelity against patterns reported in empirical studies of real markets. These evaluations provide agents with realistic market feedback and reduce the risk that they learn to exploit flaws in the simulator. Our experiments show agents coordinating across roles and adapting their decisions to market feedback. With explicit long-term strategic guidance, they also sustain advertising exploration despite weak early returns. MiniCorp thus provides an environment for studying AI-run companies and a scalable source of longitudinal and counterfactual enterprise data for agent training and evaluation.

</details>


### [601] [VERA: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Agentic co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05923)
*Junqi Liu,Yongyang Pan,Zhuosong Jiang,Dongbai Li,Bo Zhang,Xitong Ling,Sheng Wang,Hanrong Ye,Yufan He,Can Zhao,Pengfei Guo,Dong Yang,Andriy Myronenko,Yuyin Zhou,Tianyu Liu,Daguang Xu,Yucheng Tang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: VERA通过从初始轨迹自动构建可验证沙盒环境，并交替优化模型与代理工具，实现长周期任务的协同进化训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数长周期任务环境仅评估最终结果，缺乏可验证的中间步骤与可恢复沙盒，导致训练不稳定且难以归因。

Method: VERA从初始轨迹生成环境：代理撰写评分标准与可执行检查，经裁判验证通过后入库；训练中交替使用评分奖励更新模型与编辑工具技能，并用验证器按开发集标准门控模型检查点与工具编辑。

Result: 构建了9000+长周期可验证环境；9B模型协同进化后，在两个领域分别超越最强基线10.3和13.0分；27B模型在AutoCoWorkBench（71.6）和AutoMedBench（80.7）上超越基线，并迁移至未见工作流且保留通用能力。

Conclusion: VERA可规模化构建可验证环境，通过双轴协同进化实现稳定训练与强泛化，优于单轴基线。

Abstract: Competent agents need precise and verifiable environments, such as sandboxes that are resumable at any stage and evolve from observable evidence. However, most long-horizon work exposes how rare these are: for example, an agent in medical research must ground a finding, classify it, and write a report over dozens of dependent steps, yet recent environments score only the outcome. To address the challenges in stable training, we present VERA, which builds such environments at scale and lets agents evolve on them. VERA builds these environments from initial trajectories: an agent writes rubrics, executable checks, a judge verifies each sandbox, and only those that pass enter the training bank. On these environments, VERA alternates between two updates: train the model with rubric rewards, or edit the harness skills. We also create a verifier which gates model checkpoints and harness edits using explicit development-set acceptance criteria. This attribution distinguishes VERA's co-evolution from single-axis baselines: its updates target not only the cause but the outcome. With an open-source corpus of 9,000+ long-horizon verifiable environments, a 9B model paired with its co-evolved agent beats the strongest baseline by 10.3 and 13.0 points in the two domains. At 27B, it surpasses the baseline on AutoCoWorkBench (71.6) and AutoMedBench (80.7), transfers to unseen workflows, and retains general capabilities.

</details>


### [602] [Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05378)
*Dario Fenoglio,Gabriele Dominici,Martin Gjoreski,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL）范式，通过传输模型在任务无关输入上的输出（随机载体）来共享知识，避免交换模型参数或适配器，显著降低通信量并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协作学习（联邦学习、基础模型组合）通常交换模型参数或适配器，导致通信量随模型规模增长，且权重空间调和易产生干扰。探索是否可通过模型在任务无关输入上的行为来共享知识。

Method: DSL：参与者本地适配公共模型，用任务无关输入探测模型，仅传输载体输出（completions或logits）；协调器汇集输出并蒸馏到共享模型。支持一次性基础模型组合（载体补全）和迭代联邦学习（载体logits），无需传输模型更新或任务相关代理数据。

Result: LLM组合中，相比LoRA平均，DSL偏好保留率94.56% vs 87.76%，GSM8K增益22.0 vs 0.6分，上传减少30.6-49.0倍；联邦分类中，MNIST达96.83%，上行通信比FedAvg少8.9倍，在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上提供更低通信操作点。

Conclusion: 随机载体输出可作为跨不同协作学习范式的实用通信原语，实现高效知识共享。

Abstract: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.

</details>


### [603] [Grounded Joint-Attention Other-Play for Zero-Shot Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06025)
*Giulia Benintendi,Constantin Ruhdorfer,Fabian Kögel,Andreas Bulling*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出MATE多智能体强化学习方法，通过模仿人类联合注意机制实现零样本协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索赋予AI智能体类似人类联合注意的机制能否实现零样本协调，避免依赖训练中形成的脆弱伙伴相关约定。

Method: MATE鼓励智能体在交互中将视觉注意力对齐到场景显著物体上，利用环境接地信号促进协调，而非任意伙伴依赖约定；并在Card Alignment Game、Level-Based Foraging和OvercookedV2三个基准上评估。

Result: 实验一致表明，受联合注意启发的信号提升了与未知伙伴的协调能力。

Conclusion: MATE可作为通用协调机制，补充并超越对称打破方法，具有提升零样本协调的潜力。

Abstract: Joint attention - the human ability to share a common visual or cognitive focus with others - enables a meeting of minds that lets us coordinate even with unfamiliar partners. In this work we investigate whether equipping AI agents with a similar mechanism can enable such zero-shot coordination. We introduce Mutual Attention for zero-shot TEaming (MATE): a novel multi-agent reinforcement learning method inspired by human joint attention. MATE encourages agents to coordinate their actions by aligning their visual attention on scene-salient objects during the interaction rather than relying on arbitrary partner-dependent conventions established during training. Unlike symmetry-breaking approaches that merely prevent brittle conventions from emerging, MATE actively promotes coordination through an environment-grounded signal that is naturally shared across partners. We evaluate MATE on three benchmarks: our Card Alignment Game, designed to isolate brittle convention formation, and the more challenging Level-Based Foraging and OvercookedV2 benchmarks. Our experiments consistently show that a joint-attention-inspired signal improves coordination with unknown partners, underlining MATE's potential as a general coordination mechanism that complements and surpasses symmetry-breaking approaches.

</details>


### [604] [RocketAgent: A Long-Horizon Engineering Agent for Multidisciplinary Design of Liquid-Rocket Thrust Chambers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06044)
*Junxiang He,Runze Mao,Kun He,Teng Zhang,Liming Zheng,Ke Xiao,Zhi X. Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出RocketAgent，一种用于液体火箭推力室多学科初步设计的长时程工程智能体，通过协调编码智能体与工程技能，结合知识图谱和设计中间表示，管理设计依赖与修订。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 液体火箭推力室设计涉及相互依赖的分析，下游约束常需回溯修改上游决策；跨异构工具管理这些依赖需要一致的设计信息与协调更新。

Method: RocketAgent由单个计划主导的编码智能体协调性能选型、子系统优化、几何生成与多物理评估等工程技能；采用溯源感知知识图谱支持方法选择，类型化设计中间表示维护共享参数、工件与决策；修订感知检查使受影响结果失效并阻止被取代的输入，重大变更需工程批准。

Result: 在代表性仿真设计中，RocketAgent从不可行冷却搜索继续，经工程师授权修改工作点，识别可行子系统设计，并协调后续几何生成与多物理评估以支持最终配置选择；独立模块测试评估了代理预测与喷管适配；三组受控场景下的双配置比较验证了求解器执行前预期的依赖失效与被取代输入阻止。

Conclusion: 代表性案例展示了多学科设计工作流的持续协调，受控测试则确立了支持该执行的修订机制行为。

Abstract: Liquid-rocket thrust-chamber design involves interdependent analyses in which downstream constraints can require earlier design decisions to be revisited. Managing these dependencies across heterogeneous tools requires consistent design information and coordinated updates throughout the workflow. We present RocketAgent, a long-horizon engineering agent for multidisciplinary preliminary design of liquid-rocket thrust chambers. A single plan-owning Coding Agent coordinates engineering skills for performance sizing, subsystem optimization, geometry generation, and multiphysics assessment. A provenance-aware knowledge graph supports method selection, while a typed Design Intermediate Representation maintains shared parameters, artifacts, and decisions. Revision-aware checks invalidate affected results and block superseded inputs, with consequential changes subject to engineering approval. In a representative simulation-based design, RocketAgent continued from an infeasible cooling search through an engineer-authorized operating-point revision, identified feasible subsystem designs, and coordinated subsequent geometry generation and multiphysics assessment to support final configuration selection. Separate module tests assessed surrogate predictions and nozzle adaptation. A two-configuration comparison across three controlled scenarios verified the expected dependency invalidations and superseded-input blocking before solver execution. The representative case demonstrates sustained coordination across a multidisciplinary design workflow, while the controlled tests establish the behavior of the revision mechanisms supporting that execution.

</details>


### [605] [Task Vector Descent: Learning from Non-IID Batches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05402)
*Anton Baumann,Jonas Hübotter,Zeynep Akata,Andreas Krause*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文研究持续学习中任务向量应完全保留还是部分应用的问题，发现中间值λ通常优于完全整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中，数据按时间聚类分布而非独立同分布，导致稳定性-可塑性权衡，且随着同一分布暴露时间增长而加剧，因此需探究任务向量的整合方式。

Method: 比较完全应用任务向量（λ=1）与部分整合——将任务向量按λ缩放后应用于继续模型，同时按相同系数缩放优化器状态，并在持续预训练、随机初始化预训练、监督后训练和强化后训练中评估。

Result: 在多种训练场景中，中间λ值常能提升继续模型的平均性能，尤其在长时间同一分布序列后；在持续预训练实验中，任务向量缩放优于完全整合，且不能仅由学习率缩放复现。

Conclusion: 部分整合任务向量（中间λ）是缓解持续学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡的有效策略，其收益独立于学习率调整。

Abstract: A central challenge in continual learning is to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what the model has already learned. This challenge appears in language model training when training data comes from various domain-, user-, or task-specific distributions that are encountered unevenly over time. In such settings, successive minibatches are temporally clustered by distribution instead of being sampled i.i.d. from the overall data mixture. Training on temporally clustered data induces a stability-plasticity tradeoff. Adapting the model to the active distribution can improve the model on the active distribution but may lead to a performance degradation on data it previously trained on. We find that this tradeoff intensifies with longer exposure to the same distribution. We therefore ask if the parameter displacement produced by such a sequence (the task vector) should be fully retained or applied partially. We compare applying the full displacement ($λ=1$) with partial integration, which scales the task vector by $λ$ before applying it to the continuing model and scales the optimizer state by the same coefficient. Across continual pretraining, pretraining from random initialization, supervised post-training, and reinforcement post-training, we find that intermediate values of $λ$ often improve average continuing-model performance relative to full integration, particularly after longer same-distribution sequences. In continual-pretraining experiments with both controlled streams and naturally defined adaptation sequences, task-vector scaling outperforms full integration at the matched learning rate, showing that its benefits are not reproduced by learning-rate scaling alone.

</details>


### [606] [Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05446)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 HTB 方法，用时间感知自举与子目标重标记提升离线分层强化学习的价值估计与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HIRO 通过子目标重标记复用回放数据，但重标记后价值更新目标指向新子目标，而非高层策略原本需更新的子目标，导致 off-policy 分层价值估计偏差。

Method: HTB 在当前低层策略下评估指定子目标并保留累积任务奖励；用剩余执行时间区分子目标延续与新高层决策；结合原始动作条件，实现基于平稳环境转移律的 off-policy Bellman 更新；融合一步更新、多步后缀回报与截断重标记；共享价值组件跨动作学习，非负残差约束向上修正。

Result: 在固定混合权重 0.95、10M 环境步、五组配对种子下，AntFall 成功率 32.8%，匹配的局部 HIRO 为 9.6%；消融验证递归延续与混合监督贡献；固定策略测试显示对被排除拟合动作的回报预测更准确。

Conclusion: HTB 通过时间感知自举与截断重标记缓解子目标重标记的价值目标错位，显著提升 off-policy 分层强化学习性能与价值预测准确性。

Abstract: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

</details>


### [607] [Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05450)
*Jacob Brodkey,Roberto Tamez,Aaron Roth*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出GLHF算法，通过单次比较学习分组条件策略，在每组上匹配GHY最优群体扭曲界，实验降低分组扭曲。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于偏好的对齐方法（RLHF、NLHF）聚合成对比较以最大化社会福利，但比较无法识别基数效用，只能通过扭曲衡量福利差距。现有NLHF最优性假设所有用户接收相同彩票，而基于账户的LLM可针对不同用户提供不同彩票，因此需要分组条件策略。

Method: GLHF从每个用户的一次比较中学习单一分组条件策略；在个体Bradley-Terry比较下，对预设的可能重叠的组集合，同时匹配GHY最优群体扭曲界，样本复杂度随组数对数增长、随最小组成员质量反比增长；对偏好相似的组，若成员共享可行最爱响应，扭曲保证趋近于1。

Result: 在人类咖啡评分和合成LLM生成评分实验中，GLHF降低每个评估组的扭曲，并相对NLHF和其他组无关基线显著降低最差组扭曲。

Conclusion: GLHF能高效学习分组条件策略，在个体比较模型下实现各组同时最优的扭曲保证，并实证改善分组公平性。

Abstract: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

</details>


### [608] [Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05458)
*Erland Hilman Fuadi,Chong Tian,Xiaosong Ma,Qirong Ho*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 跨厂商GPU运行同一语言模型会产生logits差异，本文系统分析该不匹配的度量、来源、缓解成本及对训练的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一模型和输入在不同GPU厂商上输出不同logits，可能导致下游任务和训练不一致，需量化并定位该问题。

Method: 在2个密集模型和2个MoE模型上，用位级相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性和任务准确率五类指标评估跨厂商不匹配；追溯到矩阵指令累加顺序；测试FP32上采样、仅MLP保持BF16、FP16、输出头LoRA等方案；并分析蒸馏训练中的影响。

Result: FP32上采样使密集模型logit误差降低43%但运行时间增至3倍，仅MLP用BF16可保留94%增益且时间仅1.3倍；MoE中FP32和FP16降低概率误差却提高logit误差并改变专家选择，FP16在密集模型失败；LoRA无效；固定种子下，从AMD教师蒸馏的学生与NVIDIA教师在431道MMLU题上答案不同。

Conclusion: 跨厂商不匹配源于矩阵指令累加顺序，且影响推理与训练；单一指标会误判缓解措施的成本与收益，需多指标综合评估。

Abstract: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

</details>


### [609] [Do Small Language Models Learn to Negotiate? A Controlled Scaling Study of RL-Trained Sellers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06204)
*Pedro Tabacof,Sagar Joglekar*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究通过GRPO强化学习训练不同规模Gemma 4模型进行双边多议题谈判，发现学习率调整对小模型谈判能力有显著影响，且需注意买家模型家族的泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究小模型能否通过强化学习成为有能力的卖家，并在多议题谈判中实现成本效益。

Method: 使用GRPO和程序化效用奖励训练四个Gemma 4检查点（2.3B到31B有效参数），在相同的1152次谈判中评估，对手为两个未见过的前沿买家；学习率设为10^-6，并探索三倍和十倍学习率。

Result: 相同学习率下，RL模型相对基线的增益从2.3B的+0.001升至31B的+0.078；三倍学习率在相同或更少步数下，各规模增益提升+0.032（2.3B）至+0.081（4.5B）。12B卖家在三倍学习率下得分超过两个前沿卖家，但未训练基线已相当；4.5B卖家无显著差异且可单卡48GB运行；2.3B十倍学习率提升总分但增益集中于同家族评估买家。

Conclusion: 在断定小模型无法学会谈判前应先调整学习率，并需用多个模型家族的买家进行测试。

Abstract: LLM agents are starting to own the full customer experience. Soon, LLMs may be selling and buying on behalf of companies and customers respectively. Small models are more cost-efficient at scale, but can reinforcement learning train them into competent sellers? We train four Gemma 4 checkpoints (2.3B to 31B effective parameters) with GRPO on a programmatic utility reward for bilateral multi-issue bargaining, and evaluate every arm on the same 1,152 negotiations against two frontier buyers it never saw in training. With the same learning rate ($10^{-6}$) for every size, the gain of the RL model over its base rises from $+0.001$ at 2.3B to $+0.078$ at 31B. Each size was trained once and the two smallest checkpoints use a different architecture, so we fit no scaling law. Tripling the learning rate, with the same or fewer training steps, improves on the shared rate at every size by $+0.032$ (2.3B) to $+0.081$ (4.5B). In exploratory comparisons with two frontier models run as sellers, the 12B seller trained at the tripled rate scores above both, though its untrained base already scores as high as they do. The 4.5B seller at that rate shows no detectable difference from either and fits on one 48 GB GPU. A further 2.3B arm at ten times the shared rate raises pooled score, but its gain concentrates on the evaluation buyer that shares a model family with the training pool. These results suggest tuning the learning rate before concluding that a small model cannot learn to negotiate, and testing against buyers from more than one model family.

</details>


### [610] [From Papers to Mechanisms: An Evidence-Grounded Knowledge Substrate for Scientific Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06248)
*Qiuhui Chen,Yibo Liu,Tao Dai,Jiafan Lu,Zhenglei Zhou,Weimin Zhong*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出证据接地机制知识基底，将文献组织为溯源链接的证据单元、角色类型化实体和有向机制路径，实例化MS³模式并验证其提升科学问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学语言模型通过无类型文本块访问文献，碎片化了机制丰富问题所需的功能与证据结构。

Method: 构建证据接地机制知识基底，实例化为MS³（材料-传感器-信号-系统）模式，覆盖13,689篇论文、131,083条证据项和26,648个机制对象；在域内和覆盖偏移问答基准上，对比闭卷生成、网络搜索、原始PDF RAG和MS³检索，使用十个语言模型评估。

Result: MS³提升了宏平均科学正确性，同时改善了引文蕴含和答案完整性。

Conclusion: 机制基底可作为科学语言模型的可靠表示层，并支持源修复工作流：当MS³证据不足时，触发从其链接论文中定向检索，而非假设用户已提供正确PDF。

Abstract: Scientific language models often access literature through untyped text chunks, which fragment the functional and evidential structure required for mechanism-rich questions. We introduce an evidence-grounded mechanism knowledge substrate that organizes scientific literature into provenance-linked evidence units, role-typed entities, and directed mechanism paths. We instantiate it as MS$^3$, a Material-Sensor-Signal-System schema for conductive-fiber flexible sensors, over 13,689 papers, 131,083 evidence items, and 26,648 mechanism objects. On in-domain and coverage-shift question-answering benchmarks, we compare closed-book generation, Web search, Raw-PDF RAG, and MS$^3$ retrieval across ten language models. MS$^3$ improves macro-averaged scientific correctness. It also improves citation entailment and answer completeness. These results support mechanism substrates as a reliable representation layer for scientific language models and motivate a source-repair workflow in which insufficient MS$^3$ evidence triggers targeted retrieval from its linked papers rather than assuming that a user has already supplied the correct PDFs.

</details>


### [611] [Universality and Convergence of Generative Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05490)
*Leo Brunswic*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文分析生成流（generative flows）训练损失的意义：小损失能否保证采样准确、损失能否降为零以及梯度下降收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践者依赖平衡损失作为训练信号，但该信号对采样精度的认证能力、可优化性及收敛速率缺乏理论保证，尤其对基于比值与差值的损失以及图上的后向策略作用不明。

Method: 理论分析：比较差值型与比值型（流匹配）损失对总变分误差的界定；在图结构上固定后向策略后，将平衡转化为后向链的不变性，引入Green算子范数作为逆谱隙；分析梯度下降沿后向策略的扩散机制，并对详细平衡与轨迹平衡的平方对数生成器进行全局收敛证明；用可枚举状态空间的精确计算和Lean 4形式化验证定理。

Result: 差值型损失以显式常数界定总变分误差，而比值型流匹配损失在单环且生成器连续时无此界；图上冻结后向策略后，Green算子范数从上下两侧决定损失在平衡流附近的曲率阶，并给出训练收敛速率下界；对平方对数生成器，平衡损失在任意有限路径连通图上从任意正初始化全局收敛；该常数可有限而后向轨迹平均较短，此时精确流匹配可能失败。

Conclusion: 训练损失可作为采样精度的认证信号，但其有效性取决于损失形式与图结构；后向链的Green算子范数主导优化景观与收敛速率，且所有结论均经形式化验证。

Abstract: Generative flows sample from an unnormalized target by training a flow to be balanced, and the training loss is the signal a practitioner watches. We ask what that signal is worth: whether a small loss certifies an accurate sampler, whether the loss can be driven to zero, and how fast gradient descent does so. The loss decides the first. Losses that compare the two sides of the balance by their difference bound, in total variation, the error of the sampler the flow implies, with explicit constants that do not involve the policy; flow-matching losses that compare them through a ratio admit no such bound, already on a single cycle, whenever their generator is continuous at balance. On graphs, the backward policy decides the other two. Once it is frozen, balance becomes invariance under the backward chain, so that existence is free on finite graphs, and one constant --- the norm of that chain's Green operator, which plays the role of an inverse spectral gap --- fixes the order of the curvature of the loss around the balanced flow, from above and below, and sets a floor under the rate at which training converges near it. The mechanism is that gradient descent diffuses the flow along the backward policy. For the squared-logarithm generator of detailed and trajectory balance, training the balance loss on states converges globally on every finite path-connected graph, from every positive initialization. The constant can be infinite while backward trajectories are short on average, and exact flow matching can then fail. The bounds and rates are tested by exact computation on enumerable state spaces, and every theorem carries a certification status computed from a Lean~4 development.

</details>


### [612] [Evolving in Thought Space: Training a Small Model at Test Time Unlocks Better Discoveries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06269)
*Chonghe Jiang,Ao Qu,Siyuan Liu,Ruoyun Ma,Zijian Zhou,Dingyi Zhuang,Bo Liu,Han Zheng,Hanfei Yu,Baichuan Mo,Jinhua Zhao,Paul Pu Liang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 Guidance-TTT 框架，将测试时训练的策略探索与执行解耦，用小型引导模型生成高层策略，冻结大型执行模型实现可执行解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有基于 TTT 的方法在需要大模型可靠执行时训练开销高，且结果级验证反馈难以同时归因于高层策略与底层实现，导致信用分配困难。

Method: 冻结强执行模型负责生成完整可执行解；紧凑引导模型在测试时用自适应组相对强化学习目标更新，仅提出高层策略变更。每步选择已有候选解、提出变更、执行验证，并只更新引导模型。

Result: 在无网络访问条件下，于组合优化 Polyomino Packing、启发式编程 AHC058、机器学习 Lasso、GPU 核优化 TriMul 四个领域均取得强解，超过先前工作报告的最佳结果，并与公开在线排行榜的 SOTA 保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 将测试时学习集中于短程策略决策，同时保留强执行模型的实现能力，可在多种科学发现任务中有效且高效地提升解质量。

Abstract: Open-ended scientific discovery often requires repeatedly proposing and evaluating candidate solutions. LLM-based systems can support this process by generating and refining executable solutions from verifier feedback. Methods such as TTT-Discover use test-time training (TTT) to update the solution-generating LLM from verifier feedback, adapting its generation policy to improve subsequent proposals on the target problem. However, this becomes expensive when reliable execution requires a large model, since training must maintain gradients, optimizer states, and policy statistics while repeatedly generating long, structured outputs. It also complicates credit assignment: outcome-level verifier feedback must jointly evaluate the high-level strategy and its low-level implementation. In this work, we introduce Guidance-TTT, which separates these roles. A compact guidance model is trained at test time to propose high-level strategic changes, while a frozen execution model implements them as complete executable solutions. At each step, the system selects a promising previously discovered solution, proposes a change, executes and verifies it, and updates only the guidance model using an adaptive group-relative RL objective. This concentrates test-time learning on short strategic decisions while retaining the implementation capability of a substantially stronger model without adapting it. Without web access, Guidance-TTT produces strong solutions across four distinct domains: combinatorial optimization (Polyomino Packing), heuristic programming (AHC058), machine learning (Lasso), and GPU kernel optimization (TriMul). Across these tasks, it outperforms the best solutions reported in prior work while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art results on public online leaderboards. Code is available at https://github.com/Human-Agent-Society/reef/tree/guidance-ttt-support.

</details>


### [613] [RollPlace: Improving Macro Placement via Monte Carlo Rollout Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06316)
